doi:10.1016/j.jbiosc.2026.10.001.abstractZh: 维持高糖酵解通量，对酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）稳健的乙醇发酵及代谢工程至关重要。然而，在遗传扰动下，防止糖酵解“涡轮式设计”结构过度激活的调控机制仍不清楚。本研究构建了包含90个反应和543个参数的酵母中心碳代谢动力学模型。研究者利用遗传算法，使用野生型菌株和11个单基因缺失突变株的多组学数据集（蛋白质组学、代谢组学及通量组学）训练模型集合。对校准模型开展代谢控制分析（MCA）发现，在本研究采用的培养条件下，所考察的大多数菌株主要由两种调控模式控制糖酵解通量；不过，gcr2Δ 表现出不同的控制特征，而模型无法重现 gnd1Δ 的行为。野生型、gcn4Δ 和 rpe1Δ 菌株表现为己糖激酶（HXK）受限的控制模式：降低的己糖激酶活性可能发挥反馈限流作用，以防止途径过度激活。相反，另外7个突变株转向 ATP 需求耦合模式，将通量控制转移到耗能反应，使糖酵解通量直接与 ATP 需求相联系。两组内部均未发现一致共享的单一调控基序，这意味着不同菌株各自的表达调整反复形成了这两种调控模式。这些发现阐明了酵母为维持高发酵能力而采用的稳健、多模式控制策略，并为靶向代谢工程和稳健生物工艺设计提供了理论基础。
doi:10.1016/j.jbiosc.2026.10.001.sourceTitle: Kinetic metabolic modeling of Saccharomyces cerevisiae mutants reveals two major regulatory patterns of glycolytic flux control.
doi:10.1016/j.jbiosc.2026.10.001.sourceAbstract: Maintaining a high glycolytic flux is critical for robust ethanol fermentation and metabolic engineering in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. However, the regulatory mechanisms that prevent the excess turbo design structure of glycolysis under genetic perturbations are unknown. In this study, we constructed a kinetic model of yeast central carbon metabolism encompassing 90 reactions and 543 parameters. Using a genetic algorithm, we trained the model ensemble using multi-omics datasets (proteomics, metabolomics, and fluxomics) collected from the wild-type strain and 11 single-gene deletion mutants. Metabolic control analysis (MCA) of the calibrated models revealed that two major regulatory modes governed the glycolytic flux in most of the strains examined under the culture condition used in this study, although gcr2Δ exhibited a distinct control profile and gnd1Δ could not be reproduced by the model. The wild-type, gcn4Δ, and rpe1Δ strains exhibited an HXK-limited control mode, in which lowered hexokinase activity likely acts as a feedback limiter to prevent pathway over-activation. Conversely, seven other mutants shifted to an ATP demand-coupled mode, transferring flux control to energy-dissipating reactions and linking glycolytic flux directly to ATP demand. No single motif was uniformly shared within either group, implying that strain-specific expression adjustments repeatedly resulted in two regulatory modes. These findings elucidate the robust, multimodal control strategies employed by yeast to safeguard its high fermentation capacity and provide a theoretical foundation for targeted metabolic engineering and robust bioprocess design.

doi:10.1016/j.nbt.2026.10.013.titleZh: 在空间分隔生物反应器中利用合成工程化互利大肠杆菌共培养生物膜提高紫色杆菌素产量
doi:10.1016/j.nbt.2026.10.013.abstractZh: 紫色杆菌素（violacein，VIO）是一种细菌次级代谢物，在医疗保健、纺织和化妆品行业具有潜在应用。虽然模块化合成大肠杆菌（E. coli）共培养体系有望用于生物制造，但其中 VIO 的生产依赖高效的交叉供养，而这需要共培养成员在空间上接近并维持稳定相互作用。本研究表明，空间分隔生物反应器可使互利重组大肠杆菌共培养体系同时以悬浮态和载体附着态共存，从而能够直接比较两种状态的粗制 VIO 生产性能。该共培养体系在空间分隔生物反应器中培养：好氧搅拌罐室与一个限氧柱式单元连接，后者装有作为载体的 Fibra-Cel® 圆片，使生物量分为悬浮组分与黏附组分。在3个生物学重复中，黏附于生物膜的组分按生物量归一化的粗制 VIO 产量均高于相应悬浮组分，分别达到其4.51倍、20.05倍和5.51倍。尽管黏附组分只占总生物量的10.6%—24.0%，却贡献了总粗制 VIO 的35.4%—86.3%。这些结果表明，分隔反应器内与载体关联的空间组织方式，支持形成高生产能力的生物膜相关大肠杆菌共培养群体。该概念展示了空间组织化、载体附着型共培养体系在强化次级代谢物生产，以及未来基于生物膜的生物加工应用中的潜力。
doi:10.1016/j.nbt.2026.10.013.sourceTitle: Enhanced violacein production by synthetically engineered mutualistic Escherichia coli co-culture biofilms in a spatially partitioned bioreactor system.
doi:10.1016/j.nbt.2026.10.013.sourceAbstract: Violacein (VIO) is a bacterial secondary metabolite with potential applications in healthcare, textile, and cosmetic industries. Although modular synthetic E. coli co-cultures are promising for biomanufacturing, VIO production in such systems depends on efficient cross-feeding, which requires spatial proximity and stable interactions among co-culture members. Here, we demonstrate that a spatially partitioned bioreactor can support coexisting suspended and carrier-associated states of a mutualistic recombinant E. coli co-culture, enabling direct comparison of their crude VIO production performance. The co-culture was cultivated in a spatially partitioned bioreactor consisting of an aerobic stirred-tank compartment connected to an oxygen-limited cartridge containing Fibra-Cel® discs as carriers, thereby enabling biomass partitioning into suspended and adherent fractions. Across three biological replicates, the adherent biofilm-associated fraction consistently exhibited higher biomass-normalized crude VIO production than the corresponding suspended fraction, with 4.51-, 20.05-, and 5.51-fold increases. Although the adherent fraction represented only 10.6-24.0% of the total biomass, it contributed 35.4-86.3% of the total crude VIO. These results show that carrier-associated spatial organization within the partitioned bioreactor supported the formation of highly productive biofilm-associated E. coli co-culture populations. The presented concept highlights the potential of spatially organized, carrier-associated co-cultures for the intensification of secondary metabolite production and future biofilm-based bioprocessing applications.

doi:10.1039/d6lc00512h.titleZh: 动态锥形喷嘴与多波形调制实现宽流体性质范围内无卫星液滴的高速压电喷射
doi:10.1039/d6lc00512h.abstractZh: 压电按需喷墨打印能够在微流控、生物制造和精密制造中实现微液滴的可控沉积。然而，传统压力腔式压电打印头易受黏性耗散和喷嘴堵塞影响，对高黏度、低表面张力液体及颗粒/细胞悬浮液的适应性有限，也难以有效抑制卫星液滴。这些限制阻碍了其在高精度、高稳定性喷墨应用中的实际部署。本研究通过动态锥形喷嘴，利用几何变形诱导的局部自泵送作用生成液滴，而非依赖传统压力腔中的压力波传播。结构优化使液滴速度达到5.42—12.67 m/s，并可在黏度最高40.3 mPa·s、表面张力24.44—72.75 mN/m及 Z 值1.01—38.11的条件下稳定喷射。机制分析确定，喷嘴的高频残余振动是液丝拉伸及二次破裂的主要原因。基于该机制，研究者设计了多波形调制策略，以动态调节喷嘴的位移响应。该策略在保持打印通量的同时，有效抑制高速喷射中的卫星液滴，并使液滴直径减小32%。对0.5 wt% SiO₂ 纳米颗粒悬浮液及10 wt% PVP K30 溶液的试验进一步验证了卫星液滴抑制效果。该平台可实现 MC3T3 细胞的高存活率打印，并将70 kDa 异硫氰酸荧光素（FITC）-葡聚糖无载体递送至细胞内，为在宽流体性质范围内以较低堵塞风险实现高速、稳定喷射提供了一条可行路径。
doi:10.1039/d6lc00512h.sourceTitle: Dynamic tapered nozzle and multiple waveform modulation enable high-speed piezoelectric jetting without satellite droplets across broad fluid property ranges.
doi:10.1039/d6lc00512h.sourceAbstract: Piezoelectric drop-on-demand inkjet printing enables controlled microdroplet deposition in microfluidics, biomanufacturing, and precision manufacturing. However, conventional pressure chamber piezoelectric printheads are susceptible to viscous dissipation and nozzle clogging, exhibit limited adaptability to high-viscosity, low-surface-tension liquids and particle/cell suspensions, and struggle to suppress satellite droplets effectively. These limitations hinder their practical deployment in high-precision and high-stability inkjet applications. Here, a dynamic tapered nozzle generates droplets through local self-pumping induced by geometric deformation rather than pressure-wave propagation in a conventional pressure chamber. Structural optimization enabled droplet velocities of 5.42-12.67 m s -1 and stable ejection at viscosities up to 40.3 mPa s, surface tensions of 24.44-72.75 mN m -1 , and Z values of 1.01-38.11. Mechanistic analysis identified high-frequency residual nozzle oscillations as the primary cause of ligament stretching and secondary breakup. Based on this mechanism, a multiple waveform modulation strategy is devised to dynamically regulate the nozzle displacement response. This strategy effectively suppresses satellite droplets during high-speed ejection while maintaining printing throughput and achieves a 32% reduction in droplet diameter. The satellite-droplet suppression effect is further validated in a 0.5 wt% SiO 2 nanoparticle suspension and a 10 wt% PVP K30 solution. The platform enables high-viability printing of MC3T3 cells and carrier-free intracellular delivery of 70 kDa fluorescein isothiocyanate (FITC)-dextran, establishing a feasible pathway for high-speed and stable ejection across broad fluid property ranges with low clogging risk.

doi:10.1515/jib-2026-0037.titleZh: 系统生物学与合成生物学标准：2026年的现状、进展与工具
doi:10.1515/jib-2026-0037.abstractZh: 十多年来，《Journal of Integrative Bioinformatics》持续出版专刊，提供系统生物学与合成生物学标准的更新规范。从2024年起，专刊的收录范围扩展至新开发或改进的工具，这些工具利用上述标准，或在标准实施中发挥关键作用。本期专刊包含4项更新规范以及2项工具或程序库。此外，本文还为全部COMBINE标准规范提供综合参考，确保研究者和实践人员能够获取该领域最新的可用版本。
doi:10.1515/jib-2026-0037.sourceTitle: Standards in systems and synthetic biology: status, developments, and tools in 2026.
doi:10.1515/jib-2026-0037.sourceAbstract: For over a decade, the Journal of Integrative Bioinformatics has published special issues providing updated specifications for standards in systems biology and synthetic biology. Beginning in 2024, the special issues expanded to include novel or refined tools that leverage these standards or play a key role in their implementation. The current special issue contains four updated specifications and two tools or libraries. In addition, this document functions as a comprehensive reference for all COMBINE standard specifications, ensuring researchers and practitioners can access the most up-to-date versions available in the field.

doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11272552/v1.titleZh: 用于早期移植排斥检测的合成全细胞生物传感器
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11272552/v1.abstractZh: 摘要：移植排斥的早期检测仍是一项尚未得到充分满足的重要临床需求，因为组织病理学检查具有侵入性、只能间断进行，且易受取样误差影响，而血清肌酐及其他常规生化指标往往在损伤已经发生后才升高[1–4]。本文介绍一种合成全细胞生物传感器，利用工程化大肠杆菌Nissle 1917（Escherichia coli Nissle 1917），将尿液中与排斥相关的核酸特征转化为可定量的荧光输出。该系统通过正交的toehold开关和受RNA计算（ribocomputing）启发的逻辑门，整合三类具有临床相关性的输入——尿液CXCL10/IP-10、CXCL9以及供体来源游离DNA（dd-cfDNA）的替代扩增子，以相较于单标志物检测提高特异性[3–10]。使用合成转录本时，各独立传感模块的检测限为每反应3.1 × 10^2至8.9 × 10^2拷贝，开启/关闭（ON/OFF）动态范围为10.8至17.4倍。仅在存在类似排斥反应的生物标志物组合时，多重与门（AND门）才产生18.6 ± 2.9倍的信号增强，同时将单标志物假阳性抑制至……
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11272552/v1.sourceTitle: Synthetic Whole-Cell Biosensor for Early Transplant Rejection Detection
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11272552/v1.sourceAbstract: Abstract Early detection of transplant rejection remains a major unmet clinical need because histopathology is invasive, episodic, and subject to sampling error, whereas serum creatinine and other routine chemistries often rise only after injury is established [1–4]. Here we describe a synthetic whole-cell biosensor that converts rejection-associated urinary nucleic acid signatures into a quantifiable fluorescent output using engineered Escherichia coli Nissle 1917. Using synthetic transcripts, the individual sensing modules showed limits of detection of 3.1 × 10^2 to 8.9 × 10^2 copies per reaction and ON/OFF dynamic ranges of 10.8- to 17.4-fold. doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11458557/v1.titleZh: 乙醇与CO₂的碳汇聚协同利用实现Komagataella phaffii中3-羟基丙酸的高效生物合成
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11458557/v1.abstractZh: 摘要：CO₂是一种丰富的生物制造原料，但其高氧化态使多碳化合物的生物合成需要大量还原力。本研究在工程化Komagataella phaffii中建立了一种碳汇聚策略，通过协同利用乙醇和无机碳生产3-羟基丙酸（3-HP）。乙醇作为枢纽分子，在提供得以保留的C2骨架的同时提供还原当量，从而通过并入无机C1碳，实现通向3-HP的“2+1=3”路线。通过协同改造乙醇同化、乙酸活化、羧化、辅因子供应及能量代谢，研究者获得了LT-28菌株，其3-HP滴度达到127.04 g/L，是迄今报道的基于CO₂生物合成的最高滴度。¹³C示踪证实，乙醇来源的C2碳和无机C1碳共同参与构成产物骨架。LT-28还将来自CO₂热催化还原的、未经纯化的富乙醇物料流转化为3-HP。这些发现证明，通过乙醇介导的碳汇聚，将CO₂化学还原与微生物3-HP生物合成相耦合是可行的。
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11458557/v1.sourceTitle: Carbon-Convergent Co-utilization of Ethanol and CO2 Enables Efficient 3-Hydroxypropionic Acid Biosynthesis in Komagataella phaffii
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11458557/v1.sourceAbstract: Abstract CO 2 is an abundant feedstock for biomanufacturing, but its high oxidation state demands substantial reducing power for multicarbon biosynthesis. Here, we establish a carbon-convergent strategy for producing 3-hydroxypropionic acid (3-HP) through the co-utilization of ethanol and inorganic carbon in engineered Komagataella phaffii. Ethanol serves as a nexus molecule that supplies a conserved C2 backbone together with reducing equivalents, enabling a "2+1=3" route to 3-HP through inorganic C1 incorporation. Coordinated engineering of ethanol assimilation, acetate activation, carboxylation, cofactor supply, and energy metabolism generated strain LT-28, which produced 127.04 g/L 3-HP, the highest titer reported so far for CO 2 -based biosynthesis. 13C tracing verified the joint contribution of ethanol-derived C2 carbon and inorganic C1 carbon to the product skeleton. LT-28 also converted an unpurified ethanol-rich stream from thermocatalytic CO2 reduction into 3-HP. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of coupling chemical CO 2 reduction with microbial 3-HP biosynthesis through ethanol-mediated carbon convergence.

doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761364.titleZh: 比较多组学揭示酵母源细胞外囊泡中保守的膜结构与代谢活性载荷的选择性富集
doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761364.abstractZh:
细胞外囊泡（EV）是各生命界细胞间通讯的基本介质，但我们对其生物学的认识主要来自哺乳动物系统。相比之下，尽管酵母源细胞外囊泡（YDEV）有潜力成为可规模化、非致病性的生物技术与代谢工程平台，其特征仍缺乏充分研究。本研究将高产量分离流程与比较多组学相结合，界定了来自3个酵母物种、4个菌株的细胞外囊泡中的代谢活性载荷与膜组成：传统模式酵母酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae，SC）、非模式产油酵母 Rhodotorula toruloides（RT-88），以及解脂耶氏酵母（Yarrowia lipolytica）的野生型W29及其工程化衍生菌株Po1f。研究者采用切向流过滤结合超速离心，可重复地从所有菌株中分离出完整、由双层膜包裹的囊泡。尽管各菌株的囊泡产量存在显著差异，这些囊泡仍具有保守的纳米尺度形态。比较代谢组学揭示了不同代谢活性载荷的选择性富集，包括SC中的核苷酸代谢物、RT-88中的脂肪酸与酰基肉碱，以及解脂耶氏酵母菌株中特有的代谢物。值得注意的是，烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD⁺）在SC和RT-88的细胞外囊泡中富集，但在解脂耶氏酵母来源的囊泡中几乎不存在。这提示一种可能性：囊泡包封或可为这种本身不能透过膜的辅因子提供受保护的运输。与载荷组成的差异形成对照，比较脂质组学表明，所有菌株的囊泡膜结构总体保守，仅特定脂质类别及膜不饱和度谱发生定量层面的重塑。综合而言，这些发现支持这样一种组织原则：酵母源细胞外囊泡在维持保守膜结构的同时，选择性富集具有代谢活性的载荷，由此建立了一个比较框架，用于理解进化上具有多样性的酵母物种中的细胞外囊泡生物学。

doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761364.sourceTitle: Comparative Multi-omics Reveals Conserved Membrane Architecture and Selective Metabolic Cargo Enrichment Across Yeast-Derived Extracellular Vesicles
doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761364.sourceAbstract: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are fundamental mediators of intercellular communication across all kingdoms of life, yet our understanding of EV biology has been derived predominantly from mammalian systems. In contrast, yeast-derived extracellular vesicles (YDEVs) remain poorly characterized despite their potential as scalable, non-pathogenic platforms for biotechnology and metabolic engineering. Here, we combined a high-yield isolation workflow with comparative multi-omics to define the metabolically active cargo and membrane composition of EVs derived from three yeast species and four strains: the conventional model yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae (SC), the non-model oleaginous yeast Rhodotorula toruloides (RT-88), and two Yarrowia lipolytica strains, wild-type W29 and its engineered derivative Po1f. Using tangential flow filtration coupled with ultracentrifugation, we reproducibly isolated intact, bilayer-enclosed vesicles with conserved nanoscale morphology across all strains despite marked differences in EV yield. Comparative metabolomics revealed selective enrichment of distinct metabolically active cargo, including nucleotide metabolites in SC, fatty acids and acyl-carnitines in RT-88, and strain-specific metabolites within the Yarrowia isolates. Notably, nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD⁺) was enriched in SC and RT-88 EVs but was nearly absent from Yarrowia -derived vesicles, raising the possibility that EV encapsulation may facilitate protected transport of this otherwise membrane-impermeable cofactor. In contrast to these differences in cargo composition, comparative lipidomics demonstrated a broadly conserved membrane architecture across all strains, with only quantitative remodeling of specific lipid classes and membrane unsaturation profiles. Together, these findings support an organizational principle in which yeast-derived extracellular vesicles preserve a conserved membrane architecture while selectively enriching metabolically active cargo, establishing a comparative framework for understanding EV biology across evolutionarily diverse yeast species. doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761469.titleZh: 仿骨髓熔融静电直写支架重现幼红细胞岛，用于培养红细胞的高密度生物制造
doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761469.abstractZh: 生物制造的细胞疗法正在给现代医学带来显著进步，但高成本阻碍了其广泛应用。培养红细胞（cRBC）是一类正处于临床试验阶段、拟用于即用型输血的细胞治疗产品；然而，一次输血所需的数万亿个红细胞（RBC）的制造成本极高，仍然限制着其应用。如果培养平台能够像骨髓中那样，以更高密度培养细胞，使每个细胞所需的培养基更少、昂贵生长因子的使用浓度更低，则可能降低这些成本。研究者通过熔融静电直写（MEW）制造聚己内酯（PCL）支架，使其几何形状模仿骨髓中的骨小梁结构，随后经等离子体处理，以支持外周血单个核细胞（PB MNC）附着。PB MNC中的单核细胞首先黏附于支架，并迅速分化为CD68⁺巨噬细胞样细胞。这些负载巨噬细胞的支架进一步黏附CD71⁺幼红细胞；在红系诱导培养条件下，幼红细胞的比例从第4天的10%增加至第8天的25%，并在第20天产生CD235a⁺红系细胞。与传统的MEW交叉网格几何形状相比，仿骨小梁几何形状的MEW PCL支架具有更大的表面积，可黏附更多巨噬细胞，并生成更多幼红细胞。MEW支架持续将黏附性较弱的细胞释放到培养上清中；在细胞接种数量与培养基体积相同的条件下，其上清细胞数比液体悬浮培养对照增加74%。高细胞密度支架表现出更活跃的代谢，并内源性产生支持自身生长的细胞因子，这可能为未来通过优化培养基降低成本提供机会。本研究报告了仿骨髓骨小梁结构的MEW PCL设计，能够选择性黏附外周血单个核细胞，形成覆盖巨噬细胞的支架，为培养红细胞的生产提供物理与旁分泌支持。这一高细胞密度培养平台可能适用于未来的细胞治疗生物制造流程。
doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761469.sourceTitle: Marrow-mimicry MEW scaffolds recapitulate erythroblastic islands for high-density cRBC biomanufacturing
doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761469.sourceAbstract: Biomanufactured cell therapies are delivering a step-change in modern medicine, but their high costs have prevented widespread adoption. Cultured red blood cells (cRBCs) are one type of cell therapy in clinical trials for off-the-shelf blood transfusion but remain limited by the exorbitant costs of manufacturing trillions of RBCs required for a blood transfusion. These costs could be mitigated if culture platforms could grow cells at higher density, like those found in the bone marrow, requiring less media and lower concentrations of expensive growth factors per cell. We engineered melt electrowritten (MEW) polycaprolactone (PCL) scaffolds in geometries which imitate marrow trabeculae structures and were then plasma-treated to enable peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PB MNC) attachment. PB MNC monocytes first adhered to the scaffold and rapidly differentiated into CD68 + macrophage-like cells. These macrophage-loaded scaffolds adhered CD71 + erythroblasts, which then grew from 10 to 25% between days 4 and 8 and produced CD235a + erythroid cells by day 20, under erythrogenic culture conditions. MEW PCL scaffolds in trabecular-like geometries had greater surface area, adhered more macrophages, and generated more erythroblasts than traditional MEW crosshatch geometries. The MEW scaffolds continuously released less-adherent cells to the supernatant, providing a 74% increase in supernatant cell numbers versus liquid suspension controls with identical cell seeding numbers and media volumes. High-cell-density scaffolds exhibited increased metabolism and endogenous production of self-supportive cytokines, which may offer cost-saving opportunities through future media optimisation. This study reports marrow trabeculae-mimetic MEW PCL designs capable of selectively adhering PB MN cells to develop macrophage-coated scaffolds, which provided physical and paracrine support for cRBC production. This high-cell-density culture platform may be useful for future cell therapy biomanufacturing protocols.

doi:10.64898/2026.10.25.761636.titleZh: 遗传控制将不依赖TGFβ的多能干细胞自我更新与跨胚层的确定性正向编程相耦合
doi:10.64898/2026.10.25.761636.abstractZh: 要可重复、可规模化地制造人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）衍生细胞，需要控制其扩增与分化。转录因子介导的正向编程可使hiPSC分化受到遗传控制，但扩增仍依赖外源补充生长因子，从而增加工艺复杂性及对操作者的依赖。本研究提出GERALT，即遗传增强的自我更新与自主谱系转分化（Genetically Enhanced Renewal and Autonomous Lineage Transdifferentiation）。这是一种通过靶向安全港位点整合而组装的推拉式基因回路，将由NANOG支持、不依赖TGFβ的自我更新，与多西环素诱导的谱系编程及同步发生的NANOG沉默相耦合。在长时间撤除TGFβ的条件下，GERALT在贴壁培养与悬浮培养中均能维持多能性，同时仍可被编程为肌源性、神经元及肝细胞命运。在肌生成方面，与已建立的OPTi-OX平台相比，GERALT能够在简化培养基中实现分化，同时使命运决定过程更加定向并加快这一过程。GERALT还支持在悬浮培养中直接进行肌源性编程，并能将hiPSC直接浇注到水凝胶中，随后在组织内进行编程，获得能够对电刺激作出反应的工程化肌肉组织。这些结果将遗传控制向上游延伸至干细胞自我更新，有助于新方法学（new approach methodologies）及其他生物制造应用的实施。
doi:10.64898/2026.10.25.761636.sourceTitle: Genetic control couples TGF β -independent pluripotent stem cell renewal to deterministic forward programming across germ layers
doi:10.64898/2026.10.25.761636.sourceAbstract: Reproducible and scalable manufacture of human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC) derivatives requires control over expansion and differentiation. Transcription factor-mediated forward programming can place hiPSC differentiation under genetic control, but expansion still relies on extracellular growth-factor supplementation, increasing process complexity and operator dependence. Here we introduce GERALT ( G enetically E nhanced R enewal and A utonomous L ineage T ransdifferentiation), a push–pull genetic circuit assembled through targeted safe-harbour integration that couples NANOG-supported, TGF β -independent renewal to doxycycline-inducible lineage programming and simultaneous NANOG silencing. GERALT maintained pluripotency during extended TGF β withdrawal in both adherent and suspension culture, yet remained programmable towards myogenic, neuronal, and hepatic fates. Compared with the established OPTi-OX platform in myogenesis, GERALT enabled differentiation in simplified medium while canalising and accelerating commitment. GERALT also supported direct myogenic programming in suspension and enabled direct casting of hiPSCs into hydrogel followed by in-tissue programming, yielding electrically responsive engineered muscle tissues. These results extend genetic control upstream into stem cell renewal, facilitating deployment of new approach methodologies and other biomanufacturing applications.

doi:10.1016/j.mcpro.2026.101695.titleZh: 高通量蛋白质相互作用组分析揭示LSD1通过病毒核衣壳蛋白赖氨酸去甲基化调控SARS-CoV-2产生
doi:10.1016/j.mcpro.2026.101695.abstractZh: 在生理条件下，高通量鉴定蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）并对其成像，仍是一项重大挑战。同时，SARS-CoV-2核衣壳（N）蛋白是含量最高的病毒蛋白，在病毒产生中发挥关键作用。为增进对病毒机制的认识并支持抗病毒开发，研究者使用拆分的miRFP670nano3，开发了亮度最高且体积最小的近红外双分子荧光互补（NIR-BiFC）系统。通过将该系统与新一代测序（NGS）相整合，研究者建立了NIR-BiFC-Seq，用于高通量绘制蛋白质相互作用组。应用这一方法，研究者系统考察了SARS-CoV-2 N蛋白与宿主细胞蛋白之间的相互作用。结果揭示，赖氨酸特异性去甲基化酶1（LSD1）使N蛋白第233位赖氨酸（K233）去甲基化，从而通过增强N蛋白的多种功能促进病毒产生。这些功能包括N蛋白二聚化、与Nsp12相互作用、与病毒RNA结合，以及液-液相分离（LLPS）。值得注意的是，靶向K233位点的抑制剂显著抑制了SARS-CoV-2的产生。本研究建立了NIR-BiFC-Seq这一用于相互作用组绘制的灵敏合成生物学平台，并将LSD1介导的调控机制确定为有前景的抗病毒治疗靶点。
doi:10.1016/j.mcpro.2026.101695.sourceTitle: High-throughput protein interactome identifies LSD1 as a regulator of SARS-CoV-2 production through lysine demethylation of viral nucleocapsid protein.
doi:10.1016/j.mcpro.2026.101695.sourceAbstract: High-throughput identification and imaging of protein-protein interactions (PPIs) under physiological conditions remains a significant challenge. Concurrently, the SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid (N) protein, the most abundant viral protein, plays an essential role in viral production. To advance the understanding of viral mechanisms and support antiviral development, we developed the brightest and smallest near-infrared bimolecular fluorescence complementation (NIR-BiFC) system using split miRFP670nano3. By integrating this system with next-generation sequencing (NGS), we established NIR-BiFC-Seq for the high-throughput mapping of protein interactomes. Applying this method, we systematically investigated interactions between the SARS-CoV-2 N protein and host cellular proteins. Our findings reveal that lysine-specific demethylase-1 (LSD1) demethylates the N protein at lysine 233 (K233), thereby enhancing viral production through the potentiation of multiple N protein functions. These include N protein dimerization, interaction with Nsp12, binding to viral RNA, and liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). Notably, inhibitors targeting the K233 site significantly suppressed SARS-CoV-2 production. This study establishes NIR-BiFC-Seq as a sensitive synthetic biology platform for interactome mapping and identifies LSD1-mediated regulatory mechanisms as promising targets for antiviral therapy.

doi:10.1016/j.molcel.2026.10.001.titleZh: 小基因组，大启示：病毒如何帮助我们认识基于结构的RNA调控
doi:10.1016/j.molcel.2026.10.001.abstractZh: RNA病毒在同一分子中编码多层信息，该分子既是蛋白质合成的模板，也作为具有特定结构的调控性RNA发挥作用。这些结构控制病毒基因表达的关键环节，调节与宿主的相互作用，并介导免疫逃逸。尽管RNA结构在病毒基因组中的普遍存在已得到充分认识，但直到最近，功能与机制研究才开始揭示这些元件如何作为调控模块影响感染结局。RNA病毒具有紧凑的基因组和便于开展实验研究的生命周期，因此成为有力的模式系统，可用于揭示RNA调控的基本构成要素，以及真核生物中保守的基因控制原则。本文综述了目前对不同病毒科中基于RNA结构的调控机制的认识，并将其与真核生物转录组中由结构介导的基因控制进行对照，强调RNA结构是基因表达的一个核心调控层面，在治疗与合成生物学方面具有广泛潜力。
doi:10.1016/j.molcel.2026.10.001.sourceTitle: Small genomes, big lessons: What viruses teach us about structure-based riboregulation.
doi:10.1016/j.molcel.2026.10.001.sourceAbstract: RNA viruses encode multiple layers of information within a single molecule, which functions simultaneously as a template for protein synthesis and as a structured regulatory RNA. These structures control key aspects of viral gene expression, govern host interactions, and mediate immune evasion. Although the prevalence of RNA structure in viral genomes is now well established, only recently have functional and mechanistic studies begun to uncover how these elements act as regulatory modules that shape infection outcomes. With their compact genomes and experimentally tractable life cycles, RNA viruses represent powerful model systems for uncovering the fundamental building blocks of riboregulation and illuminating principles of gene control conserved across eukaryotes. Here, we review current mechanistic understanding of RNA structure-based regulation across diverse viral families and draw parallels to structure-mediated gene control in eukaryotic transcriptomes, highlighting RNA structure as a central regulatory layer in gene expression with broad therapeutic and synthetic biology potential.

doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.3003778.titleZh: PrimeStack编辑器实现植物中大型多基因载荷的高效、位点特异性整合
doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.3003778.abstractZh: 将大型DNA序列精确、定点地整合到植物基因组中，是作物生物技术和合成生物学长期追求的目标，但随机插入、同源重组效率低以及基因靶向方面的限制仍然存在。本研究提出PrimeStack，这是一种不依赖双链断裂（DSB）的平台，将先导编辑（PE）与单向大型丝氨酸整合酶Bxb1相结合，并利用进化所得的变体增强活性，从而在水稻（Oryza sativa）预先指定的基因组安全港（GSH）中，实现多基因、数千碱基载荷的可编程插入。优化后的先导编辑器首先以高保真性建立具有高遗传性的attP着陆位点，随后通过Bxb1介导的重组，实现遗传信息的不可逆整合。根据连接位点特异性PCR分析，PrimeStack在再生水稻植株中实现了大型载荷的定点整合，效率最高达45%。在所评估的条件下，移栽入土5周后，未观察到这些植株与野生型（WT）植株之间存在明显的形态学差异。研究者通过在一个经实验确认的基因组安全港中定点插入类胡萝卜素基因盒，验证了该平台的实用性。PrimeStack提供了模块化、位点特异性的基因堆叠平台，使基因组安全港中的多基因性状聚合与途径构建具有可预测性，从而加快改良型、抗逆作物品种的开发，并推动可规模化的植物生物制造及强大合成生物学底盘的构建。
doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.3003778.sourceTitle: PrimeStack editors enable efficient and site-specific integration of large multigene cargos in plants.
doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.3003778.sourceAbstract: Precise, site-specific integration of large DNA sequences into plant genomes is a long-standing goal of crop biotechnology and synthetic biology, yet remains constrained by random insertion, inefficient homologous recombination, and gene targeting. Here, we present PrimeStack, a DSB-independent platform that integrates PE with the unidirectional large serine integrase Bxb1, leveraging evolved variants for enhanced activity, to achieve the programmable insertion of multigene, multikilobase cargos at predefined genomic safe harbors (GSH) in rice (Oryza sativa). Optimized prime editors first install attP landing sites with high fidelity and heritability followed by Bxb1-mediated recombination that generates irreversible integration of genetic information. PrimeStack enabled targeted large-cargo integration in regenerated rice plants with efficiencies of up to 45%, as determined by junction-specific PCR analyses. No obvious morphological differences from WT plants were observed at 5 weeks after transfer to soil under the evaluated conditions. We validate its utility by achieving targeted insertion of a carotenoid cassette at an experimentally confirmed genomic safe harbor. PrimeStack delivers a modular, site-specific gene stacking platform that enables predictable, multigene trait pyramiding and pathway construction at GSH, thereby accelerating the development of improved and resilient crop varieties, as well as scalable plant-based biomanufacturing and a powerful chassis for synthetic biology.

doi:10.1016/j.pbiomolbio.2026.101967.titleZh: 人工智能增强的CRISPR-Cas9治疗技术：精准性、安全性与递送的研究进展
doi:10.1016/j.pbiomolbio.2026.101967.abstractZh: CRISPR-Cas9基因组编辑已经改变了生物医学研究，并正向临床转化推进。人工智能（AI）的引入有助于提高向导RNA设计、脱靶预测与递送优化的精准性。本综述综合了CRISPR-Cas9医学应用的近期进展，涵盖其核心机制、工程化变体、碱基编辑器与先导编辑器（prime editors），以及嵌合抗原受体T细胞（CAR-T）和嵌合抗原受体自然杀伤细胞（CAR-NK）工程改造、遗传性疾病、感染性疾病及再生医学等治疗应用。文章评估了递送策略，重点关注由AI驱动的优化。所讨论的AI应用包括：用于向导RNA设计的深度学习架构；OpenCRISPR-1等由AI设计的核酸酶；结合结构指导与AI辅助，设计紧凑型、高保真SaCas9变体；利用强化学习优化流程；以及AI在CAR-T细胞治疗和安全性评估中的作用。综述还考察了脱靶效应、染色体重排、免疫原性及监管方面的安全挑战。未来方向重点包括多尺度建模、可解释AI、临床验证，以及与合成生物学、单细胞测序、类器官和纳米材料相结合。AI与CRISPR-Cas9的融合为个体化医疗带来了很大潜力。
doi:10.1016/j.pbiomolbio.2026.101967.sourceTitle: AI-enhanced CRISPR-Cas9 therapeutics: Advances in precision, safety, and delivery.
doi:10.1016/j.pbiomolbio.2026.101967.sourceAbstract: CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing has transformed biomedical research and is advancing toward clinical translation. The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) offers improved precision in guide RNA design, off-target prediction, and delivery optimization. This review synthesizes recent advances in CRISPR-Cas9 for medical applications, covering core mechanisms, engineered variants, base and prime editors, and therapeutic applications including CAR T-cell and CAR-NK engineering, genetic disorders, infectious diseases, and regenerative medicine. Delivery strategies are evaluated with emphasis on AI-driven optimization. AI applications are highlighted across deep learning architectures for guide RNA design, AI-designed nucleases such as OpenCRISPR-1, structure-guided and AI-assisted design of compact high-fidelity SaCas9 variants, reinforcement learning for pipeline optimization, and roles in CAR T-cell therapy and safety assessment. Safety challenges are examined, including off-target effects, chromosomal rearrangements, immunogenicity, and regulatory concerns. Future directions emphasize multi-scale modeling, explainable AI, clinical validation, and integration with synthetic biology, single-cell sequencing, organoids, and nanomaterials. The convergence of AI and CRISPR-Cas9 holds substantial potential for personalized medicine.

doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2026.102578.titleZh: 在植物体内工程化构建母乳寡糖的全部岩藻糖苷键类型
doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2026.102578.abstractZh: 母乳寡糖（HMOs）是母乳的一种组分，可通过调节免疫反应、抑制病原体黏附和促进健康的肠道微生物群，改善婴儿的健康结局。尽管这些作用已有充分报道，但接受过临床或生化研究的HMO种类仍很少，因为在超过200种HMO中，目前只有少数结构最简单的种类能够通过化学合成，或在微生物宿主中利用代谢工程生产。相比之下，植物天然具备生物合成多种复杂多糖的能力，近期也已被用作HMO生产的异源体系。不过，HMOs中的许多结构类型尚未在植物中构建出来，尤其是岩藻糖基化结构。岩藻糖基化HMO中存在4种岩藻糖苷键，但此前仅有Fucα1-2Gal在植物体内实现了生物合成。本研究以模式植物本氏烟草（Nicotiana benthamiana）筛选细菌来源的岩藻糖基转移酶，生产了3-岩藻糖基乳糖（3-fucosyllactose，Fucα1-3Glc）、lacto-N-fucopentaose II（Fucα1-4GlcNAc）和lacto-N-fucopentaose III（Fucα1-3GlcNAc），表明全部4种岩藻糖苷键均可在植物体内构建。母乳中的所有HMO仅由12种糖苷键构成，本研究将已能在植物体内构建的糖苷键种类从7种增加到10种，大幅扩展了可利用植物合成的HMO种类。
doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2026.102578.sourceTitle: Engineering all human milk oligosaccharide fucosidic linkages in planta.
doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2026.102578.sourceAbstract: Human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) are a component of breast milk which improve infant health outcomes by modulating immune responses, inhibiting pathogen adhesion, and promoting healthy gut microbiota. Although their effects are well-documented, few HMOs have been clinically or biochemically studied because only a handful of the simplest HMOs out of >200 species are currently possible to chemically synthesize or produce in microbes via metabolic engineering in microbial hosts. In contrast, plants are naturally adept at biosynthesizing a wide range of complex polysaccharides, and they have recently been established as a heterologous system for HMO production. However, much of the structural diversity of HMOs has not yet been reproduced in a plant, particularly fucosylations. Four fucosidic linkages can be found in fucosylated HMOs, but only Fucα1-2Gal has been biosynthesized in planta. Here, we screened bacterial fucosyltransferases using the model plant Nicotiana benthamiana to produce 3-fucosyllactose (Fucα1-3Glc), lacto-N-fucopentaose II (Fucα1-4GlcNAc), and lacto-N-fucopentaose III (Fucα1-3GlcNAc), demonstrating that all four fucosidic linkages can be made in planta. Just twelve glycosidic linkages make up all the HMOs found in breast milk, and our findings increase the number of linkages made in planta from seven to ten, greatly expanding the variety of HMOs accessible in a plant.

doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.109091.titleZh: 叶绿体基因组工程：近期进展、商业化路径与未来方向
doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.109091.abstractZh: 叶绿体是理想的生物工厂，因为每个植物细胞中可整合数千个转基因拷贝，从而高水平生产重组蛋白和酶。由于叶绿体基因组主要通过母系遗传，转基因通常不会经花粉传播。核基因组工程开启了以作物保护为目标的转基因生物（GMO）革命，而这类应用大多只需要较低的转基因表达水平。更高水平的表达，以及通过限制基因扩散而实现的生物安全性，有助于拓展转基因作物的新应用，包括生产高价值生物药和酶。本综述重点介绍该领域的近期进展，包括植物细胞制备的生物药首次获美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准开展人体临床试验评估、局部或口服给药、通过去除抗生素抗性基因获得不含筛选标记的可食用植物，以及产生有功能的人源蛋白所需的新型翻译后修饰。此外，文章讨论了改善DNA递送、无载体组装、游离型或整合型方法的新工具，通过优化调控序列和密码子增强转基因表达的方法、靶向基因组编辑，以及生物制造中的其他创新。文中还讨论了利用含植物细胞的口香糖进行局部给药、以控制口腔病毒、致病细菌或酵母，以及使用植物细胞制得的治疗性蛋白进行口服给药、以治疗糖尿病、肥胖和心肺疾病的策略；这些策略目前已推进至人体临床试验。文章还讨论了用于推出新产品、赋予有价值的农艺性状或增强光合作用的高价值工业酶。未来展望部分列举了有望在未来3—5年推出的生物技术产品，并讨论了相关机遇与预期挑战。
doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.109091.sourceTitle: Chloroplast genome engineering: Recent advances, pathways towards commercialization and future directions.
doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.109091.sourceAbstract: Chloroplasts are ideal biofactories because thousands of transgene copies integrated into each plant cell to produce high levels of recombinant proteins and enzymes. Because chloroplast genomes are predominantly maternally inherited, transgenes are generally not transmitted via pollen. Nuclear genome engineering ushered in the GMO revolution for crop protection that mostly required lower levels of transgene expression. Higher level expression and biosafety through gene containment facilitate new applications of GM crops, including production of high-value biopharmaceuticals and enzymes. This review focuses on recent advances in this field, including the first FDA approval of biopharmaceuticals made in plant cells for evaluation in human clinical trials, topical or oral drug delivery, marker free edible plants by removal of antibiotic resistance genes and novel post-translational modifications required to produce functional human proteins. In addition, new tools are discussed to improve DNA delivery, vector free assembly, episomal or integration methods, enhancement of transgene expression through optimization of regulatory sequences, codons, targeted genome editing and other innovations in biomanufacturing. Topical drug delivery using plant cells incorporated into chewing gums to control oral viruses, pathogenic bacteria, or yeast and oral drug delivery with therapeutic proteins made in plant cells to treat diabetes, obesity and cardiopulmonary diseases currently advanced to human clinical trials are discussed. In addition, high-value industrial enzymes for launching new products or to confer valuable agronomic traits or enhance photosynthesis are discussed. Future perspectives section provides examples of biotechnology products anticipated to be launched in the next 3-5 years, with opportunities and anticipated challenges.

doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.109092.titleZh: 细胞培养中的精细平衡：调配氨基酸与二肽，优化培养基配方及生物制造性能
doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.109092.abstractZh: 随着工业界在强化工艺条件下，以更高细胞密度生产日益复杂的分子，高质量细胞培养基仍然是哺乳动物生物加工的核心。氨基酸是一类关键培养基组分，既是内源蛋白和重组蛋白的构建单元，也是细胞代谢的重要调节因子。因此，氨基酸的供给浓度会对其稳定性和溶解度极限构成挑战。本综述概述氨基酸在细胞培养中的作用，以及如何为培养基配方选择最佳氨基酸水平，重点关注中国仓鼠卵巢（CHO）细胞。文章介绍了组学辅助的培养基开发策略，用于表征氨基酸代谢，并尽量减少由氨基酸降解引起的代谢低效。此外，综述讨论了旨在引入氨基酸营养缺陷或解除代谢瓶颈的遗传工程方法，将其作为改善细胞培养性能的互补策略。在浓缩培养基配方中，理解氨基酸溶解度相关的理化限制变得日益重要。新兴的计算热力学模型能够描述氨基酸与其他培养基组分之间的相互作用，文章强调了其作为预测溶解度极限、指导理性培养基配方设计的有价值工具的作用。由于溶解度、稳定性以及促进工艺表现的性质有所改善，二肽正日益成为颇具吸引力的游离氨基酸替代选择。因此，本综述总结了关键二肽、目前关于其摄取和代谢的认识，以及氨基酸和二肽的转运蛋白与切割酶。最后，综述强调，将实验与建模方法相结合开展智能培养基设计，对于实现高效、稳健且可持续的生物制造过程具有重要意义。
doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.109092.sourceTitle: Cell culture tightrope: Balancing amino acids and dipeptides to optimize media formulation and biomanufacturing performance.
doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.109092.sourceAbstract: High-quality cell culture media remain central to mammalian bioprocessing as industry produces increasingly complex molecules at higher cell densities under intensified processing conditions. Amino acids represent a critical class of media components, serving as building blocks for endogenous and recombinant proteins and also as key regulators of cellular metabolism. This requires delivery of amino acids at concentrations that challenge their stability and solubility limits. This review provides an overview of amino acid roles in cell culture and how to choose their optimal levels in media formulations, with a focus on Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells. Omics-assisted medium development strategies are described to characterize amino acid metabolism and minimize metabolic inefficiencies arising from amino acid degradation. Additionally, genetic engineering approaches aimed at introducing amino acid auxotrophies or removing metabolic bottlenecks are discussed as complementary strategies to improve cell culture performance. Understanding the physicochemical limitations associated with amino acid solubility becomes increasingly important in concentrated media formulations. Emerging in silico thermodynamic models that capture interactions between amino acids and other media components are highlighted as valuable tools for predicting solubility limits and guiding rational media formulation strategies. Dipeptides represent an increasingly attractive alternative to free amino acids due to improved solubility, stability, and process-enhancing properties. Consequently, this review summarizes key dipeptides, current knowledge of their uptake and metabolism, and the amino acid and dipeptide transporters and cleavage enzymes. Finally, the review emphasizes the importance of smart media design by integrating experiments with modeling approaches to enable efficient, robust, and sustainable biomanufacturing processes.

doi:10.64898/2026.10.27.762313.titleZh: 工程化益生菌靶向肉芽肿，用于治疗分枝杆菌感染
doi:10.64898/2026.10.27.762313.abstractZh: 肉芽肿是分枝杆菌的一种病理性生存微环境，常规疗法仍难以到达。本研究表明，益生菌大肠杆菌Nissle 1917（Escherichia coli Nissle 1917，EcN）能够浸润并定植于肉芽肿，还可被改造成感知局部微环境并释放抗分枝杆菌载荷的递送系统。具体而言，研究者利用坏死性肉芽肿的低氧微环境限制细菌生长，并开发了结合细胞内与细胞外杀伤的双模式裂解回路，以实现载荷持续释放，同时限制进化逃逸。研究者进一步改造EcN，使其表达一种来源于分枝杆菌噬菌体的酶，获得的菌株在体外抑制了药物敏感型和耐药型分枝杆菌，并增强了常规抗生素的活性。工程化益生菌还降低了体内分枝杆菌负荷；在利福平耐药感染的小鼠模型中，与pretomanid联合治疗实现的菌量下降幅度大于任一单药治疗。这些结果共同建立了一个利用可编程活微生物靶向肉芽肿性感染的合成生物学框架。
doi:10.64898/2026.10.27.762313.sourceTitle: Engineered probiotics target granulomas to treat mycobacterial infection
doi:10.64898/2026.10.27.762313.sourceAbstract: Granulomas are a pathological niche for mycobacteria that remain difficult to access with conventional therapies. Here we show that probiotic Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 (EcN) infiltrates and colonizes granulomas and can be engineered as a delivery system that senses the local microenvironment and releases antimycobacterial payloads. Specifically, we leveraged the hypoxic microenvironment of necrotic granulomas to restrict bacterial growth, and developed a dual-mode lysis circuit combining intracellular and extracellular killing for sustained payload release with limited evolutionary escape. We further engineered EcN to express a mycobacteriophage-derived enzyme, generating a strain that suppressed drug-sensitive and drug-resistant mycobacteria in vitro and potentiated conventional antibiotic activity. Engineered probiotics also reduced mycobacterial burden in vivo, and in a murine model of rifampicin-resistant infection, combination treatment with pretomanid achieved greater bacterial reduction than either monotherapy. Together, these results establish a synthetic biology framework for targeting granulomatous infections with programmable living microbes.

doi:10.1016/j.stem.2026.10.003.titleZh: 细胞生物学与生物工程交汇处的新方法学：类器官与器官芯片
doi:10.1016/j.stem.2026.10.003.abstractZh: 包括类器官和器官芯片（OOC）在内的新方法学（NAM）的快速发展，凸显了细胞生物学家与生物工程师开展跨学科对话的必要性，以开发最能辅助治疗手段研发的人源模型。干细胞来源及生物工程构建的人体组织模型正在重塑人们对人体生理与病理生理的理解，并提供传统临床前模型所不能实现的可控性。通过再现复杂组织微环境、多器官相互作用及患者个体特异性的生物学特征，这些系统正在弥合药物研发与临床应用流程中长期存在的缺口。本文综合梳理了类器官、器官芯片及其他用于转化医学的生物工程技术的进展，以识别仍然存在的不足，包括可重复性、验证及监管认可方面的挑战。合成生物学、多组学、机器学习与基因工程交叉领域涌现的机遇，正推动新方法学不仅成为改进的实验工具，也成为加快治疗手段发现、支持规模化个体化医疗的基础平台。
doi:10.1016/j.stem.2026.10.003.sourceTitle: Organoids and organs-on-a-chip as new approach methodologies at the convergence of cell biology and bioengineering.
doi:10.1016/j.stem.2026.10.003.sourceAbstract: The rapid growth of new approach methodologies (NAMs), including organoids and organs-on-a-chip (OOCs), has revealed a need for interdisciplinary dialogue between cell biologists and bioengineers to develop human models that can best complement therapeutic development. Stem cell-derived and bioengineered human tissue models are redefining how we understand human physiology and pathophysiology, offering control that traditional preclinical models cannot provide. By recapitulating complex tissue microenvironments, multi-organ interactions, and patient-specific biology, these systems are bridging long-standing gaps in the drug development and clinical application pipelines. Here, we synthesize advances in organoids, OOCs, and other bioengineered technologies for translational medicine to identify remaining gaps, including challenges in reproducibility, validation, and regulatory acceptance. Emerging opportunities at the intersection of synthetic biology, multi-omics, machine learning, and genetic engineering are positioning NAMs not merely as improved experimental tools but as foundational platforms for accelerating therapeutic discovery and enabling personalized medicine at scale.

doi:10.1002/adhm.71906.titleZh: 人工细胞与仿生细胞：推动药物发现和递送范式转变的智能系统
doi:10.1002/adhm.71906.abstractZh: 合成生物学、材料科学与人工智能的融合正推动生物制药研究发生变革，使其从被动药物载体发展为智能、可编程的治疗系统。本综述将人工细胞与仿生细胞作为连接基础生物学发现和临床转化的框架进行评估，并考察了5条关键技术路径：膜工程化人工细胞、无膜细胞器（MLO）系统、多区室人工细胞、原始细胞通讯网络及虚拟细胞。这些平台能够精确调控药物稳定性、靶向性、生物合成及适应性响应能力。近期进展包括微环境触发释放、逻辑门控的细胞间通讯，以及虚拟细胞辅助的高通量筛选和毒性预测。尽管取得这些进展，可规模化制造、长期稳定性及监管适配仍面临挑战。将闭环学习、可解释模型与先进生物制造相整合，将是推动人工细胞与仿生细胞系统走向下一代精准医学前沿的关键。
doi:10.1002/adhm.71906.sourceTitle: Artificial Cells and Biomimetic Cells: Intelligent Systems Driving a Paradigm Shift in Drug Discovery and Delivery.
doi:10.1002/adhm.71906.sourceAbstract: The convergence of synthetic biology, materials science, and artificial intelligence drives a transformative shift in biopharmaceutical research, advancing from passive drug carriers to intelligent, programmable therapeutics. This review evaluates artificial and biomimetic cells as a framework that connects fundamental biological discovery with clinical translation. It examines five key technological pathways: membrane-engineered artificial cells, membraneless organelle (MLO) systems, multicompartmental artificial cells, protocell communication networks, and virtual cells. These platforms enable precise regulation of drug stability, targeting, biosynthesis, and adaptive responsiveness. Recent progress includes microenvironment-triggered release, logic-gated intercellular communication, and virtual cell-assisted high-throughput screening and toxicity prediction. Despite these advances, challenges remain in scalable manufacturing, long-term stability, and regulatory adaptation. The integration of closed-loop learning, interpretable models, and advanced biomanufacturing will be essential to position artificial and biomimetic cell systems at the forefront of next-generation precision medicine.

doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11324733/v1.titleZh: 通过大肠杆菌代谢工程增强L-丝氨酸生物合成
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11324733/v1.abstractZh: 摘要：L-丝氨酸是一种重要的非必需氨基酸，广泛应用于食品、制药、饲料和化妆品行业。然而，以往关于大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）发酵生产L-丝氨酸的研究主要着眼于提高滴度，对转化得率关注不足，限制了其工业生产的经济可行性。本研究开展系统性代谢工程改造，以提高L-丝氨酸得率。以H5为亲本菌株，利用CRISPR/Cas9系统删除与L-丝氨酸再摄取相关的基因sstT和tdcC，获得菌株H8，其L-丝氨酸滴度提高至5.58 g/L，转化得率达到0.37 g/g。随后，分别增强H8中的L-丝氨酸生物合成模块、L-丝氨酸转运模块和辅因子供应模块，获得重组菌株H8-abc、H8-be和H8-pntab。这3株菌的L-丝氨酸滴度分别为6.40、5.89和5.59 g/L，相应得率分别为0.43、0.39和0.37 g/g。进一步将有效策略组合到H8底盘中，获得菌株H8-abc-be，但其L-丝氨酸产量下降。最后，研究者选择H8-abc进行发酵培养基优化。优化后，摇瓶发酵的L-丝氨酸滴度达到7.20 g/L，得率为0.48 g/g，相比起始菌株H5提高71.84%。这些结果为开发用于工业化生产L-丝氨酸的高效大肠杆菌菌株提供了有用参考。
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11324733/v1.sourceTitle: Metabolic engineering of Escherichia coli to enhance L-serine biosynthesis
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11324733/v1.sourceAbstract: Abstract L-serine, an important non-essential amino acid, is widely used in the food, pharmaceutical, feed, and cosmetic industries. However, previous studies on fermentative L-serine production by Escherichia coli have mainly focused on improving titer, whereas insufficient attention has been paid to the conversion yield, limiting its industrial economic feasibility. In this study, systematic metabolic engineering was performed to improve L-serine yield. Using H5 as the parental strain, the L-serine re-uptake-related genes sstT and tdcC were deleted based on the CRISPR/Cas9 system to generate strain H8, in which the L-serine titer increased to 5.58 g/L and the conversion yield reached 0.37 g/g. Subsequently, the L-serine biosynthetic module, L-serine transport module, and cofactor supply module were individually enhanced in H8, resulting in recombinant strains H8- abc , H8- be , and H8- pntab , respectively. The resulting strains H8- abc , H8- be , and H8- pntab produced 6.40, 5.89, and 5.59 g/L L-serine, with yields of 0.43, 0.39, and 0.37 g/g, respectively. Further combination of effective strategies in the H8 chassis generated strain H8- abc-be ; however, its L-serine production decreased. Finally, H8- abc was selected for fermentation medium optimization. After optimization, the L-serine titer reached 7.20 g/L in shake-flask fermentation, with a yield of 0.48 g/g, representing a 71.84% increase compared with the starting strain H5. These results provide a useful reference for the development of efficient E. coli strains for industrial L-serine production.

doi:10.64898/2026.10.26.761776.titleZh: 极端嗜热细菌Anaerocellum bescii的CRISPR-Cas9基因组编辑系统开发
doi:10.64898/2026.10.26.761776.abstractZh:
Anaerocellum bescii（原称Caldicellulosiruptor bescii）是一种极端嗜热的厌氧细菌，最适温度（Topt）为75—78 °C；它还能够高效降解木质纤维素，因此有望成为代谢工程平台。迄今为止，A. bescii的染色体遗传操作需要通过整合型载体介导的同源重组和反向筛选等多步骤程序完成。本研究借助来自Geobacillus stearothermophilus的热稳定Cas9酶（GeoCas9），首次在A. bescii中实现了CRISPR-Cas9基因组编辑。通过可复制载体递送异源CRISPR系统，研究者能够在A. bescii中分别及依次删除乳酸脱氢酶基因（ldh）和pyrE。随后，研究者利用该系统删除一个新的靶标——色氨酸合酶基因（trpBA），获得了A. bescii的色氨酸营养缺陷型菌株。利用这一菌株，研究者表明，trpBA互补可支持对表达异源酶类报告基因的可复制载体进行筛选和维持。

研究意义（Importance）：极端嗜热微生物，尤其是Anaerocellum bescii（原称Caldicellulosiruptor bescii）这类能够天然分解难降解木质纤维素的物种，是颇具吸引力的下一代生物加工底盘，具备将廉价且丰富的可再生原料转化为燃料和工业化学品的能力。然而，要为生物加工应用改造这些非模式生物，需要可靠的遗传工程工具，因为针对中温模式生物开发的技术往往难以直接迁移应用。CRISPR-Cas基因组编辑如今已广泛用于生物技术，但它也是在这些生物天然生长的极端温度下受到限制的工具之一。本研究在A. bescii中建立了基于CRISPR-Cas9的基因组编辑系统，扩充了这种极端嗜热细菌可用的遗传工具箱。通过简化靶向遗传改造，该方法有潜力加快构建用于代谢工程和生物加工应用的工程菌株。
doi:10.64898/2026.10.26.761776.sourceTitle: Development of a CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing system for the extremely thermophilic bacterium Anaerocellum bescii
doi:10.64898/2026.10.26.761776.sourceAbstract: Anaerocellum (f. Caldicellulosiruptor ) bescii is an extremely thermophilic (T opt 75-78 ℃) anaerobic bacterium and is also a highly efficient degrader of lignocellulose, making it a promising platform for metabolic engineering. To date, chromosomal genetic manipulations in A. bescii have required multistep procedures involving homologous recombination with integrating vectors and counterselection. Here, we demonstrate the first implementation of CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing in A. bescii facilitated by a thermostable Cas9 enzyme from Geobacillus stearothermophilus (GeoCas9). Delivery of heterologous CRISPR machinery via a replicating vector enabled us to individually and sequentially delete genes for lactate dehydrogenase ( ldh ) and pyrE in A. bescii . We then deployed this system to delete a novel target, tryptophan synthase ( trpBA ), generating a tryptophan auxotrophic strain of A. bescii . Using this strain, we show trpBA complementation enables selection and maintenance of a replicating vector expressing a heterologous enzymatic reporter gene. Importance Extreme thermophiles, especially species that can naturally break down recalcitrant lignocellulose, such as Anaerocellum (f. Caldicellulosiruptor ) bescii , represent compelling chassis for next-generation bioprocessing, offering the capability to convert inexpensive and plentiful renewable feedstocks into fuels and industrial chemicals. However, engineering these non-model organisms for bioprocessing applications requires robust genetic engineering tools, as techniques developed in mesophilic model organisms often translate poorly. CRISPR-Cas genome editing, now widely used in biotechnology, is one such tool that faces limitations at the extreme native temperatures of these organisms. Here we establish a CRISPR-Cas9-based genome editing system in A. bescii , expanding the genetic toolbox available for this extremely thermophilic bacterium. By streamlining targeted genetic modifications, this approach has the potential to accelerate the construction of engineered strains for metabolic engineering and bioprocess applications.

doi:10.64898/2026.10.28.762476.titleZh: 代谢知识引导的生物反应器模型：将补料分批工艺的知识迁移至连续生物制造
doi:10.64898/2026.10.28.762476.abstractZh: 中国仓鼠卵巢（CHO）细胞仍是单克隆抗体（mAb）制造的主要平台，不断增长的需求正推动该行业从补料分批运行转向连续运行。连续培养有望维持高细胞密度和高体积生产率，但其运行依赖可靠的实时监测、预测与控制。细胞内状态的可观测性有限，细胞外测量又较为稀疏，阻碍了这一目标的实现，使机制认识与预测模型的实际部署之间持续存在差距。本研究提出一种由代谢知识引导的mAb生产模型，将反应器层面和细胞内层面的质量衡算直接嵌入学习架构，同时避免预设动力学速率定律和显式稳态假设。由于守恒关系在不同运行模式下保持不变，这一表述为跨工况泛化提供了基于原理的结构先验，并将模型定位为连续生物过程的软传感器：推断未测量的细胞内通量，并提前一步预测细胞外浓度，以支持过程监测和控制。研究者对两种代谢网络规模与三种代谢优化策略进行了基准比较，发现不同网络规模下的浓度预测结果无可区分的差异。交换通量的保真度与求解器选择无关，网络规模仅影响细胞内过程的可解释性。将所开发的模型从补料分批运行迁移至连续运行时，微调的表现优于其他迁移学习方案。这与代谢结构不随运行模式改变的认识一致。预测通量显示，补料分批培养中的生长速率，而非运行模式，是代谢变化的主导维度；模型还识别出可能提示工况转换的信号，可为连续培养表征的实验设计提供指导。这些结果为构建既充分建立在第一性原理知识之上、又能适应工况转换下部署的数字模型提供了一条路径。
doi:10.64898/2026.10.28.762476.sourceTitle: Metabolism-Informed Bioreactor Model for Transferring Knowledge from Fed-batch to Continuous Biomanufacturing
doi:10.64898/2026.10.28.762476.sourceAbstract: Chinese Hamster Ovary (CHO) cells remain the dominant platform for monoclonal antibody (mAb) manufacturing, and rising demand is pushing the industry from fed-batch toward continuous operation. Continuous cultures promise sustained high cell densities and volumetric productivities, but their operation depends on reliable real-time monitoring, prediction and control. Limited intracellular observability and sparse extracellular measurements hinder this, leaving a persistent gap between mechanistic understanding and predictive deployment. Here we describe a metabolism-informed model for mAb production that embeds reactor- and intracellular-level mass balances directly within a learning architecture, while deliberately avoiding predefined kinetic rate laws and explicit steady-state assumptions. Because conservation relationships remain invariant across operating modes, this formulation provides a principled structural prior for cross-regime generalisation, positioning the model as a soft sensor for continuous bioprocesses: inferring unmeasured intracellular fluxes and one-step ahead forecasting extracellular concentrations to support process monitoring and control. Benchmarking two metabolic network sizes and three metabolic optimisation strategies, concentration predictions are indistinguishable across network sizes. Exchange flux fidelity is agnostic to solver choice, with network size mattering only for intracellular interpretability. Transferring the developed model from fed-batch to continuous operation with fine-tuning outperforming other transfer learning variants. This is consistent with the metabolic structure being invariant to mode of operation. Predicted fluxes reveal growth rate in fed-batch, rather than operating mode, as the dominant axis of metabolic variation, and identify potential regime-shift signals to guide experimental design for continuous culture characterisation. These results chart a route towards digital models sufficiently grounded in first-principles knowledge, yet adaptive for deployment under regime shifts.

version:doi:10.1016/j.ijbiomac.2026.1550.titleZh: 曲霉属转糖苷酶及其在食品加工中的应用：酶挖掘与智能生物催化进展
version:doi:10.1016/j.ijbiomac.2026.1550.abstractZh: 转糖苷酶（TGs）属于糖苷水解酶家族，可通过分子内或分子间取代完成糖基转移。黑曲霉、米曲霉及其他曲霉菌株是工业转糖苷酶的主要来源，这类酶广泛应用于食品加工。不过，酶性能优化、工业适应及协同催化体系构建仍受到明显瓶颈制约。本综述阐述曲霉来源转糖苷酶在食品加工中的应用潜力，分析利用人工智能调控酶催化性能的科学依据，系统总结分子改造和多酶协同机制，并介绍其在益生元低聚糖、乳制品、酿造和烘焙等领域的应用效果。文章进一步讨论人工智能与食品生物制造的融合，以及绿色功能食品加工、智能生物加工和大健康食品研究的发展前景。
version:doi:10.1016/j.ijbiomac.2026.1550.sourceTitle: Transglycosidases from aspergillus genus and their applications in food processing: Advances in enzyme mining and smart biocatalysis.
version:doi:10.1016/j.ijbiomac.2026.1550.sourceAbstract: Transglycosidases (TGs) constitute a family of glycoside hydrolases that perform glycosyl transfer via intra- and intermolecular substitution. A. niger, A. oryzae, and other Aspergillus strains represent the major industrial sources of TGs, which are widely applied in food processing. However, prominent bottlenecks still restrict the optimization of enzyme performance, industrial adaptation, and the construction of synergistic catalytic systems. This comprehensive review expounds the application potential of Aspergillus-derived TGs in food processing, analyzes the scientific basis of artificial intelligence (AI) regulation on enzyme catalytic performance, systematically summarizes the molecular modification and multi-enzyme synergistic mechanisms, and illustrates their application effects in the fields of prebiotic oligosaccharides, dairy products, brewing, and baking. Furthermore, it promotes the in-depth integration of AI and food biomanufacturing, and advances the high-quality development of the green functional food processing industry, showing sustainable and bright prospects in smart bioprocessing and big-health food research.

version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.titleZh: 基于无细胞代谢工程构建异戊烯醇利用途径及其在多酶级联合成中的应用
version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.abstractZh: 传统类异戊二烯微生物合成途径通常需要复杂的代谢平衡和多基因调控，既耗时，又容易受到宿主代谢及有毒中间体或终产物反馈抑制的影响。本研究建立了用于合成代表性类异戊二烯化合物番茄红素的新型无细胞多酶催化体系。通过整合异戊烯醇利用途径与无细胞代谢工程，体系无需复杂的体内遗传改造，也避免了固有细胞代谢干扰。体外反应直接使用7种酶，无需依赖昂贵的异戊烯基焦磷酸（IPP）和二甲基烯丙基焦磷酸（DMAPP）。优化反应体系为：isoprenol（3-甲基-3-丁烯-1-醇）与 prenol（3-甲基-2-丁烯-1-醇）（摩尔比3:1，15 mM）、7种关键酶（各0.6 mg/mL）、8 mM Mg²⁺、1 mM NAD、1 mM ATP、1 mM CoA及0.05%（w/v）Tween 20，溶于30 mM Bis-Tris缓冲液（pH 6.5）。在30°C孵育20小时后，番茄红素滴度达到128.04 mg/L；后续体内验证获得270.0 mg/L的终滴度。作者认为，这为克服复杂天然类异戊二烯途径构建和调控中的问题提供了替代策略。
version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.sourceTitle: Development of isopentenol utilization pathway based on cell-free metabolic engineering and its application in multienzyme cascades synthesis.
version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.sourceAbstract: Conventional microbial biosynthetic pathways for isoprenoid often require intricate metabolic balancing and multigene regulation, which are not only time-consuming but also prone to interference from host cellular metabolism and feedback inhibition by toxic intermediate metabolites or end-products. In this study, we developed a novel cell-free multienzyme catalytic system for the synthesis of lycopene, a representative isoprenoid. By integrating the isopentenol utilization pathway with cell-free metabolic engineering strategies, the system eliminates the need for complex in vivo genetic modifications and avoids inherent cellular metabolic interference. The in vitro reaction employs seven enzymes directly, enabling rapid and efficient lycopene production without relying on costly substrates isopentenyl pyrophosphate (IPP) and dimethylallyl pyrophosphate (DMAPP). The optimized cell-free reaction mixture consisted of isoprenol and prenol (3:1 molar ratio, 15mM), seven key enzymes (each at a concentration of 0.6mg/mL), 8mM Mg 2+ , 1mM NAD, 1mM ATP, 1mM CoA, and 0.05% (w/v) Tween 20 in 30mM Bis-Tris buffer (pH 6.5). After incubation at 30 °C for 20hours, the lycopene titer reached 128.04mg/L. Further in vivo validation achieved a final lycopene titer of 270.0mg/L. This novel approach offers a promising alternative strategy to overcome common challenges associated with the construction and regulation of complex natural isoprenoid biosynthetic pathways.

version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.titleZh: 通过多层次代谢工程提高解淀粉芽孢杆菌的 L-酪氨酸产量
version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.abstractZh: L-酪氨酸是一种具有多种应用的高价值芳香族氨基酸。尽管基于质粒的过表达显著提高了 L-酪氨酸产量，但对抗生素筛选的依赖，以及非选择性条件下的遗传不稳定性，限制了其工业适用性。为解决这些问题，本研究采用多层次代谢工程策略，在解淀粉芽孢杆菌（Bacillus amyloliquefaciens）的基因组水平增强 L-酪氨酸生物合成途径。首先，将含有突变型预苯酸脱氢酶（TyrAI309A/E330V）的表达盒插入野生型菌株 Z1 的基因组。当拷贝数达到3个时，所得菌株 Z4 的 L-酪氨酸滴度达到437.43 mg/L。随后整合突变型 DAHP 合酶（AroAR27A/K38A），所得双拷贝菌株 Z7 的 L-酪氨酸滴度提高至591.29 mg/L。对限速步骤的系统性鉴定表明，大多数途径基因均能不同程度地提高产量。研究者进一步采用启动子原位替换策略构建菌株 Z21，使滴度提高至813.01 mg/L。最后，通过优化前体供应，工程菌株 Z32 的 L-酪氨酸滴度达到1079.94 mg/L。总体而言，这一无质粒、不依赖抗生素的平台，为微生物细胞工厂稳定合成 L-酪氨酸及其他芳香族氨基酸提供了有前景的策略。
version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.sourceTitle: Multilevel metabolic engineering of Bacillus amyloliquefaciens for enhanced L-tyrosine production.
version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.sourceAbstract: L-Tyrosine is a valuable aromatic amino acid with diverse applications. Although plasmid-based overexpression has markedly improved L-tyrosine production, the dependence on antibiotic selection and genetic instability under nonselective conditions limits its industrial applicability. To address these issues, this study employed a multi-level metabolic engineering strategy to enhance the L-tyrosine biosynthetic pathway at the genomic level in Bacillus amyloliquefaciens. First, an expression cassette containing the mutant prephenate dehydrogenase (TyrAI309A/E330V) was inserted into the genome of the wild-type strain Z1. When the copy number reached three (strain Z4), L-tyrosine production reached 437.43mg/L. Subsequently, the mutant DAHP synthase (AroAR27A/K38A) was integrated, and the resulting two-copy strain Z7 increased L-tyrosine production to 591.29mg/L. Systematic identification of rate-limiting steps showed that most pathway genes enhanced production to varying extents. A promoter in situ replacement strategy was then applied to construct strain Z21, which further increased the titer to 813.01mg/L. Finally, by optimizing precursor supply, the engineered strain Z32 reached an L-tyrosine titer of 1079.94mg/L. Overall, this plasmid-free and antibiotic-independent platform offers a promising strategy for stable biosynthesis of L-tyrosine and other aromatic amino acids in microbial cell factories.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.21.760811:2.titleZh: 通过代谢工程提高解脂耶氏酵母的脂肪醇产量
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.21.760811:2.abstractZh: 脂肪醇是多种行业需求不断增长的通用化学品，但传统生产方式带来环境问题。如果能通过宿主工程实现高滴度，微生物合成可成为有前景的替代方案。具有工业应用价值的产油酵母解脂耶氏酵母具备天然脂质代谢能力，适合承担这一任务。本研究改造 Yarrowia lipolytica W29，通过破坏脂质合成及脂肪醇氧化相关途径，确定脂肪醇氧化是限制产物积累的主要因素。初步改造后，以40 g/L葡萄糖为底物，脂肪醇滴度达到2.5 g/L。随后优化培养基添加物和营养浓度，同时删除柠檬酸转运蛋白基因 CEX1，并在萃取培养基中加入1% Tergitol，使摇瓶培养在80 g/L葡萄糖、碳氮比60的条件下达到10.9 g/L。放大至补料分批生物反应器后，滴度进一步提高至19.4 g/L。这些结果表明，将代谢工程与培养基及工艺优化相结合，可实现解脂耶氏酵母的高滴度脂肪醇生产。
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.21.760811:2.sourceTitle: Metabolic engineering of Yarrowia lipolytica for higher fatty alcohol production
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.21.760811:2.sourceAbstract: Fatty alcohols are versatile chemicals with growing demand across a broad range of industries, yet conventional production methods pose environmental challenges. Microbial biosynthesis offers a promising alternative, if hosts can be engineered to achieve high product titers. The industrially relevant oleaginous yeast Yarrowia lipolytica is well suited to this challenge because of its natural capacity for lipid metabolism. Here, we engineered Y. lipolytica W29 for fatty alcohol production by disrupting pathways involved in lipogenesis and fatty alcohol oxidation, identifying fatty alcohol oxidation as a major constraint on product accumulation. Initial engineering yielded fatty alcohol titers of 2.5 g/L from 40 g/L glucose. Subsequent optimization of media supplements and nutrient concentrations, combined with deletion of the citrate transporter CEX1 and addition of 1% Tergitol to the extractive culture medium, increased titers to 10.9 g/L in shake flasks with 80 g/L glucose and a carbon-to-nitrogen ratio of 60. Scaling the process to fed-batch bioreactor cultivation further increased titers to 19.4 g/L. These results demonstrate that combining metabolic engineering with medium and process optimization enables high-titer fatty alcohol production in Y. lipolytica.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.28.762476:f.titleZh: 代谢知识引导的生物反应器模型：将补料分批工艺的知识迁移至连续生物制造
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.28.762476:f.abstractZh: 中国仓鼠卵巢（CHO）细胞仍是单克隆抗体（mAb）制造的主要平台，不断增长的需求正推动该行业从补料分批运行转向连续运行。连续培养有望维持高细胞密度和高体积生产率，但其运行依赖可靠的实时监测、预测与控制。细胞内状态的可观测性有限，细胞外测量又较为稀疏，阻碍了这一目标的实现，使机制认识与预测模型的实际部署之间持续存在差距。本研究提出一种由代谢知识引导的mAb生产模型，将反应器层面和细胞内层面的质量衡算直接嵌入学习架构，同时避免预设动力学速率定律和显式稳态假设。由于守恒关系在不同运行模式下保持不变，这一表述为跨工况泛化提供了基于原理的结构先验，并将模型定位为连续生物过程的软传感器：推断未测量的细胞内通量，并提前一步预测细胞外浓度，以支持过程监测和控制。研究者对两种代谢网络规模与三种代谢优化策略进行了基准比较，发现不同网络规模下的浓度预测结果无可区分的差异。交换通量的保真度与求解器选择无关，网络规模仅影响细胞内过程的可解释性。将所开发的模型从补料分批运行迁移至连续运行时，微调的表现优于其他迁移学习方案。这与代谢结构不随运行模式改变的认识一致。预测通量显示，补料分批培养中的生长速率，而非运行模式，是代谢变化的主导维度；模型还识别出可能提示工况转换的信号，可为连续培养表征的实验设计提供指导。这些结果为构建既充分建立在第一性原理知识之上、又能适应工况转换下部署的数字模型提供了一条路径。
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.28.762476:f.sourceTitle: Metabolism-Informed Bioreactor Model for Transferring Knowledge from Fed-batch to Continuous Biomanufacturing
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.28.762476:f.sourceAbstract: Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells remain the dominant platform for monoclonal antibody (mAb) manufacturing, and rising demand is pushing the industry from fed-batch toward continuous operation. Continuous cultures promise sustained high cell densities and volumetric productivities, but their operation depends on reliable real-time monitoring, prediction and control. Limited intracellular observability and sparse extracellular measurements hinder this, leaving a persistent gap between mechanistic understanding and predictive deployment. Here we describe a metabolism-informed model for mAb production that embeds reactor- and intracellular-level mass balances directly within a learning architecture, while deliberately avoiding predefined kinetic rate laws and explicit steady-state assumptions. Because conservation relationships remain invariant across operating modes, this formulation provides a principled structural prior for cross-regime generalisation, positioning the model as a soft sensor for continuous bioprocesses: inferring unmeasured intracellular fluxes and one-step ahead forecasting extracellular concentrations to support process monitoring and control. Benchmarking two metabolic network sizes and three metabolic optimisation strategies, concentration predictions are indistinguishable across network sizes. Exchange flux fidelity is agnostic to solver choice, with network size mattering only for intracellular interpretability. Transferring the developed model from fed-batch to continuous operation with fine-tuning outperforming other transfer learning variants. This is consistent with the metabolic structure being invariant to mode of operation. Predicted fluxes reveal growth rate in fed-batch, rather than operating mode, as the dominant axis of metabolic variation, and identify potential regime-shift signals to guide experimental design for continuous culture characterisation. These results chart a route towards digital models sufficiently grounded in first-principles knowledge, yet adaptive for deployment under regime shifts.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.25.761636:c.titleZh: 遗传控制将不依赖TGFβ的多能干细胞自我更新与跨胚层的确定性正向编程相耦合
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.25.761636:c.abstractZh: 要可重复、可规模化地制造人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）衍生细胞，需要控制其扩增与分化。转录因子介导的正向编程可使hiPSC分化受到遗传控制，但扩增仍依赖外源补充生长因子，从而增加工艺复杂性及对操作者的依赖。本研究提出GERALT，即遗传增强的自我更新与自主谱系转分化（Genetically Enhanced Renewal and Autonomous Lineage Transdifferentiation）。这是一种通过靶向安全港位点整合而组装的推拉式基因回路，将由NANOG支持、不依赖TGFβ的自我更新，与多西环素诱导的谱系编程及同步发生的NANOG沉默相耦合。在长时间撤除TGFβ的条件下，GERALT在贴壁培养与悬浮培养中均能维持多能性，同时仍可被编程为肌源性、神经元及肝细胞命运。在肌生成方面，与已建立的OPTi-OX平台相比，GERALT能够在简化培养基中实现分化，同时使命运决定过程更加定向并加快这一过程。GERALT还支持在悬浮培养中直接进行肌源性编程，并能将hiPSC直接浇注到水凝胶中，随后在组织内进行编程，获得能够对电刺激作出反应的工程化肌肉组织。这些结果将遗传控制向上游延伸至干细胞自我更新，有助于新方法学（new approach methodologies）及其他生物制造应用的实施。
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.25.761636:c.sourceTitle: Genetic control couples TGFβ-independent pluripotent stem cell renewal to deterministic forward programming across germ layers
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.25.761636:c.sourceAbstract: Reproducible and scalable manufacture of human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC) derivatives requires control over expansion and differentiation. Transcription factor-mediated forward programming can place hiPSC differentiation under genetic control, but expansion still relies on extracellular growth-factor supplementation, increasing process complexity and operator dependence. Here we introduce GERALT (Genetically Enhanced Renewal and Autonomous Lineage Transdifferentiation), a push-pull genetic circuit assembled through targeted safe-harbour integration that couples NANOG-supported, TGFβ-independent renewal to doxycycline-inducible lineage programming and simultaneous NANOG silencing. GERALT maintained pluripotency during extended TGFβ withdrawal in both adherent and suspension culture, yet remained programmable towards myogenic, neuronal, and hepatic fates. Compared with the established OPTi-OX platform in myogenesis, GERALT enabled differentiation in simplified medium while canalising and accelerating commitment. GERALT also supported direct myogenic programming in suspension and enabled direct casting of hiPSCs into hydrogel followed by in-tissue programming, yielding electrically responsive engineered muscle tissues. These results extend genetic control upstream into stem cell renewal, facilitating deployment of new approach methodologies and other biomanufacturing applications.

version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.titleZh: 以多层次代谢工程提高解淀粉芽孢杆菌的L-酪氨酸产量
version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.abstractZh: L-酪氨酸是一种用途广泛的高价值芳香族氨基酸。虽然基于质粒的过表达已经明显提高了L-酪氨酸产量，但依赖抗生素筛选，以及在非选择性条件下存在遗传不稳定性，限制了其工业应用。为解决这些问题，本研究采用多层次代谢工程策略，在解淀粉芽孢杆菌（Bacillus amyloliquefaciens）的基因组层面增强L-酪氨酸生物合成途径。首先，将含有突变型预苯酸脱氢酶TyrA（I309A/E330V）的表达盒插入野生型菌株Z1的基因组。当拷贝数达到3个时，所得菌株Z4的L-酪氨酸滴度达到437.43 mg/L。随后整合突变型DAHP合酶AroA（R27A/K38A），所得双拷贝菌株Z7的L-酪氨酸滴度提高至591.29 mg/L。对限速步骤的系统性辨识表明，大多数途径基因都能不同程度地提高产量。接着，研究者通过启动子原位替换构建菌株Z21，使滴度进一步提高到813.01 mg/L。最后，通过优化前体供应，工程菌株Z32的L-酪氨酸滴度达到1079.94 mg/L。总体而言，这一无质粒、不依赖抗生素的平台，为微生物细胞工厂稳定生物合成L-酪氨酸及其他芳香族氨基酸提供了一种有前景的策略。
version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.sourceTitle: Multilevel metabolic engineering of Bacillus amyloliquefaciens for enhanced L-tyrosine production.
version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.sourceAbstract: L-Tyrosine is a valuable aromatic amino acid with diverse applications. Although plasmid-based overexpression has markedly improved L-tyrosine production, the dependence on antibiotic selection and genetic instability under nonselective conditions limits its industrial applicability. To address these issues, this study employed a multi-level metabolic engineering strategy to enhance the L-tyrosine biosynthetic pathway at the genomic level in Bacillus amyloliquefaciens. First, an expression cassette containing the mutant prephenate dehydrogenase (TyrA I309A/E330V ) was inserted into the genome of the wild-type strain Z1. When the copy number reached three (strain Z4), L-tyrosine production reached 437.43mg/L. Subsequently, the mutant DAHP synthase (AroA R27A/K38A ) was integrated, and the resulting two-copy strain Z7 increased L-tyrosine production to 591.29mg/L. Systematic identification of rate-limiting steps showed that most pathway genes enhanced production to varying extents. A promoter in situ replacement strategy was then applied to construct strain Z21, which further increased the titer to 813.01mg/L. Finally, by optimizing precursor supply, the engineered strain Z32 reached an L-tyrosine titer of 1079.94mg/L. Overall, this plasmid-free and antibiotic-independent platform offers a promising strategy for stable biosynthesis of L-tyrosine and other aromatic amino acids in microbial cell factories.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.26.761776:b.titleZh: 极端嗜热细菌Anaerocellum bescii的CRISPR-Cas9基因组编辑系统开发
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.26.761776:b.abstractZh: Anaerocellum bescii（原称Caldicellulosiruptor bescii）是一种极端嗜热的厌氧细菌，最适温度（Topt）为75—78 °C；它还能够高效降解木质纤维素，因此有望成为代谢工程平台。迄今为止，A. bescii的染色体遗传操作需要通过整合型载体介导的同源重组和反向筛选等多步骤程序完成。本研究借助来自Geobacillus stearothermophilus的热稳定Cas9酶（GeoCas9），首次在A. bescii中实现了CRISPR-Cas9基因组编辑。通过可复制载体递送异源CRISPR系统，研究者能够在A. bescii中分别及依次删除乳酸脱氢酶基因（ldh）和pyrE。随后，研究者利用该系统删除一个新的靶标——色氨酸合酶基因（trpBA），获得了A. bescii的色氨酸营养缺陷型菌株。利用这一菌株，研究者表明，trpBA互补可支持对表达异源酶类报告基因的可复制载体进行筛选和维持。
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.26.761776:b.sourceTitle: Development of a CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing system for the extremely thermophilic bacterium Anaerocellum bescii
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.26.761776:b.sourceAbstract: Anaerocellum (f. Caldicellulosiruptor) bescii is an extremely thermophilic (Topt 75-78 °C) anaerobic bacterium and is also a highly efficient degrader of lignocellulose, making it a promising platform for metabolic engineering. To date, chromosomal genetic manipulations in A. bescii have required multistep procedures involving homologous recombination with integrating vectors and counterselection. Here, we demonstrate the first implementation of CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing in A. bescii facilitated by a thermostable Cas9 enzyme from Geobacillus stearothermophilus (GeoCas9). Delivery of heterologous CRISPR machinery via a replicating vector enabled us to individually and sequentially delete genes for lactate dehydrogenase (ldh) and pyrE in A. bescii. We then deployed this system to delete a novel target, tryptophan synthase (trpBA), generating a tryptophan auxotrophic strain of A. bescii. Using this strain, we show trpBA complementation enables selection and maintenance of a replicating vector expressing a heterologous enzymatic reporter gene.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761364:6.titleZh: 比较多组学揭示酵母源细胞外囊泡中保守的膜结构与代谢活性载荷的选择性富集
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761364:6.abstractZh: 细胞外囊泡（EV）是各生命界细胞间通讯的基本介质，但我们对其生物学的认识主要来自哺乳动物系统。相比之下，尽管酵母源细胞外囊泡（YDEV）有潜力成为可规模化、非致病性的生物技术与代谢工程平台，其特征仍缺乏充分研究。本研究将高产量分离流程与比较多组学相结合，界定了来自3个酵母物种、4个菌株的细胞外囊泡中的代谢活性载荷与膜组成：传统模式酵母酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae，SC）、非模式产油酵母 Rhodotorula toruloides（RT-88），以及解脂耶氏酵母（Yarrowia lipolytica）的野生型W29及其工程化衍生菌株Po1f。研究者采用切向流过滤结合超速离心，可重复地从所有菌株中分离出完整、由双层膜包裹的囊泡。尽管各菌株的囊泡产量存在显著差异，这些囊泡仍具有保守的纳米尺度形态。比较代谢组学揭示了不同代谢活性载荷的选择性富集，包括SC中的核苷酸代谢物、RT-88中的脂肪酸与酰基肉碱，以及解脂耶氏酵母菌株中特有的代谢物。值得注意的是，烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD⁺）在SC和RT-88的细胞外囊泡中富集，但在解脂耶氏酵母来源的囊泡中几乎不存在。这提示一种可能性：囊泡包封或可为这种本身不能透过膜的辅因子提供受保护的运输。与载荷组成的差异形成对照，比较脂质组学表明，所有菌株的囊泡膜结构总体保守，仅特定脂质类别及膜不饱和度谱发生定量层面的重塑。综合而言，这些发现支持这样一种组织原则：酵母源细胞外囊泡在维持保守膜结构的同时，选择性富集具有代谢活性的载荷，由此建立了一个比较框架，用于理解进化上具有多样性的酵母物种中的细胞外囊泡生物学。
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761364:6.sourceTitle: Comparative Multi-omics Reveals Conserved Membrane Architecture and Selective Metabolic Cargo Enrichment Across Yeast-Derived Extracellular Vesicles
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761364:6.sourceAbstract: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are fundamental mediators of intercellular communication across all kingdoms of life, yet our understanding of EV biology has been derived predominantly from mammalian systems. In contrast, yeast-derived extracellular vesicles (YDEVs) remain poorly characterized despite their potential as scalable, non-pathogenic platforms for biotechnology and metabolic engineering. Here, we combined a high-yield isolation workflow with comparative multi-omics to define the metabolically active cargo and membrane composition of EVs derived from three yeast species and four strains: the conventional model yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae (SC), the non-model oleaginous yeast Rhodotorula toruloides (RT-88), and two Yarrowia lipolytica strains, wild-type W29 and its engineered derivative Po1f. Using tangential flow filtration coupled with ultracentrifugation, we reproducibly isolated intact, bilayer-enclosed vesicles with conserved nanoscale morphology across all strains despite marked differences in EV yield. Comparative metabolomics revealed selective enrichment of distinct metabolically active cargo, including nucleotide metabolites in SC, fatty acids and acyl-carnitines in RT-88, and strain-specific metabolites within the Yarrowia isolates. Notably, nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD⁺) was enriched in SC and RT-88 EVs but was nearly absent from Yarrowia-derived vesicles, raising the possibility that EV encapsulation may facilitate protected transport of this otherwise membrane-impermeable cofactor. In contrast to these differences in cargo composition, comparative lipidomics demonstrated a broadly conserved membrane architecture across all strains, with only quantitative remodeling of specific lipid classes and membrane unsaturation profiles. Together, these findings support an organizational principle in which yeast-derived extracellular vesicles preserve a conserved membrane architecture while selectively enriching metabolically active cargo, establishing a comparative framework for understanding EV biology across evolutionarily diverse yeast species.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.10.765708:b.titleZh: 皂苷佐剂QS-21与QS-7对人THP-1巨噬细胞的差异性及协同免疫调节作用
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.10.765708:b.abstractZh: QS-21是从Quillaja saponaria衍生的三萜糖苷皂苷，是几种已获FDA批准疫苗中强效的免疫刺激佐剂。QS-7是一种结构相关的皂苷组分，据报道具有保留免疫调节活性但溶血毒性降低的特点；然而，其较低的自然丰度限制了其系统的免疫学表征。为填补这一空白，我们在THP-1人巨噬细胞模型中系统比较了对QS-21和QS-7的反应，以阐明它们对抗原呈递细胞（APC）激活的独特和协同贡献。在进行细胞毒性分析以确定安全且具生物学相关性的剂量后，使用流式细胞术、蛋白质组学和转录组学来描绘每种皂苷单独及联合使用时所涉及的免疫程序。QS-7单独给药仅引起细胞表面激活标志物的轻微上调，未引发显著的转录特征，但它驱动了剂量依赖性的多种促炎细胞因子和趋化因子的分泌，揭示了巨噬细胞激活这两个方面的解离。令人惊讶的是，QS-7与QS-21联合施用显著增强了在所有受测指标上的巨噬细胞激活，放大了表面标志物上调，将细胞因子和趋化因子输出扩大至包括IL-12p70和IFN-γ，并显著扩展了由QS-21诱导的促炎转录和通路景观，同时抑制了限制炎症输出的反向调节脂质感应通路（PPAR、RAR、FXR/RXR）。综上所述，这些发现确立了QS-7不仅仅是QS-21的减弱类似物，而是一种功能不同的免疫调节剂，它重新校准了QS-21驱动的巨噬细胞激活的强度和调节基调。这些发现表明，结构不同的皂苷引发独特且互补的巨噬细胞反应，为结构-功能研究提供了基础。结合合成生物学和数据驱动设计，这些知识可以指导自然界原本不存在的新型皂苷佐剂的开发。
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.10.765708:b.sourceTitle: Differential and Cooperative Immunomodulation by Saponin Adjuvants QS-21 and QS-7 in Human THP-1 Macrophages
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.10.765708:b.sourceAbstract: QS-21, a triterpene glycoside saponin derived from Quillaja saponaria, is a potent immunostimulatory adjuvant incorporated in several FDA-approved vaccines. QS-7, a structurally related saponin fraction, has been reported to retain immunomodulatory activity with reduced hemolytic toxicity; however, its lower natural abundance has limited its systematic immunological characterization. To address this gap, we systematically compare responses to QS-21 and QS-7 in the THP-1 human macrophage model to resolve their distinct and cooperative contributions to antigen presenting cell (APC) activation. Following cytotoxicity profiling to establish safe and biologically relevant dosing, flow cytometry, proteomics, and transcriptomics were used to delineate the immunological programs engaged by each saponin alone and in combination. QS-7 alone induced minimal upregulation of cell surface activation markers and did not elicit a significant transcriptional signature, yet it drove dose-dependent secretion of a broad panel of pro-inflammatory cytokines and chemokines, revealing a dissociation between these two arms of macrophage activation. Strikingly, co-administration of QS-7 with QS-21 substantially potentiated macrophage activation across all parameters tested, amplifying surface marker upregulation, broadening cytokine and chemokine output to include IL-12p70 and IFN-γ, and markedly expanding the pro-inflammatory transcriptional and pathway landscape induced by QS-21, while concurrently suppressing counter-regulatory lipid-sensing pathways (PPAR, RAR, FXR/RXR) that constrain inflammatory output. Collectively, these findings establish QS-7 not merely as an attenuated analog of QS-21, but as a functionally distinct immunomodulator that recalibrates both the magnitude and regulatory tone of QS-21-driven macrophage activation. These findings show that structurally distinct saponins elicit distinct and complementary macrophage responses, providing a foundation for structure-function studies. Together with synthetic biology and data-driven design, this knowledge can guide the development of new-to-nature saponin adjuvants.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.10.765548:c.titleZh: 将环境生物传感器耦合到土壤细菌的反相器电路中
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.10.765548:c.abstractZh: 基因逻辑门（如反相NOT功能）通常是为一组狭窄的实验室标准化学输入而设计和优化的。这种依赖性限制了它们在现实世界应用中的实用性，因为工程化底盘必须应对复杂且特定于生态位的信号。聚焦于环境合成生物学，我们设计了四种对生态相关物理和化学输入（铁、氧气、温度和光）有响应的生物传感器，并系统地将其与三种基于阻遏蛋白的NOT逻辑门（QacR、SrpR和LitR）耦合，以生成12个复合传感器-门电路。为了评估跨宿主鲁棒性，所有构建体均在两种非模式土壤细菌：假单胞菌 KT2440 (Pseudomonas putida KT2440) 和假单胞菌 Pf-5 (Pseudomonas protegens Pf-5) 中进行了基准测试。我们的发现表明，整体电路性能是非加性的，不能简单地通过累加单个传感器和门的动力学来预测。虽然独立的生物传感器可靠地检测到其特异性输入，但跨越调控连接处的串联引入了非线性、涌现动力学和宿主依赖性效应，导致几种配对出乎意料地偏离了其预测行为。此外，宿主背景直接控制逻辑执行：P. protegens Pf-5 表现出优越的整体电路处理能力，而特定配置（如铁响应门）在 P. putida KT2440 中表现更好。所有12个构建体均使用标准欧洲载体架构 (SEVA) 格式模块化集成，提供了一个经过基准测试的工具包，用于在现实环境中编程复杂的信息处理。

question.text: 如何设计对环境物理和化学输入有响应的生物传感器，并将其与逻辑门耦合以在土壤细菌中实现稳健的逻辑运算？
