version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.10.765548:c.sourceTitle: Coupling environmental biosensors to inverter circuits in soil bacteria
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.10.765548:c.sourceAbstract: Genetic logic gates, such as inverting NOT functions, are routinely designed and optimised for a narrow set of laboratory-standard chemical inputs. This reliance limits their utility in real-world applications, where engineered chassis must navigate complex, niche-specific signals. Focusing on environmental synthetic biology, we engineered four biosensors responsive to ecologically relevant physical and chemical inputs (iron, oxygen, temperature, and light) and systematically coupled them to three repressor-based NOT logic gates (QacR, SrpR, and LitR) to generate 12 composite sensor-gate circuits. To evaluate cross-host robustness, all constructs were benchmarked in two non-model soil bacteria: Pseudomonas putida KT2440 and Pseudomonas protegens Pf-5. Our findings demonstrate that overall circuit performance is non-additive and cannot be predicted simply by summing individual sensor and gate dynamics. While standalone biosensors reliably detected their cognate inputs, concatenation across regulatory junctions introduced non-linearities, emergent dynamics, and host-dependent effects that caused several pairings to deviate unexpectedly from their predicted behaviour. Furthermore, host context directly governed logic execution: P. protegens Pf-5 exhibited superior overall circuit-processing capacity, whereas specific configurations, such as iron-responsive gates, performed better in P. putida KT2440. All 12 constructs are modularly integrated using the Standard European Vector Architecture (SEVA) format, providing a benchmarked toolkit to program complex information processing in real-world environments.

version:doi:10.1016/j.ijbiomac.2026.1552.titleZh: Fe(II)/2-氧代戊二酸依赖性双加氧酶双功能催化涉及连续末端碳氧化以形成吡咯烷酮生物碱的环结构
version:doi:10.1016/j.ijbiomac.2026.1552.abstractZh: Fe(II)/2-氧代戊二酸依赖性双加氧酶UcsF在抗菌和抗肿瘤吡咯烷酮生物碱UCS1025A的早期生物合成中发挥关键作用，参与其核心环骨架的形成。UcsF催化L-异亮氨酸末端C5的连续氧化，最终生成五元环产物(2S,3S)-3,4-二氢-3-甲基-2H-吡咯-2-羧酸。这一催化过程对于天然产物骨架的构建和合成生物学至关重要。然而，UcsF的分子基础及其独特的两步催化机制仍知之甚少。我们表征了UcsF的催化功能，测定了其晶体结构，并结合分子对接和MD模拟揭示了底物识别的分子基础，同时采用量子化学计算研究反应状态模型，以探究连续氧化背后的可能反应途径。UcsF对2-氨基羧酸底物表现出催化活性。UcsF的晶体结构具有独特的开放活性口袋，底物结合由多个结构模块的集体贡献所定义。在催化反应中，Fe(IV)=O物种从L-异亮氨酸的C5位置夺取一个氢原子，随后发生羟基回弹完成第一步羟基化。综合动力学、溶剂同位素效应、突变和计算分析支持一种优选的Asp279'促进的PCET途径，用于将5-OH-Ile氧化为醛产物的第二步氧化。我们的研究为理解Fe(II)/2-氧代戊二酸依赖性双加氧酶结构与功能的关系提供了分子基础，并揭示了UcsF催化能力在生物合成中的潜力。
version:doi:10.1016/j.ijbiomac.2026.1552.sourceTitle: Fe(II)/2-oxoglutarate-dependent dioxygenase bifunctionally catalyzes ring formation involving sequential terminal carbon oxidation for pyrrolizidinone alkaloid biosynthesis.
version:doi:10.1016/j.ijbiomac.2026.1552.sourceAbstract: The Fe(II)/2-oxoglutarate-dependent dioxygenase UcsF plays a key role in the early biosynthesis of UCS1025A, an antibacterial and antitumor pyrrolizidinone alkaloid, by participating in the formation of its core ring scaffold. UcsF catalyzes sequential oxidation of the terminal C5 of L-isoleucine, ultimately generating a five-membered ring product, (2S,3S)-3,4-dihydro-3-methyl-2H-pyrrole-2-carboxylic acid. This catalytic process is vital in the construction of natural product skeletons and synthetic biology. However, the molecular basis of UcsF and its unique two-step catalytic mechanism remain poorly understood. We characterized the catalytic function of UcsF, determined its crystal structure and combined molecular docking and MD simulations to reveal the molecular basis for substrate recognition, and employed quantum chemical calculations on reaction-state models to investigate plausible reaction pathways underlying the sequential oxidation. UcsF exhibits catalytic activity toward 2-amino carboxylic acid substrates. The crystal structure of UcsF features a unique open active pocket, with substrate binding defined by the collective contributions of multiple structural modules. In the catalytic reaction, the Fe(IV) = O species abstracts a hydrogen atom from the C5 position of L-isoleucine, followed by hydroxyl rebound to complete the first hydroxylation step. Combined kinetic, solvent isotope-effect, mutational, and computational analyses support a preferred Asp279'-facilitated PCET pathway for the second oxidation of 5-OH-Ile to the aldehyde product. Our study provides a molecular basis for understanding the relationship between the structure and function of Fe(II)/2-oxoglutarate-dependent dioxygenases and reveals the potential of the catalytic ability of UcsF for biosynthesis.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.11.766072:a.titleZh: Yarrowia lipolytica中基于dCas12a的CRISPRi/a用于混合筛选的经验优化
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.11.766072:a.abstractZh: 耶氏酵母（Yarrowia lipolytica）是生物技术和代谢工程的重要宿主，因其积累脂质并产生多种工业相关化合物的能力而备受推崇。这产生了对能够加速鉴定复杂表型背后基因的基因组规模工具的日益增长的需求。尽管基于Cas9的CRISPR干扰（CRISPRi）和激活（CRISPRa）工具在耶氏酵母中已确立，但Cas12a提供了一个互补的平台，具有富含T的PAM，可以扩展对启动子区域的访问并促进多重调控。然而，基于Cas12a的CRISPRi/a在耶氏酵母中相对发展不足，特别是在大规模功能筛选方面。在此，我们建立并系统地基准测试了用于耶氏酵母混合筛选的基于dCas12a的CRISPRi/a平台。我们首先在单基因测定和针对九个必需或条件必需基因的752个crRNA的混合CRISPRi文库中比较了两个广泛使用的效应蛋白dLbCas12a和denAsCas12a。两种同源物均支持强大的转录抑制，但它们的相对表现取决于crRNA和条件，其中dLbCas12a在靶标上显示出更一致且更强的后期耗竭。dLbCas12a还实现了基于富集的CRISPRi和CRISPRa筛选，恢复了预期的耐药性和脂质相关表型。混合文库的广泛设计进一步使识别与CRISPRi效力相关的crRNA特征成为可能。高活性的crRNA富集在转录起始位点附近，有效靶向区间延伸至大约-260至+50 bp。中等GC含量与较高的效力相关，而PAM身份显示出较弱但一致的影响，TTTA和TTTT PAMs与比TTTC和TTTG PAMs更强的耗竭相关。间隔长度与CRISPRi效力关联最强，18-nt crRNA始终优于匹配的更长20、23和25-nt变体。最后，我们测试了具有增强活性的工程化LbCas12a变体dHyperLbCas12a，发现它产生的CRISPRi和CRISPRa表型显著强于dLbCas12a。总之，这些结果确立了Cas12a作为耶氏酵母中混合CRISPRi/a筛选的多功能平台，确定了提高文库性能的实用crRNA优先规则，并强调dHyperLbCas12a作为未来大规模功能和缺失筛选的有力效应的潜力。
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.11.766072:a.sourceTitle: Empirical optimization of dCas12a-based CRISPRi/a for pooled screening in Yarrowia lipolytica
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.11.766072:a.sourceAbstract: Yarrowia lipolytica is an important host for biotechnology and metabolic engineering, valued for its ability to accumulate lipids and produce a wide range of industrially relevant compounds. This creates a growing need for genome-scale tools that can accelerate the identification of genes underlying complex phenotypes. Although Cas9-based CRISPR interference (CRISPRi) and activation (CRISPRa) tools are well established in Y. lipolytica, Cas12a offers a complementary platform with a T-rich PAM that can expand access to promoter regions and facilitate multiplexed regulation. Despite these advantages, Cas12a-based CRISPRi/a remains comparatively underdeveloped in Y. lipolytica, particularly for large-scale functional screening. Here, we establish and systematically benchmark dCas12a-based CRISPRi/a platforms for pooled screening in Y. lipolytica. We first compared two widely used effectors, dLbCas12a and denAsCas12a, across single-gene assays and a pooled CRISPRi library targeting nine essential or conditionally essential genes with 752 crRNAs. Both orthologs supported robust transcriptional repression, but their relative performance was crRNA- and condition-dependent, with dLbCas12a showing more consistent and stronger late-stage depletion across targets. dLbCas12a also enabled enrichment-based CRISPRi and CRISPRa screens, recovering expected drug-resistance and lipid-associated phenotypes. The broad design of the pooled library further enabled identification of crRNA features associated with CRISPRi efficacy. Highly active crRNAs were enriched near transcription start sites, with an effective targeting interval extending from approximately −260 to +50 bp. Intermediate GC content was associated with higher efficacy, while PAM identity showed a weaker but consistent effect, with TTTA and TTTT PAMs linked to stronger depletion than TTTC and TTTG PAMs. Spacer length showed the strongest association with CRISPRi efficacy, with 18-nt crRNAs consistently outperforming matched longer 20-, 23-, and 25-nt variants. Finally, we tested dHyperLbCas12a, an engineered LbCas12a variant with enhanced activity, and found that it produced substantially stronger CRISPRi and CRISPRa phenotypes than dLbCas12a. Together, these results establish Cas12a as a versatile platform for pooled CRISPRi/a screens in Y. lipolytica, identify practical crRNA prioritization rules for improved library performance, and highlight dHyperLbCas12a as a promising effector for future large-scale gain- and loss-of-function screens.

version:doi:10.1016/j.xplc.2026.102166:a.titleZh: 柑橘中倍半萜类化合物生物合成的谱系特异性出现与多层级调控
version:doi:10.1016/j.xplc.2026.102166:a.abstractZh: 三萜类植物化学物质柠檬苦素类（Limonoids）有助于延缓柑橘果实的苦味，增强抗虫性，并表现出具有营养保健和农用化学品潜力的多种生物活性。尽管它们很重要，但柑橘中柠檬苦素类生物合成背后的遗传和调控基础仍知之甚少。在此，我们通过整合134个柑橘及相关种质资源的靶向代谢物谱分析，并与来自橙亚科（Aurantioideae）的12个代表性物种的比较基因组学分析相结合，我们发现柠檬苦素（limonin）、诺米林（nomilin）和奥巴酮（obacunone）的出现与柑橘特异性获得三个下游生物合成基因CYP88A51、CYP716AC1和柠檬苦素呋喃合成酶（LFS）相关，而上游氧化角鲨烯环化酶1（OSC1）在各谱系中保持保守。我们进一步鉴定出CsbHLH92是一个关键转录激活因子，直接调控这些基因，其过表达导致柠檬苦素和诺米林水平显著增加。此外，CsMPK7介导的磷酸化削弱了CsbHLH92的活性，从而在叶片衰老期间下调柠檬苦素类的生物合成，此时衰老叶片通常较少受昆虫害虫青睐。总之，我们的发现揭示了谱系特异性基因出现和多层级调控如何共同塑造柑橘中柠檬苦素类的特殊代谢。这些见解为提高柑橘风味、增强抗虫性以及提高高价值生物活性化合物产量提供了代谢工程靶点。
version:doi:10.1016/j.xplc.2026.102166:a.sourceTitle: Lineage-specific Emergence and Multi-layered Regulation of Limonoid Biosynthesis in Citrus.
version:doi:10.1016/j.xplc.2026.102166:a.sourceAbstract: Limonoids are triterpenoid phytochemicals that contribute to delayed bitterness in citrus fruit, enhance pest resistance, and exhibit a wide range of bioactivities with nutraceutical and agrochemical potential. Despite their importance, the genetic and regulatory basis underlying limonoid biosynthesis in citrus remains poorly understood. Here, by integrating targeted metabolite profiling across 134 citrus and related accessions with comparative genomic analyses of 12 representative species from the orange subfamily (Aurantioideae), we show that the emergence of limonin, nomilin, and obacunone correlates with the citrus-specific acquisition of three downstream biosynthetic genes, CYP88A51, CYP716AC1, and limonoid furan synthase (LFS), while the upstream oxidosqualene cyclase 1 (OSC1) remains conserved across lineages. We further identify CsbHLH92 as a key transcriptional activator that directly regulates these genes, and its overexpression led to dramatic increases in limonin and nomilin levels. Moreover, CsbHLH92 activity is attenuated by CsMPK7-mediated phosphorylation, contributing to the downregulation of limonoid biosynthesis during leaf senescence, when senescing leaves are generally less preferred by insect pests. Together, our findings uncover how lineage-specific gene emergence and multi-layered regulation collectively shape the specialized metabolism of limonoids in citrus. These insights provide metabolic engineering targets for improving citrus flavor, enhancing pest resistance, and boosting the production of high-value bioactive compounds.

version:doi:10.1080/13543784.2026.276188.titleZh: 新兴的合成生物学工具包以控制基因表达并为心血管疾病提供治疗途径
version:doi:10.1080/13543784.2026.276188.abstractZh: 合成生物学是一个新兴领域，它整合工程原理、分子创新、跨学科方法和设计师工具包，以创建多功能且可适应的平台，用于控制和增强生物系统及活体生物中的信号传导、表型或功能。哺乳动物合成生物学的进展引发了对其转化应用的日益关注，包括心血管药物发现和疾病管理。本报告重点介绍了有前景的合成生物学启发技术，这些技术已应用或潜在应用于心血管医学中的转基因调控和疾病管理，例如可调谐调控开关、可编程基因电路、合成传感模块以及肠-心轴工程。我们还总结了该领域的近期转化进展，并讨论了剩余的障碍、潜在解决方案和未来机遇，特别强调从实验室概念到心血管疾病实际应用的进展。专家观点认为，合成生物学正稳步向转化迈进。然而，临床实施的障碍仍然存在，包括非哺乳动物成分、免疫原性、监管不确定性以及更广泛的伦理和安全问题。新兴的解决方案，包括人源化分子成分、先进的监测策略和机器学习，可能有助于减轻这些风险并扩大合成生物学在心血管领域的实用性。更强的证据和更深入的综合临床应用将使该领域为未来的心血管医学做好准备。
version:doi:10.1080/13543784.2026.276188.sourceTitle: Emerging synthetic biology toolkits to control gene expression and provide therapeutic avenues in cardiovascular disease.
version:doi:10.1080/13543784.2026.276188.sourceAbstract: Introduction Synthetic biology is an emerging field that integrates engineering principles, molecular innovations, interdisciplinary methodologies, and designer toolkits to create versatile and adaptable platforms for control, enhance, and reprogram signaling, phenotype, or function in biological systems and living organisms. Advances in mammalian synthetic biology have generated growing interest in its translational applications, including cardiovascular drug discovery and disease management. Areas covered This concise report highlights promising synthetic biology-inspired technologies that have been applied or can potentially apply to transgene regulation and disease management in cardiovascular medicine, such as tunable regulatory switches, programmable gene circuits, synthetic sensing modules, and gut-heart axis engineering. We also summarize recent translational progress in the field and discuss remaining obstacles, potential solutions, and future opportunities, with particular emphasis on the progression from laboratory concepts to practical applications in cardiovascular disease. Expert opinion Synthetic biology is steadily advancing toward translation. However, barriers for clinical implementation remain, including non‑mammalian components, immunogenicity, regulatory uncertainty, and broader ethical and safety concerns. Emerging solutions, including humanized molecular components, advanced monitoring strategies, and machine learning, may help mitigate those risks and expand the cardiovascular utility of synthetic biology. Stronger evidence and deeper clinical integration will position the field for future cardiovascular medicine.

version:doi:10.1556/030.2026.03095:4ff21.titleZh: 细菌外膜囊泡在宿主-病原体界面：生化机制、免疫调节及临床与生物技术应用
version:doi:10.1556/030.2026.03095:4ff21.abstractZh: 细菌外膜囊泡（OMVs）是由革兰氏阴性菌自然分泌的双层球形纳米结构。它们曾被视为细胞包膜再生的副产物，现在被定义为一种高度调控的零型分泌系统，参与水平基因转移、生物膜结构和宿主-病原体通讯。本文综述了控制这些囊泡形成、选择性负载包装、细胞摄取和胞内运输的分子机制。同时，批判性地评估了OMVs如何改变宿主先天性和适应性免疫、它们在疾病发病机制中的作用，以及作为临床和生物技术应用的通用平台的用途。OMVs的形成受细胞包膜重塑的刺激，包括肽聚糖与外膜之间交织键的破坏、不对称磷脂的积累、假单胞菌喹诺酮信号的插入以及内溶素介导的爆炸性细胞裂解。动态分子筛选机制，如拟杆菌中的脂蛋白输出信号（LES）和牙龈卟啉单胞菌中指向脂多糖（LPS）的分选，控制特定负载的封装。当OMVs到达宿主细胞时，它们利用各种吞噬途径和膜直接融合来传递病原体相关分子模式（PAMPs）和毒力因子。这种递送通过模式识别受体（PRRs），包括Toll样受体（TLRs）、NOD样受体和胞质环GMP-AMP合成酶（cGAS）-干扰素基因刺激因子（STING）通路刺激免疫反应。在临床上，这些特性正在Bexsero获批的脑膜炎球菌疫苗以及用于癌症靶向免疫治疗和药物递送的工程化下一代平台中得到利用。最终，对这些生物物理和免疫生理原则的理解将加速个性化疫苗和合成生物学工具的理性设计。
version:doi:10.1556/030.2026.03095:4ff21.sourceTitle: Bacterial outer membrane vesicles at the Host-Pathogen interface: Biochemical mechanisms, immunomodulation, clinical and biotechnological applications.
version:doi:10.1556/030.2026.03095:4ff21.sourceAbstract: Bacterial outer membrane vesicles (OMVs) are bilayered spherical nanostructures that are naturally secreted by Gram-negative bacteria. Formerly considered a byproduct of cell envelope regeneration, OMVs are now defined as a highly regulated type zero secretion system that contributes to horizontal gene transfer, biofilm structure, and host-pathogen communication. This paper reviews the molecular mechanisms that govern the formation of these vesicles, selective load packing, cellular uptake, and intracellular transport. It also critically evaluates how OMVs modify host innate and adaptive immunity, their role in disease pathogenesis, and their use as versatile platforms for clinical and biotechnological applications. The formation of OMVs is stimulated by cell envelope remodeling, including disruption of the interlaced bonds between peptidoglycan and the outer membrane, accumulation of asymmetric phospholipids, intercalation of Pseudomonas quinolone signal, and endolysin-mediated explosive cell lysis. Dynamic molecular screening mechanisms, such as lipoprotein export signal (LES) in Bacteroides and lipopolysaccharide (LPS) directed sorting in Porphyromonas gingivalis, control the specific load encapsulation. When they reach host cells, OMVs use various phagocytic pathways and direct fusion of membranes to communicate pathogen-associated molecular patterns (PAMPs) and virulence agents. This delivery stimulates immune responses via pattern recognition receptors (PRRs), including Toll-like receptors (TLRs), NOD-like receptors, and the cytoplasmic cyclic GMP-AMP synthase (cGAS)-stimulator of interferon genes (STING) pathway. Clinically, these properties are being exploited in Bexsero's approved meningococcal vaccine and in engineered next-generation platforms for cancer-targeted immunotherapy and drug delivery. Ultimately, the understanding of these biophysical and immunophysiological principles will accelerate the rational design of personalized vaccines and synthetic biology tools.

version:doi:10.1016/j.tibtech.2026.10.01.titleZh: 用于调节遗传电路的分层设计策略
version:doi:10.1016/j.tibtech.2026.10.01.abstractZh: 遗传电路设计是合成生物学的核心，但由于多样化的电路和宿主依赖因素，实现可预测和可编程的电路性能仍然具有挑战性。因此，需要一种系统性的视角来整合跨越多层设计的这些因素。在本综述中，我们建立了一个用于调节遗传电路的分层框架，将其作为一个涵盖生物元件设计、DNA合成与组装、载体选择、宿主细胞实施以及跨宿主转移的工程过程。我们进一步讨论了每一层如何贡献于电路行为并塑造关键性能特性之间的权衡。通过将分层设计策略与迭代故障排除相结合，本综述为调节遗传电路以实现更可预测和可靠的性能提供了实用的路线图。

question.text: 如何系统性整合多样化的电路和宿主依赖因素，以解决遗传电路设计中难以实现可预测和可编程性能的挑战？
question.evidence: Genetic circuit design is central to synthetic biology, yet achieving predictable and programmable circuit performance remains challenging due to diverse circuit- and host-dependent factors.

methods.text: 建立涵盖生物元件设计、DNA合成与组装、载体选择、宿主细胞实施及跨宿主转移的分层框架，并结合迭代故障排除进行综述分析。
methods.evidence: In this review, we establish a hierarchical framework for tuning genetic circuits as an engineering process spanning biological part design, DNA synthesis and assembly, carrier selection, host-cell implementation, and cross-host transfer.

findings.text: 建立了用于调节遗传电路的分层框架，讨论了各层对电路行为及性能权衡的贡献，并提供了结合分层设计与迭代故障排除以改善电路可预测性和可靠性的实用路线图。
findings.evidence: By integrating hierarchical design strategies with iterative troubleshooting, this review provides a practical roadmap for tuning genetic circuits toward more predictable and reliable performance.

version:doi:10.1016/j.tibtech.2026.10.01.sourceTitle: Hierarchical design strategies for tuning genetic circuits.
version:doi:10.1016/j.tibtech.2026.10.01.sourceAbstract: Genetic circuit design is central to synthetic biology, yet achieving predictable and programmable circuit performance remains challenging due to diverse circuit- and host-dependent factors. Thus, a systematic perspective is needed to integrate these factors across multiple design layers. In this review, we establish a hierarchical framework for tuning genetic circuits as an engineering process spanning biological part design, DNA synthesis and assembly, carrier selection, host-cell implementation, and cross-host transfer. We further discuss how each layer contributes to circuit behavior and shapes trade-offs among key performance properties. By integrating hierarchical design strategies with iterative troubleshooting, this review provides a practical roadmap for tuning genetic circuits toward more predictable and reliable performance.

version:doi:10.1039/d5cs01551k:ae87fc20-.titleZh: 田间作物病害监测：从表型到分子
version:doi:10.1039/d5cs01551k:ae87fc20-.abstractZh: 气候变化和日益复杂的生态系统加剧了作物病害，导致严重的产量损失并威胁全球粮食安全。及时准确的田间监测对于作物病害的预警和有效管理至关重要。传感技术、柔性电子学和合成生物学的进步正在将作物病害监测从表型转变为分子水平。在本综述中，我们首先总结了主要的作物病原体和害虫及其相关的疾病生物标志物。随后，我们考察了可部署于田间的分子检测方法，包括现场检测试剂盒、无人机搭载平台、可穿戴设备和哨兵植物，这些方法能够实现作物感染的田间、实时、大规模和长期监测。我们评估了它们在早期作物感染检测、田间病原体调查、农药施用指导以及作物应激反应研究中的技术成熟度和应用。最后，我们讨论了微型化、高通量分析设备和物联网的前景，以及将田间监测技术转化为重塑作物病害管理的农业应用中面临的挑战。

question.text: 如何从表型向分子水平转变以实现田间作物病害的及时、准确、实时、大规模和长期监测？
question.evidence: Timely and accurate in-field surveillance is essential for early warning and effective management of crop diseases.

methods.text: 综述主要作物病原体和害虫及其生物标志物；考察现场检测试剂盒、无人机平台、可穿戴设备和哨兵植物等田间分子检测方法；评估其技术成熟度及应用领域。
methods.evidence: In this review, we first summarize major crop pathogens and pests as well as their associated disease biomarkers.

findings.text: 传感技术、柔性电子学和合成生物学正推动监测从表型向分子转变；现场检测试剂盒、无人机平台、可穿戴设备和哨兵植物可实现田间实时、大规模和长期监测；这些技术在早期感染检测、病原体调查、农药指导和应激反应研究中具有应用潜力。
findings.evidence: We then examine field-deployable molecular detection approaches, including point-of-need assays, drone-equipped platforms, wearable devices, and sentinel plants, which enable in-field, real-time, broad-scale, and long-term surveillance of crop infection.

limitations.text: 将田间监测技术转化为农业应用中面临挑战。
limitations.evidence: Finally, we discuss the prospects of miniaturized, high-throughput analytical devices and the Internet of Things, as well as the challenges of translating in-field surveillance technologies into agricultural applications that will reshape crop disease management.

version:doi:10.1039/d5cs01551k:ae87fc20-.sourceTitle: In-field crop disease surveillance: from phenotypes to molecules.
version:doi:10.1039/d5cs01551k:ae87fc20-.sourceAbstract: Climate change and increasing ecological complexity intensify crop diseases, causing severe yield losses and threatening global food security. Timely and accurate in-field surveillance is essential for early warning and effective management of crop diseases. Advances in sensing technologies, flexible electronics, and synthetic biology are transforming crop disease surveillance from phenotypes to molecules. In this review, we first summarize major crop pathogens and pests as well as their associated disease biomarkers. We then examine field-deployable molecular detection approaches, including point-of-need assays, drone-equipped platforms, wearable devices, and sentinel plants, which enable in-field, real-time, broad-scale, and long-term surveillance of crop infection. We assess their technological readiness and applications in early crop infection detection, field pathogen survey, pesticide application instruction, and investigations of crop stress responses. Finally, we discuss the prospects of miniaturized, high-throughput analytical devices and the Internet of Things, as well as the challenges of translating in-field surveillance technologies into agricultural applications that will reshape crop disease management.

version:doi:10.1016/j.crmeth.2026.101662.titleZh: 通过编程SporeBot实现按需生物制造
version:doi:10.1016/j.crmeth.2026.101662.abstractZh: 生物制药，包括抗菌肽和工程化蛋白质疫苗，代表了生物技术领域的关键产品。然而，它们对大规模制造和冷链物流的依赖限制了其在野外和资源有限环境中的部署。为了解决这一差距，我们开发了SporeBot，这是一个利用枯草芽孢杆菌孢子内在稳定性进行多功能和按需生物制药生产的平台。该平台由包裹工程化孢子的聚合物微胶囊组成。这些孢子表现出强大的稳定性，在恶劣条件和长期储存下保留工程化功能。激活后，萌发细胞分泌目标蛋白，这些蛋白扩散穿过聚合物网格，将细胞工厂与分泌产物物理分离。我们通过生产抗菌肽和疫苗抗原并进行功能测试验证了该平台。我们的方法解决了蛋白质治疗剂的关键制造和分布限制，并为发达国家和资源有限环境中的按需生物制造提供了一种可部署的解决方案。

question.text: 如何解决生物制药对大规模制造和冷链物流的依赖，以实现野外和资源有限环境中的部署？
question.evidence: However, their reliance on large-scale manufacturing and cold-chain logistics limits deployment in field and resource-limited settings.

methods.text: 开发SporeBot平台，利用枯草芽孢杆菌孢子的内在稳定性；构建包含工程化孢子的聚合物微胶囊；通过激活萌发细胞分泌目标蛋白，并利用聚合物网格物理分离细胞工厂与产物；生产抗菌肽和疫苗抗原并进行功能测试。
methods.evidence: To address this gap, we developed SporeBot, a platform that exploits the intrinsic stability of Bacillus subtilis spores for versatile and on-demand biopharmaceutical production.

findings.text: 工程化孢子在恶劣条件和长期储存下保持稳定性和功能；激活后萌发细胞能分泌目标蛋白并通过聚合物网格扩散；该平台成功用于生产具有功能的抗菌肽和疫苗抗原；解决了蛋白质治疗剂的制造和分布限制，适用于按需生物制造。
findings.evidence: We validate this platform through the production and functional testing of antimicrobial peptides and vaccine antigens.

version:doi:10.1016/j.crmeth.2026.101662.sourceAbstract: Biopharmaceuticals, including antimicrobial peptides and engineered protein-based vaccines, represent key products of the biotechnology sector. However, their reliance on large-scale manufacturing and cold-chain logistics limits deployment in field and resource-limited settings. To address this gap, we developed SporeBot, a platform that exploits the intrinsic stability of Bacillus subtilis spores for versatile and on-demand biopharmaceutical production. The platform comprises polymeric microcapsules that encapsulate engineered spores. These spores exhibit robust stability, retaining engineered functionality under harsh conditions and extended storage. Upon activation, germinated cells secrete the target proteins, which diffuse across a polymeric mesh that physically separates the cellular factory from the secreted product. We validate this platform through the production and functional testing of antimicrobial peptides and vaccine antigens. Our approach resolves key manufacturing and distribution constraints of protein therapeutics and offers a deployable solution for on-demand biomanufacturing in both developed and resource-limited settings.

version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_373:9c7d7f6a.titleZh: 微生物生产L-苹果酸的研究进展
version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_373:9c7d7f6a.abstractZh: L-苹果酸是一种重要的有机酸，广泛应用于食品、制药和化学工业。与传统的化学和酶法生产方法相比，微生物发酵提供了一种更可持续的途径，利用可再生资源生产光学纯的L-苹果酸。本章总结了L-苹果酸的性质、应用、生产方法、生物合成途径、菌株改良策略以及下游加工技术。特别关注黑曲霉（Aspergillus niger），由于其强大的有机酸分泌能力、稳健的代谢和良好的工业耐受性，它被认为是生产L-苹果酸的有希望的宿主。讨论了包括代谢工程、适应性进化、提高胁迫耐受性以及利用低成本底物在内的近期策略，以强调高效且经济地生产L-苹果酸的未来方向。

methods.text: 综述了L-苹果酸的性质、应用、生产方法、生物合成途径、菌株改良策略及下游加工；重点讨论黑曲霉作为宿主的优势；探讨代谢工程、适应性进化、胁迫耐受性提升及低成本底物利用等策略。
methods.evidence: This chapter summarizes the properties, applications, production methods, biosynthetic pathways, strain improvement strategies, and downstream processing of L-malic acid.

findings.text: 微生物发酵比传统化学和酶法更可持续，可利用可再生资源生产光学纯L-苹果酸；黑曲霉因具备强有机酸分泌能力、稳健代谢和良好工业耐受性，是生产L-苹果酸的有希望宿主。
findings.evidence: Special attention is given to Aspergillus niger, which is a promising host for L-malic acid production due to its strong organic acid secretion ability, robust metabolism, and good industrial tolerance.

version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_373:9c7d7f6a.sourceTitle: Advances in Microbial Production of L-Malic Acid.
version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_373:9c7d7f6a.sourceAbstract: L-Malic acid is an important organic acid widely used in food, pharmaceutical, and chemical industries. Compared with traditional chemical and enzymatic production methods, microbial fermentation offers a more sustainable route for producing optically pure L-malic acid from renewable resources. This chapter summarizes the properties, applications, production methods, biosynthetic pathways, strain improvement strategies, and downstream processing of L-malic acid. Special attention is given to Aspergillus niger, which is a promising host for L-malic acid production due to its strong organic acid secretion ability, robust metabolism, and good industrial tolerance. Recent strategies, including metabolic engineering, adaptive evolution, stress tolerance improvement, and utilization of low-cost substrates, are discussed to highlight future directions for efficient and economical L-malic acid production.

version:doi:10.1080/10408398.2026.275457.titleZh: 靶向细菌信号通路：食品安全抗菌策略的范式转变
version:doi:10.1080/10408398.2026.275457.abstractZh: 食源性细菌感染对全球食品安全和公共健康构成重大挑战。病原菌每年导致数百万起食源性疾病，而腐败生物则通过产品变质造成巨大的经济损失。全球近十分之一的人口每年感染食源性疾病，导致约42万人死亡。在低收入和中等收入国家，因不安全食品导致的劳动生产力和医疗费用损失每年高达1100亿美元。传统保鲜方法面临质量下降、残留毒性和消费者日益增长的清洁标签需求等局限性。细菌信号通路调控毒力、生物膜形成和应激适应，提供了新型抗毒力靶点，能在最小化微生物危害的同时保持食品质量。本综述系统考察了三大细菌信号通路作为食品抗菌策略新靶点的应用。评估了新兴干预平台，包括计算生物学、纳米技术、合成生物学、天然群体感应（QS）抑制剂和酶降解策略，重点介绍其在冷链、发酵食品和肉类产品中的实际应用。靶向信号通路显示出控制病原体的巨大潜力。关键挑战包括信号分子在食品基质中的稳定性以及生物利用度的优化。结合计算筛选、天然抑制剂和工程化递送系统的多靶点干预策略代表了下一代食品抗菌剂最有希望的方向。
version:doi:10.1080/10408398.2026.275457.sourceTitle: Targeting bacterial signaling pathways: a paradigm shift in antimicrobial strategies for food safety.
version:doi:10.1080/10408398.2026.275457.sourceAbstract: Foodborne bacterial contamination represents a critical challenge to global food safety and public health. Pathogenic bacteria cause millions of foodborne illnesses annually, while spoilage organisms lead to substantial economic losses through product deterioration. Nearly one in ten people worldwide contract foodborne illnesses each year, resulting in approximately 420,000 deaths annually. US$ 110 billion is lost each year in productivity and medical expenses resulting from unsafe food in low and middle-income countries. Conventional preservation methods face limitations including quality degradation, residual toxicity, and growing consumer demand for clean-label solutions. Bacterial signaling pathways orchestrate virulence, biofilm formation, and stress adaptation, offering novel anti-virulence targets that preserve food quality while minimizing microbial hazards. This review systematically examines three major bacterial signaling pathways as novel targets for food antimicrobial strategies. Emerging intervention platforms are evaluated, including computational biology, nanotechnology, synthetic biology, natural QS inhibitors, and enzymatic degradation strategies, with emphasis on practical applications in cold chain, fermented foods, and meat products. Targeting signaling pathways demonstrates significant potential for controlling pathogens. Key challenges include signal molecule stability in food matrices, bioavailability optimization. Multi-target intervention strategies combining computational screening, natural inhibitors, and engineered delivery systems represent the most promising direction for next-generation food antimicrobials.

version:doi:10.34133/research.1457:7ee80.titleZh: 人工智能作为对抗耐药性抗菌药物发现的多功能工具包
version:doi:10.34133/research.1457:7ee80.abstractZh: 如何理性地将人工智能（AI）应用于克服抗菌素耐药性（AMR）的抗菌药物发现与开发，目前仍定义不足，特别是在不同耐药机制和转化阶段方面。全球范围内AMR的出现和传播正在削弱常规抗菌疗法，而缓慢的抗生素发现、有限的靶点多样性以及依赖单一机制的药物设计进一步增加了治疗选择不足的风险。凭借在多组学整合、复杂模式识别和结构指导分子设计方面的优势，AI为支持下一代抗菌药物开发提供了一种有前景的方法。本综述聚焦于针对细菌耐药性的抗菌药物开发中的人工智能相关策略，并系统概述了靶点识别、分子设计、活性预测和临床转化方面的进展。该综述并非提出新的理论框架，而是引入一个实用的综合工具，用于评估在考虑应用目标、数据特性、验证深度、生物学可解释性和转化可行性时，AI在何处增加价值以及在何处仍存在重要局限性。重点强调了主要挑战，包括数据异质性、克隆偏差、外部验证有限、体外活性与体内治疗效果之间的差异，以及尚无经AI发现或AI设计的抗菌药物获得监管批准。相应地，勾勒了未来方向，包括多模态数据整合、可解释的人工智能方法、通过合成生物学的验证以及协调的国际监管努力。总体而言，本综述提供了关于如何将人工智能与理性抗菌药物设计相结合的结构性概述，同时考虑了其解决多重耐药病原体方面的潜力和当前局限性。
version:doi:10.34133/research.1457:7ee80.sourceTitle: Artificial Intelligence as a Multifaceted Toolkit for Antibacterial Drug Discovery against Resistance.
version:doi:10.34133/research.1457:7ee80.sourceAbstract: How artificial intelligence (AI) can be rationally applied to antibacterial drug discovery and development to overcome antimicrobial resistance (AMR) remains insufficiently defined, particularly across different resistance mechanisms and translational stages. The global emergence and dissemination of AMR are compromising conventional antibacterial therapies, while slow antibiotic discovery, limited target diversity, and reliance on single-mechanism drug design further increase the risk of inadequate treatment options. With strengths in multi-omics integration, complex pattern recognition, and structure-guided molecular design, AI offers a promising approach to support next-generation antibacterial development. This review focuses on AI-related strategies for antimicrobial development against bacterial resistance and provides a systematic overview of advances in target identification, molecular design, activity prediction, and clinical translation. Rather than proposing a new theoretical framework, the review introduces a pragmatic synthesis tool for evaluating where AI adds value and where important limitations remain, considering application objectives, data properties, validation depth, biological interpretability, and translational feasibility. Major challenges are highlighted, including data heterogeneity, clonal bias, limited external validation, discrepancies between in vitro activity and in vivo therapeutic efficacy, and the absence of regulatory approval for any AI-discovered or AI-designed antibacterial agent. Correspondingly, future directions are delineated, including multimodal data integration, explainable AI methodologies, validation through synthetic biology, and coordinated international regulatory efforts. Overall, this review provides a structured overview of how AI can be integrated with rational antibacterial design while considering both its potential and current limitations for addressing multidrug-resistant pathogens.

version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_366:f401797e.titleZh: 人工智能驱动的合成生物学：机遇与挑战
version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_366:f401797e.abstractZh: 生物系统的开发通常需要大量的实验迭代和优化，这可能耗费大量资源且耗时。近年来，人工智能（AI）的快速进步展示了解决这些挑战的强大潜力。AI技术，特别是那些能够从大型数据集中持续学习并智能探索新解空间的技术，与合成生物学平台不断发展的需求高度契合。AI在分析复杂的生物特征和促进复杂生物系统的设计方面具有重大前景。本综述探讨了AI在合成生物学中的应用现状，重点介绍了其在部件工程、电路工程、代谢工程和基因组工程等领域的影响。它还强调了将AI与合成生物学整合的几个关键挑战，包括标准化数据、智能平台的开发、实验自动化以及提高预测准确性等问题。AI与合成生物学的融合有望通过加速新生物系统的设计和测试来彻底改变“设计-构建-测试-学习”（DBTL）循环。此外，开发能够模拟合成生物学家能力的AI系统可能会带来AI本身的重大突破。随着这两个领域同步发展，AI与合成生物学的融合有可能推动创新，重塑生物技术和人工智能的未来。
version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_366:f401797e.sourceTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Synthetic Biology Promises and Challenges.
version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_366:f401797e.sourceAbstract: The development of biological systems often requires extensive experimental iterations and optimization, which can be resource-intensive and time-consuming. In recent years, rapid advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) have demonstrated a strong potential to address these challenges. AI technologies, particularly those that enable continuous learning from large datasets and intelligent exploration of novel solution spaces, align closely with the evolving needs of synthetic biology platforms. AI holds significant promise for analyzing complex biological features and facilitating the design of sophisticated biological systems. This review explores the current progress of AI applications in synthetic biology, focusing on its impact in areas such as part engineering, circuit engineering, metabolic engineering, and genome engineering. It also highlights several key challenges in integrating AI with synthetic biology, including issues related to standardized data, development of intelligent platforms, automation of experimentation, and enhancing predictive accuracy. The fusion of AI and synthetic biology is poised to revolutionize the "design-build-test-learn" (DBTL) cycle by accelerating the design and testing of new biological systems. Furthermore, the development of AI systems that emulate the capabilities of synthetic biologists could lead to significant breakthroughs in AI itself. As both fields continue to evolve in tandem, the convergence of AI and synthetic biology holds the potential to drive innovations that will reshape the future of biotechnology and artificial intelligence.

version:doi:10.1002/pei3.70225:7bb49eb-1.titleZh: 超越原发-次生代谢二分法：迈向统一的代谢视角
version:doi:10.1002/pei3.70225:7bb49eb-1.abstractZh: 原发与次生代谢之间的区分长期以来在生物化学，特别是植物科学中提供了一个有用的概念和教学框架，但随着对代谢物产生和功能理解的深入，它作为描述代谢物如何实际产生和发挥作用的字面解释越来越失效。途径共享前体、辅因子、调控机制、转运系统和回收路线，而传统上被归入不同类别的代谢物可根据上下文参与生长、信号传导、防御、营养获取、结构或应激反应。在此，我们回顾了原发-次生二分法的历史起源，并综合了生化、遗传、生态、代谢组学和系统层面的证据，以提出对植物代谢更整合的解释。我们并不主张废除既定术语：它们仍然是描述保护、分布和途径组织方面广泛趋势的有用 descriptors。相反，我们反对将其视为固定的功能类别。我们开发了一个操作框架，其中共同评估网络位置、通量和资源耦合、系统发育分布、时空定位、条件必需性以及实验证实的功能。随后，我们展示了这一视角如何改变非靶向代谢组学数据的分析和代谢工程策略的设计。统一的代谢视角提供了一种实用方法，将植物生理学、环境响应和生态相互作用联系起来，而不需要用新的僵化词汇替换既定术语。
version:doi:10.1002/pei3.70225:7bb49eb-1.sourceTitle: Beyond the Primary-Secondary Dichotomy: Toward a Unified Metabolic Perspective.
version:doi:10.1002/pei3.70225:7bb49eb-1.sourceAbstract: The distinction between primary and secondary metabolism has long provided a useful conceptual and pedagogical framework in biochemistry, particularly in plant sciences, but it increasingly fails as a literal description of how metabolites are produced and function. Pathways share precursors, cofactors, regulatory mechanisms, transport systems, and recycling routes, while metabolites conventionally assigned to different categories can contribute to growth, signaling, defense, nutrient acquisition, structure, or stress responses depending on context. Here, we review the historical origins of the primary-secondary dichotomy and synthesize biochemical, genetic, ecological, metabolomic, and systems-level evidence for a more integrated interpretation of plant metabolism. We do not argue that established terms must be abolished: they remain useful descriptors of broad tendencies in conservation, distribution, and pathway organization. Instead, we argue against treating them as fixed functional categories. We develop an operational framework in which network position, flux and resource coupling, phylogenetic distribution, spatiotemporal localization, conditional essentiality, and experimentally demonstrated function are evaluated together. We then show how this perspective changes the analysis of untargeted metabolomic data and the design of metabolic-engineering strategies. A unified metabolic perspective provides a practical way to connect plant physiology, environmental responses, and ecological interactions without replacing established terminology with a new rigid vocabulary.

version:doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11409779/v1.titleZh: 连续高频监测揭示硬蛤养殖中排水期间温室气体动态的显著昼夜变化
version:doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11409779/v1.abstractZh: 近年来，水产养殖中的温室气体（GHG）排放引起了越来越多的关注；然而，由于以前的研究在很大程度上依赖于短期观察，排水期间的GHG动态仍知之甚少。在本研究中，对硬蛤（Meretrix lusoria）池塘排水后的连续六天进行了连续高频监测，以表征二氧化碳（CO2）、甲烷（CH4）和氧化亚氮（N2O）的时间动态。与养殖期相比，排水期的平均CO2通量显著降低（0.55 ± 1.17 µg m−2 day−1 vs. 1,126.88 ± 5,735.56 mg m−2 day−1），CH4吸收减少（-0.86 ± 9.84 µg m−2 day−1 vs. -0.52 ± 1.06 mg m−2 day−1），平均N2O排放量更高（68.98 ± 393.54 mg m−2 day−1 vs. 0.88 ± 0.90 mg m−2 day−1）。这些结果表明，与养殖期相比，排水期的特征是平均CO2排放量较低、CH4吸收较弱以及平均N2O排放量较高，突显了三种GHG的不同响应。连续监测进一步揭示了早期排水阶段GHG浓度的显著昼夜变化。排水后前三天CO2浓度波动明显，随着沉积物曝气增加，CH4浓度逐渐下降，尽管通量没有显著的昼夜差异，但N2O浓度表现出延迟的昼夜模式，表明微生物产生与大气排放之间可能存在时间滞后。这些发现表明，排水期间的GHG动态具有高度可变性且对采样时间敏感。因此，在一天中的单一时间进行的测量可能会高估或低估每日排放量。据我们所知，这是第一项使用连续高频监测来表征排水期间GHG动态的研究。
version:doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11409779/v1.sourceTitle: Continuous high-frequency monitoring reveals pronounced diel variability in greenhouse gas dynamics during pond drainage in hard clam aquaculture
version:doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11409779/v1.sourceAbstract: Abstract Greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions from aquaculture have attracted increasing attention in recent years; however, GHG dynamics during the pond drainage period remain poorly understood because previous studies have relied largely on short-term observations. In this study, continuous high-frequency monitoring was conducted over six consecutive days following pond drainage in hard clam ( Meretrix lusoria ) ponds to characterize the temporal dynamics of carbon dioxide (CO 2 ), methane (CH 4 ), and nitrous oxide (N 2 O). Compared with the culture period, the drainage period exhibited substantially lower mean CO₂ fluxes (0.55 ± 1.17 µg m − 2 day − 1 vs. 1,126.88 ± 5,735.56 mg m − 2 day − 1 ), reduced CH 4 uptake (− 0.86 ± 9.84 µg m − 2 day − 1 vs. −0.52 ± 1.06 mg m − 2 day − 1 ), and higher mean N 2 O emissions (68.98 ± 393.54 mg m − 2 day − 1 vs. 0.88 ± 0.90 mg m − 2 day − 1 ). These results indicate that the drainage period was characterized by lower mean CO 2 emissions, weaker CH 4 uptake, and higher mean N 2 O emissions relative to the culture period, highlighting distinct responses among the three GHGs. Continuous monitoring further revealed pronounced diel variations in GHG concentrations during the early drainage stage. CO 2 concentrations fluctuated markedly during the first three days after drainage, CH 4 concentrations progressively declined as sediment aeration increased, and N 2 O concentrations exhibited a delayed diel pattern despite the absence of significant diel differences in fluxes, suggesting a potential temporal lag between microbial production and atmospheric emission. These findings demonstrate that GHG dynamics during pond drainage are highly variable and sensitive to sampling time. Measurements conducted at a single time of day may therefore overestimate or underestimate daily emissions. To our knowledge, this is the first study to characterize GHG dynamics during pond drainage using continuous high-frequency monitoring.

version:doi:10.1093/protein/gzag034:27f5.titleZh: 解耦细胞复杂性：野生型与突变型 PhoE 在纳米反应器中的传质对比分析
version:doi:10.1093/protein/gzag034:27f5.abstractZh: 跨区室边界的底物转运的精确控制对于酶纳米反应器的设计至关重要，然而选择性且可调控的分子通量仍是受限反应系统中的主要瓶颈。外膜孔蛋白提供了一种有希望的解决方案，因为其转运特性可通过蛋白质工程进行调节。其中，来自大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）的中度阴离子选择性孔蛋白 PhoE 因其明确的孔结构而成为一个极具吸引力的候选者。此前已描述并分析了多种 PhoE 突变体，主要是在全细胞实验中进行的。然而，此类系统限制了底物转运的定量分辨率，因为特异性通量难以从表达水平、膜插入效率以及功能性蛋白量的变化中分离出来。为了克服这些局限性，我们采用装载酶的纳米反应器作为最小且定义明确的平台，直接量化独立于细胞复杂性的 PhoE 介导的底物通量。将野生型 PhoE 与在细菌细胞中表现出不同转运行为的突变体进行比较，其中 F111C 突变体的转运降低了约 50%。此外，我们设计并表征了新的缺失突变体 PhoEΔ102-107，其转运速率比野生型 PhoE 高 2.4 倍。这种自下而上的合成生物学系统实现了对特异性转运速率的直接比较，展示了这些变体在工程化酶纳米反应器中用于转运调控的潜力。互补的分子动力学模拟为观察到的 PhoE 突变体转运行为的分子基础提供了结构见解。
version:doi:10.1093/protein/gzag034:27f5.sourceTitle: Decoupling cellular complexity: Comparative mass transport analysis of wild-type and mutant PhoE in nanoreactors.
version:doi:10.1093/protein/gzag034:27f5.sourceAbstract: Precise control of substrate transport across compartment boundaries is critical for the design of enzymatic nanoreactors, yet selective and tunable molecular flux remains a major bottleneck in confined reaction systems. Outer membrane porins offer a promising solution, as their transport properties can be modulated through protein engineering. Among these, the moderately anion-selective porin PhoE from Escherichia coli is an attractive candidate due to its defined pore architecture. Several PhoE mutants have previously been described and analyzed, predominantly in whole-cell assays. However, such systems limit the quantitative resolution of substrate transport, as specific flux cannot easily be disentangled from expression levels, membrane insertion efficiency, and variations in the amount of functional protein. To overcome these limitations, we employed enzyme-loaded nanoreactors as a minimal and well-defined platform to directly quantify PhoE-mediated substrate flux independent of cellular complexity. Wild-type PhoE was compared to mutants exhibiting distinct transport behaviors in bacterial cells, with F111C showing approximately 50% lower transport. Additionally, we designed and characterized the novel deletion mutant PhoEΔ102-107, which exhibited 2.4-fold higher transport than wild-type PhoE. The bottom-up synthetic biology system enabled a direct comparison of specific transport rates, demonstrating the potential of these variants for transport tuning in engineered enzymatic nanoreactors. Complementary molecular dynamics simulations provided structural insight into the molecular basis of the observed transport behavior of the PhoE mutants.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.08.762986:9.titleZh: DecoyOpt：一种用于识别诱饵酶和预测EC编号的两阶段流程
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.08.762986:9.abstractZh: 准确且高效的EC编号预测对于阐明酶的催化作用至关重要。尽管基于相似性和深度学习的方法推动了这一任务，但它们往往无法区分由局部功能位点突变而失活的活性酶与密切相关的诱饵，导致高假阳性率（FPR）。我们提出了DecoyOpt，这是一种用于识别诱饵酶和预测EC编号的两阶段流程。具体而言，我们使用ESM3生成了推测无活性的功能位点诱饵，并在三个数据分割中评估了16种蛋白质语言模型。一个经过分类和排序损失训练的MLP在对比学习模型为预测的酶分配EC编号之前，区分酶、未注释蛋白和诱饵。在最严格的GraphPart 40%分割中，DecoyOpt实现了0.899的MCC和6.17%的D0诱饵FPR，优于重新训练的基础模型。在所有分割中，它在完整测试集上的EC编号预测方面优于这些基础模型，同时在酶子集上保持了接近CLEAN的性能。它还正确注释了所有四种野生型酶并拒绝了所有八种无活性或近乎无活性的变体。我们认为DecoyOpt在注释未表征蛋白及其变体方面具有潜力，可应用于基因组学、合成生物学和生物催化。
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.08.762986:9.sourceTitle: DecoyOpt: A two-stage pipeline for decoy-aware enzyme discrimination and EC number prediction
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.08.762986:9.sourceAbstract: Accurate and efficient EC number prediction is essential for elucidating the catalytic roles of enzymes. Although similarity-based and deep learning-based approaches have advanced this task, they often fail to distinguish active enzymes from closely related decoys inactivated by local functional-site mutations, leading to high false-positive rates (FPRs). We propose DecoyOpt, a two-stage pipeline for decoy-aware enzyme discrimination and EC number prediction. Specifically, we generated putatively inactive functional-site decoys using ESM3 and evaluated 16 protein language models across three splits. An MLP trained with classification and ranking losses distinguishes enzymes from unannotated proteins and decoys before a contrastive learning model assigns EC numbers to predicted enzymes. On the most stringent GraphPart 40% split, DecoyOpt achieves an MCC of 0.899 and a D0 decoy FPR of 6.17%, outperforming retrained baselines. Across all splits, it outperforms these baselines in EC number prediction on the full test set while maintaining performance close to CLEAN on the enzyme subset. It also correctly annotates all four wild-type enzymes and rejects all eight inactive or nearly inactive variants. We believe that DecoyOpt has potential for annotating uncharacterized proteins and their variants, with applications in genomics, synthetic biology, and biocatalysis.

version:doi:10.1002/btpr.88563:b2fc9519-.titleZh: 一次性组件中小面积灭菌级膜过滤器的扩散完整性测试
version:doi:10.1002/btpr.88563:b2fc9519-.abstractZh: 无菌过滤是生物制造过程中的最终关键步骤，其中灭菌级膜过滤器用于去除药物产品中的微生物污染，因此过滤器完整性验证至关重要。虽然气泡点和气液扩散测试是水溶性膜的既定非破坏性方法，但扩散测试对微小缺陷具有高灵敏度，并且在较低测试压力下运行。然而，将扩散测试应用于集成在封闭一次性组件中的小面积过滤器仍然具有挑战性，因为自动完整性测试仪测量的压力变化不仅可能来自膜扩散，还可能来自与组件相关的效应，如透气软管、上游体积和热平衡。对于低面积设备，这些背景贡献可能与膜信号相当或更大，从而降低测试灵敏度并使解释变得复杂。本研究提出了一种在实际中实施密封一次性组件中小规格灭菌级过滤器基于扩散的完整性测试的方法。该方法量化了特定于组件的背景贡献，并将其纳入调整后的扩散规范中，从而能够在不改变组装系统的情况下解析出特定的膜扩散。通过考虑系统衍生的测量噪声，该方法使得无法重新配置以减少上游体积或更换高渗透性软管材料的封闭组件的最终用户可靠性完整性评估成为可能。
version:doi:10.1002/btpr.88563:b2fc9519-.sourceTitle: Diffusion integrity testing of small-area sterilizing-grade membrane filters in single-use assemblies.
version:doi:10.1002/btpr.88563:b2fc9519-.sourceAbstract: Sterile filtration represents the final critical step in biomanufacturing, where a sterilizing-grade membrane filter removes microbial contamination from the drug product - making filter integrity verification essential. While bubble point and gas-liquid diffusion tests are established non-destructive methods for hydrophilic membranes, diffusion testing offers high sensitivity to small defects and operates at lower test pressures. However, applying diffusion testing to small-area filters integrated into closed single-use assemblies remains challenging because pressure changes measured by automated integrity testers can arise not only from membrane diffusion, but also from assembly-related effects such as gas-permeable tubing, upstream volume and thermal equilibration. For low-area devices, these background contributions can become comparable to or greater than the membrane signal, reducing test sensitivity and complicating interpretation. This work presents a practical method for implementing diffusion-based integrity testing of small-format sterilizing-grade filters in final sealed single-use assemblies. The approach quantifies assembly-specific background contribution and incorporates it into an adjusted diffusion specification, allowing membrane-specific diffusion to be resolved without altering the assembled system. By accounting for system-derived measurement noise, the method enables reliable end-user integrity assessment of closed assemblies that cannot be reconfigured to reduce upstream volume or replace high-permeability tubing materials.

version:doi:10.1093/lambio/ovag098:a2dbd.titleZh: 使用非生物诱导剂增强细菌次级代谢产物产量：盲目代谢工程
version:doi:10.1093/lambio/ovag098:a2dbd.abstractZh: 细菌次级代谢产物广泛应用于制药、食品、农业和化妆品等多个行业。非生物胁迫是增强这些代谢产物积累的一种低成本且简便的方法。另一方面，理性的代谢工程策略受到未知代谢负担、不完整的通路知识以及与基因修饰微生物（GMMs）相关的生物安全问题的限制。本综述调查了通过非生物胁迫驱动的策略来提高细菌菌株中次级代谢产物的产量。它系统地分析了关键的非生物胁迫——渗透、氧化、pH、溶剂和辐射——如何重塑微生物代谢和次级代谢产物生物合成途径。本综述的主要思想是阐明将各种胁迫刺激与细菌分子防御机制联系起来的相互关联的网络，并探索这种串扰在理性设计代谢工程方法中的潜在应用。根据从各种研究中收集的证据，非生物胁迫能够显著增强工业重要细菌菌株中广泛范围的次级代谢产物（包括色素、脂肪酸、酶、抗生素、有机酸、氨基酸和醇）的产量。本综述强调，对非生物胁迫的反应具有显著的菌株依赖性和代谢产物依赖性，这突出了针对特定菌株和次级代谢产物定制胁迫方案的必要性。

question.text: 如何利用非生物胁迫策略提高细菌次级代谢产物的产量，以及其背后的分子机制和应用潜力是什么？
question.evidence: This review surveys abiotic stress-driven strategies to boost secondary metabolite production in bacterial strains.

methods.text: 本综述系统分析了渗透、氧化、pH、溶剂和辐射等关键非生物胁迫如何重塑微生物代谢及次级代谢产物生物合成途径，并阐明了胁迫刺激与细菌分子防御机制之间的网络联系。
methods.evidence: It systematically analyzes how key abiotic stress-osmotic, oxidative, pH, solvent, and radiation-reshape microbial metabolism and secondary metabolite biosynthetic pathways.

findings.text: 非生物胁迫能显著增强工业重要细菌菌株中色素、脂肪酸、酶、抗生素、有机酸、氨基酸和醇等多种次级代谢产物的产量；但应对反应具有菌株和代谢产物的特异性，需定制方案。
findings.evidence: According to the collected evidences from various studies, abiotic stresses are able to induce a significant enhancement in the production of a wide-range of secondary metabolites including pigments, fatty acids, enzymes, antibiotics, organic acids, amino acids, and alcohols in the industrially-important bacterial strains.

limitations.text: 理性代谢工程策略受限于未知的代谢负担、不完整的通路知识以及基因修饰微生物的生物安全问题。
limitations.evidence: On the other hand, rational metabolic engineering strategies are limited by the unknown metabolic burden, incomplete pathway knowledge, and biosafety concerns associated with genetically modified microorganisms (GMMs).

version:doi:10.1093/lambio/ovag098:a2dbd.sourceTitle: Enhancing Bacterial Secondary Metabolite Yields Using Non-Biological Inducers: Blind metabolic engineering.
version:doi:10.1093/lambio/ovag098:a2dbd.sourceAbstract: Bacteria secondary metabolites are widely used in many industries, including pharmaceutical, food, agricultural, and cosmetics. Abiotic stresses are a low-cost and easy approach to enhance the accumulation of these metabolites. On the other hand, rational metabolic engineering strategies are limited by the unknown metabolic burden, incomplete pathway knowledge, and biosafety concerns associated with genetically modified microorganisms (GMMs). This review surveys abiotic stress-driven strategies to boost secondary metabolite production in bacterial strains. It systematically analyzes how key abiotic stress-osmotic, oxidative, pH, solvent, and radiation-reshape microbial metabolism and secondary metabolite biosynthetic pathways. The main idea of this review is to elucidate the interconnected network linking diverse stress stimuli to bacterial molecular defense mechanisms, and to explore the potential applications of this crosstalk in the rational design of metabolic engineering approaches. According to the collected evidences from various studies, abiotic stresses are able to induce a significant enhancement in the production of a wide-range of secondary metabolites including pigments, fatty acids, enzymes, antibiotics, organic acids, amino acids, and alcohols in the industrially-important bacterial strains. This review emphasizes that response to abiotic stresses is significantly strain-depended and metabolite-depended, which highlights the necessity of customization of stress regimens toward specific strains and secondary metabolites.

version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_354:75779c0e.titleZh: 黑曲霉中柠檬酸的高效生物制造
version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_354:75779c0e.abstractZh: 柠檬酸是工业生物技术中产量最大的有机酸，全球年产量超过200万吨，广泛应用于食品、制药、化工和环境领域。尽管自1917年发现黑曲霉发酵生产柠檬酸以来已有超过一个世纪的工业发展，但当前的生产系统在菌株性能、工艺效率和环境可持续性方面正接近关键瓶颈。越来越多的证据表明，柠檬酸的过量产生并非由单一代谢途径控制，而是涉及代谢、细胞生理和环境条件协调调控的多约束驱动系统现象。系统生物学和合成生物学的最新进展使范式从经验优化转向理性和可编程的生物制造。多组学数据与全基因组代谢模型的整合大大加深了对柠檬酸溢出代谢的理解。同时，基于CRISPR/Cas9的基因组编辑、动态基因调控系统和启动子工程的开发使得代谢网络的精确和多路重排成为可能。针对碳摄取、线粒体代谢、柠檬酸转运和形态调节的目标工程策略表明，高水平生产需要协调的多层优化而非单基因修饰。在工艺层面，新兴策略包括固定化发酵、原位产物回收以及利用替代非粮原料，正越来越多地与工程菌株结合以提高生产力和可持续性。这些进展共同指向从传统发酵向多尺度集成生物制造框架的转变。本综述全面概述了柠檬酸生物制造的近期进展，涵盖工业黑曲霉菌株的演变、柠檬酸积累的系统水平机制、合成生物学工具的开发、理性底盘工程策略和工艺强化方法。最后，我们讨论了未来方向，包括动态代谢控制、人工智能辅助设计和循环生物精炼系统，旨在为下一代柠檬酸生产建立完全集成、智能和可持续的范式。

question.text: 如何突破当前柠檬酸工业生产的瓶颈，实现高效、可持续的生物制造？
question.evidence: Despite more than a century of industrial development since the discovery of citric acid fermentation by Aspergillus niger in 1917, current production systems are approaching critical bottlenecks in strain performance, process efficiency, and environmental sustainability.

version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_354:75779c0e.sourceTitle: Efficient Bioproduction of Citric Acid in Aspergillus niger.
version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_354:75779c0e.sourceAbstract: Citric acid is the most widely produced organic acid in industrial biotechnology, with a global annual output exceeding 2 million tons and broad applications across the food, pharmaceutical, chemical, and environmental sectors. Despite more than a century of industrial development since the discovery of citric acid fermentation by Aspergillus niger in 1917, current production systems are approaching critical bottlenecks in strain performance, process efficiency, and environmental sustainability. Increasing evidence indicates that citrate overproduction is not governed by a single metabolic pathway but emerges as a multi-constraint-driven systems phenomenon involving coordinated regulation of metabolism, cellular physiology, and environmental conditions. Recent advances in systems biology and synthetic biology have enabled a paradigm shift from empirical optimization to rational and programmable biomanufacturing. The integration of multi-omics data with genome-scale metabolic models has substantially deepened the understanding of citrate overflow metabolism. In parallel, the development of CRISPR/Cas9-based genome editing, dynamic gene regulation systems, and promoter engineering has enabled precise and multiplexed rewiring of metabolic networks. Targeted engineering strategies focusing on carbon uptake, mitochondrial metabolism, citrate transport, and morphology regulation have demonstrated that high-level production requires coordinated multi-layer optimization rather than single-gene modifications. At the process level, emerging strategies, including immobilized fermentation, in situ product recovery, and the utilization of alternative non-food feedstocks, are being increasingly integrated with engineered strains to enhance productivity and sustainability. These advances collectively point toward a transition from conventional fermentation to a multi-scale, integrated biomanufacturing framework. This review provides a comprehensive overview of recent progress in citric acid biomanufacturing, covering the evolution of industrial A. niger strains, systems-level mechanisms of citrate accumulation, synthetic biology-enabled tool development, rational chassis engineering strategies, and process intensification approaches. Finally, we discuss future directions, including dynamic metabolic control, artificial intelligence-assisted design, and circular biorefinery systems, aiming to establish a fully integrated, intelligent, and sustainable paradigm for next-generation citric acid production.

version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1362.titleZh: 通过系统工程实现枯草芽孢杆菌中5'-磷酸吡哆醛的高水平从头生物合成
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1362.abstractZh: 5'-磷酸吡哆醛（PLP）是维生素B6的活性形式，是一种在制药和食品工业中具有广泛应用的重要辅因子。然而，其微生物生产受到细胞内毒性、严格的代谢调控、降解以及有限的外排能力的阻碍。本研究旨在通过整合代谢工程、转运蛋白工程和酶工程策略，在枯草芽孢杆菌中开发一个高效的PLP从头生产平台。我们首先评估了PLP耐受性，发现枯草芽孢杆菌能够耐受外源PLP暴露，表明其作为生产宿主的潜力。随后，引入木糖诱导系统以动态控制PLP合成酶的表达，从而最大限度地减少早期PLP积累的不利影响。接着，通过模块化途径优化改善了核糖-5-磷酸、甘油醛-3-磷酸和谷氨酰胺的供应，从而增强了PLP的生物合成。同时，减少了PLP的降解并引入了异源转运蛋白以促进细胞外PLP的积累。此外，对PLP合成酶复合物进行了蛋白质工程改造以提高其催化效率。所得菌株在5-L生物反应器中产生了1.5 g/L的PLP，生产率为20.8 mg/L/h，这是目前报道的微生物从头生产PLP的最高滴度。这项工作为提升微生物PLP生产提供了新的见解，并在工业应用中具有巨大潜力。
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1362.sourceTitle: High-level de novo biosynthesis of pyridoxal 5'-phosphate in Bacillus licheniformis by systems engineering.
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1362.sourceAbstract: Pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (PLP), the active form of vitamin B6, is an essential cofactor with broad applications in the pharmaceutical and food industries. However, its microbial production is hindered by intracellular toxicity, tight metabolic regulation, degradation, and limited export. This study aimed to develop an efficient de novo PLP production platform in Bacillus licheniformis by integrating metabolic, transporter, and enzyme engineering strategies. We first assessed PLP tolerance and found that B. licheniformis tolerated exogenous PLP exposure, suggesting its potential as a production host. A xylose-inducible system was then introduced to dynamically control PLP synthase expression, thereby minimizing the adverse effects of early PLP accumulation. Subsequently, PLP biosynthesis was enhanced by improving the supply of ribose 5-phosphate, glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate, and glutamine through modular pathway optimization. In parallel, PLP degradation was reduced and a heterologous transporter was introduced to promote extracellular PLP accumulation. Furthermore, protein engineering of the PLP synthase complex was performed to improve its catalytic efficiency. The resulting strain produced 1.5 g/L PLP with a productivity of 20.8 mg/L/h in a 5-L bioreactor, the highest titer reported for microbial de novo PLP production. This work offers new insight into boosting microbial PLP production and holds considerable potential for industrial applications.

version:doi:10.1080/21645698.2026.274025.titleZh: 知识产权权利与分子植物技术的全球交换
version:doi:10.1080/21645698.2026.274025.abstractZh: 植物的全球知识产权体制在结构上与当今气候韧性农业所依赖的分子工具不相匹配。随着基因编辑、合成生物学和数字序列信息（DSI）成为培育耐旱、耐热和耐盐作物的核心，这些技术日益被密集的专利丛林、超越《与贸易有关的知识产权协定》（TRIPS）最低标准的贸易规则（通常称为TRIPS-plus规则）以及高昂的监管要求所包围。通过教义法律分析、专利景观审查和产品层面的案例研究，我们展示了这种架构如何产生“市场力量效应”，即一小部分公司能够设定价格、叠加版税并控制准入技术，从而有效地将公共育种者、小型实验室和气候脆弱国家边缘化。我们提出了“法律韧性”的概念，以捕捉生物技术作物中的分子韧性若没有允许适应性性状快速、公平扩散的法律结构则毫无意义的观点。在实证方面，我们将CRISPR相关专利的增加、许可和合规成本的上升以及企业集中化与停滞的产量增长、持续的人类营养不良以及现有获取惠益分享机制无法遏制的新兴数字生物盗版联系起来。我们还考察了大型中等收入创新者（特别是中国）的地位，它们不符合传统的南北划分，其国内政策选择正朝着加强而非削弱保护的方向发展。在此基础上，我们提出了一套多中心改革方案：为增量本地适应设立气候效用模型层级；由商业种子销售的小额征款资助的多边DSI惠益分享基金；针对非生物胁迫抗性技术的强制性人道主义专利池；将实验室与无偿自由实施支持相结合的区域分子枢纽；以及对现有的基因库网络和社区种子系统提供持续支持，作为对抗遗传均匀性危害的实际制衡力量。我们的核心主张是，遗传韧性必须被视为人类粮食安全的基本设施，而不仅仅是可交易的个人资产。
version:doi:10.1080/21645698.2026.274025.sourceTitle: Intellectual property rights and the global exchange of molecular plant technologies.
version:doi:10.1080/21645698.2026.274025.sourceAbstract: The global intellectual property regime for plants is structurally misaligned with the molecular tools on which climate-resilient agriculture now depends. As gene editing, synthetic biology, and Digital Sequence Information (DSI) become central to breeding drought-, heat-, and salinity-tolerant crops, these same technologies are increasingly enclosed within dense patent thickets, trade rules that go beyond the minimum standards of the Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS), commonly called TRIPS-plus rules, and costly regulatory requirements. Using doctrinal legal analysis, a patent-landscape review, and product-level case studies, we show how this architecture generates a "Market Power Effect," whereby a small group of firms can set prices, stack royalties, and control access to enabling technologies, effectively sidelining public breeders, small laboratories, and climate-vulnerable states. We develop the concept of "legal resilience" to capture the idea that molecular resilience in biotech crops is meaningless without legal structures that allow rapid, equitable diffusion of adaptive traits. Empirically, we link rising CRISPR-related patents, escalating licensing and compliance costs, and corporate concentration to stagnant yield growth, persistent human undernourishment, and an emerging form of digital biopiracy that existing access and benefit-sharing instruments cannot contain. We also examine the position of large middle-income innovators, China in particular, which do not fit the conventional North-South division and whose domestic policy choices are pushing toward stronger rather than weaker protection. On this basis, we propose a polycentric reform package: a climate-utility model tier for incremental local adaptations; a multilateral DSI benefit-sharing fund financed by small levies on commercial seed sales; compulsory humanitarian patent pools for abiotic stress-resistance technologies; regional molecular hubs that pair laboratories with pro-bono freedom-to-operate support; and sustained support for the existing network of genebanks and community seed systems as a practical counterweight to the hazard of genetic uniformity. Our central claim is that genetic resilience must be treated as an essential facility for human food security, not merely as a tradable private asset.

version:doi:10.1007/s11033-026-13119-5:e.titleZh: 功能性细菌淀粉样蛋白（FuBAs）在炎症反应、泛素-蛋白酶体系统（UPS）损伤以及与宿主淀粉样蛋白交叉接种中的机制作用
version:doi:10.1007/s11033-026-13119-5:e.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病以蛋白质稳态失衡、聚集、炎症和神经元韧性受损为特征，年龄影响疾病易感性。细菌淀粉样蛋白（如菌毛、Fap、TasA和酚溶模蛋白）是有助于生物膜形成的功能性淀粉样蛋白，并可能与宿主蛋白及先天免疫通路相互作用。它们是交叉β折叠蛋白，能与其他物种的蛋白质相互作用，实验数据显示某些细菌淀粉样蛋白促进淀粉样蛋白β和α-突触核蛋白的聚集。沿肠脑轴的各种fuBA效应取决于微生物产生、肠道滞留、屏障完整性、系统清除、免疫状态和组织易感性。FuBAs或相关微生物信号激活先天免疫机制（如Toll样受体信号传导）可能导致炎症和氧化应激。泛素-蛋白酶体系统（UPS）是另一种细胞蛋白质质量控制方面，可能因淀粉样蛋白负荷增加而进一步受损。迄今为止，直接的FuBA介导的蛋白酶体抑制仍未得到充分确立。为此，本综述将直接证据、聚集/炎症应激的间接效应以及来自人类淀粉样蛋白研究的机制先例区分开来。将结合结构生物学、免疫学和蛋白质稳态研究，并将FuBAs作为神经退行性蛋白病的潜在上游调节因子进行调查。我们评估FuBAs是否直接影响肠道、外周或神经 compartments 中UPS的功能，并讨论可能的治疗策略，包括微生物组调节、屏障修复、免疫调节和蛋白酶体刺激。FuBAs可以在淀粉样蛋白相关疾病和其他神经退行性过程中改变神经元蛋白质稳态，但不一定作为这些过程的触发因素。
version:doi:10.1007/s11033-026-13119-5:e.sourceTitle: Mechanistic role of functional bacterial amyloids (FuBAs) in inflammatory responses, ubiquitin proteasome system (UPS) impairment, and cross-seedings with host amyloids.
version:doi:10.1007/s11033-026-13119-5:e.sourceAbstract: Neurodegenerative diseases are characterized by disruption of protein homeostasis, aggregation, inflammation, and neuronal resilience, with age affecting disease susceptibility. Bacterial amyloids, such as curli, Fap, TasA, and phenol-soluble modulins, are functional amyloids that aid in biofilm formation and potentially interact with host proteins and innate immune pathways. They are cross-β-sheet proteins that interact with other proteins from different species, and experimental data show that some bacterial amyloids promote the aggregation of amyloid-β and α-synuclein. Various fuBA effects along the gut-brain axis depend on microbial production, retention in the gut, barrier integrity, clearance from the system, immune status, and tissue susceptibility. The activation of innate immune mechanisms, such as Toll-like receptor signaling, by FuBAs or related microbial signals could lead to inflammation and oxidative stress. The ubiquitin-proteasome system (UPS) is another aspect of cellular protein quality control that could be further compromised by increased amyloid burden. To date, direct FuBA-mediated proteasome inhibition remains poorly established. To this end, this review separates direct evidence, indirect effects of aggregation/inflammatory stress, and mechanistic precedents from studies on human amyloid. Structural biology, immunology, and proteostasis research will be combined, and FuBAs will be investigated as potential upstream modulators of the neurodegenerative proteinopathies. We assess whether FuBAs directly influence UPS function in intestinal, peripheral, or neural compartments, and discuss possible therapeutic strategies, including microbiome modulation, barrier repair, immunomodulation, and proteasome stimulation. FuBAs can alter neuronal proteostasis in both amyloid-related disorders and other neurodegenerative processes, but not necessarily act as triggers of these processes.

version:doi:10.1016/j.carres.2026.110165.titleZh: 下一代纳米纤维素基智能生物材料：进展、功能化策略及可持续生物医学应用
version:doi:10.1016/j.carres.2026.110165.abstractZh: 纳米纤维素因其高机械强度、可调节的表面化学性质和生物相容性，已成为智能生物材料的通用平台。这些特性支持将其纳入广泛的生物医学材料中，但许多传统的纳米纤维素基系统仍主要处于被动状态，主要作为结构或支撑组件发挥作用。对智能生物材料日益增长的兴趣反映了对能够响应环境变化从而为生物医学功能提供更动态控制的材料的需求。本综述考察了纤维素纳米晶体、纤维素纳米纤维和细菌纳米纤维素向具有响应性和潜在适应性生物医学平台的转变。文中探讨了其对化学、物理和机电刺激响应的结构和分子特征，及其在响应性生物医学系统中的应用。同时关注引入化学修饰、合成聚合物或无机纳米材料以增加功能性时产生的可持续性-性能权衡，以及与材料变异性、生物稳定性、重现性、安全性和标准化相关的转化障碍。最后，考察了基于合成生物学、基因工程和人工智能/机器学习的新兴方法，评估其在提高纳米纤维素生产和设计可预测性和可编程性方面的潜力。通过将材料结构和加工与响应性、生物医学功能、可持续性及转化潜力联系起来，本综述强调了塑造智能纳米纤维素从概念验证材料向临床相关生物医学平台发展的机遇与局限。

question.text: 本综述旨在考察纳米纤维素（包括纤维素纳米晶体、纤维素纳米纤维和细菌纳米纤维素）如何向具有响应性和潜在适应性的智能生物医学平台转变，并评估其功能化策略、可持续性权衡及转化障碍。

version:doi:10.1016/j.carres.2026.110165.sourceTitle: Next-generation nanocellulose-based smart biomaterials: advances, functionalization strategies, and sustainable biomedical applications.
version:doi:10.1016/j.carres.2026.110165.sourceAbstract: Nanocellulose has emerged as a versatile platform for smart biomaterials because of its high mechanical strength, tunable surface chemistry, and biocompatibility. These properties have supported its incorporation into a wide range of biomedical materials, but many conventional nanocellulose-based systems remain predominantly passive, functioning mainly as structural or supporting components. The growing interest in smart biomaterials reflects the need for materials that can respond to changes in their environment and thereby provide more dynamic control over biomedical functions. This review examines the transition of cellulose nanocrystals, cellulose nanofibrils, and bacterial nanocellulose towards responsive and potentially adaptive biomedical platforms. The structural and molecular characteristics underlying responses to chemical, physical and electromechanical stimuli are examined, together with their application in responsive biomedical systems. Attention is also given to the sustainability-performance trade-off arising when chemical modification, synthetic polymers, or inorganic nanomaterials are introduced to increase functionality, as well as to translational barriers related to material variability, biological stability, reproducibility, safety and standardisation. Finally, emerging approaches based on synthetic biology, genetic engineering and artificial intelligence/machine learning are examined for their potential to improve the predictability and programmability of nanocellulose production and design. By relating material structure and processing to responsiveness, biomedical function, sustainability, and translational potential, this review highlights the opportunities and limitations that will shape the progression of smart nanocellulose from proof-of-concept materials towards clinically relevant biomedical platforms.

version:doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btag8.titleZh: SeekRBP：利用序列-结构整合与强化学习进行受体结合蛋白识别
version:doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btag8.abstractZh: 动机 受体结合蛋白（RBPs）启动病毒感染并决定宿主特异性，是噬菌体工程和疗法的关键靶点。然而，由于RBPs具有极端的序列多样性，传统基于同位素的比对方法往往失效，使得RBP的识别变得复杂。虽然机器学习提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但这类方法在处理严重的类别不平衡以及从异质性尾部蛋白中选择信息性负样本方面存在困难。现有方法往往难以在从这些“难负样本”中学习的同时保持泛化能力。结果 我们提出了SeekRBP，这是一个序列-结构框架，将负采样建模为顺序决策问题。通过采用多臂老虎机策略，SeekRBP根据实时训练反馈动态优先选择信息性的非RBP序列，并结合蛋白质语言和结构嵌入的多模态融合。基准测试表明，SeekRBP一致优于静态采样策略。此外，关于霍乱弧菌噬菌体的案例研究验证了SeekRBP能有效识别RB以改善宿主预测，突显了其在大规模注释和合成生物学应用中的潜力。可用性 SeekRBP的源代码可通过以下链接获取：https://github.com/Saillxl/SeekRBP。
version:doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btag8.sourceTitle: SeekRBP: Leveraging Sequence-Structure Integration with Reinforcement Learning for Receptor-Binding Protein Identification.
version:doi:10.1093/bioinformatics/btag8.sourceAbstract: Motivation Receptor-binding proteins (RBPs) initiate viral infection and determine host specificity, serving as key targets for phage engineering and therapy. However, the identification of RBPs is complicated by their extreme sequence divergence, which often renders traditional homology-based alignment methods ineffective. While machine learning offers a promising alternative, such approaches struggle with severe class imbalance and the difficulty of selecting informative negative samples from heterogeneous tail proteins. Existing methods often fail to balance learning from these "hard negatives" while maintaining generalization. Results We present SeekRBP, a sequence-structure framework that models negative sampling as a sequential decision-making problem. By employing a multi-armed bandit strategy, SeekRBP dynamically prioritizes informative non-RBP sequences based on real-time training feedback, complemented by a multimodal fusion of protein language and structural embeddings. Benchmarking demonstrates that SeekRBP consistently outperforms static sampling strategies. Furthermore, a case study on Vibrio phages validates that SeekRBP effectively identifies RBPs to improve host prediction, highlighting its potential for large-scale annotation and synthetic biology applications. Availability The source code of SeekRBP is available via: https://github.com/Saillxl/SeekRBP.

version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.titleZh: 通过桥接先进生物催化与系统合成生物学重编程类黄酮糖基化
version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.abstractZh: 类黄酮糖苷具有深远的药理学和营养学价值，然而它们在植物提取物中丰度低以及化学合成的立体化学复杂性严重阻碍了其工业规模的获取。合成生物学提供了一种可持续的替代方案，而天然植物尿苷二磷酸依赖性糖基转移酶（UGTs）的应用本质上受到低催化效率、稳定性差和严重的细胞内代谢竞争的限制。本综述系统地探讨了这些复杂分子生物制造的范式转变，强调了UGT发现的方法学演变如何从传统的序列同源性发展到多组学和AI驱动的预测模型。阐述了跨越活性位点重塑、远端变构调控和计算设计的UGT多维工程，以精确操纵催化效力、酶稳定性、底物广谱性和催化区域选择性。在优化的生物催化剂与稳健的微生物细胞工厂之间架起桥梁需要关键的系统代谢工程策略，包括重新布线细胞内UDP-糖通量、消除分解代谢汇以及部署时空解耦的微生物群落。无细胞合成级联提供了规避体内生理约束的高度可控替代方案。未来的研究战略路线图强调AI驱动的新酶设计、自主的单细胞动态调节以及木质纤维素生物质的增值利用，以实现前所未有的原子经济性。最终，这一综合框架为高价值类黄酮糖苷的可持续和绿色生物制造提供了可扩展的多维蓝图。

question.text: 如何实现类黄酮糖苷的高效、可持续工业规模生物制造？

version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.sourceTitle: Reprogramming flavonoid glycosylation by bridging advanced biocatalysis and systems synthetic biology.
version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.sourceAbstract: Flavonoid glycosides exhibit profound pharmacological and nutritional value, yet their industrial-scale acquisition is severely hampered by low abundance in plant extracts and the stereochemical complexity of chemical synthesis. Synthetic biology offers a sustainable alternative, while the deployment of natural plant uridine diphosphate-dependent glycosyltransferases (UGTs) is intrinsically bottlenecked by low catalytic efficiency, poor stability, and severe intracellular metabolic competition. This review systematically explores the paradigm shifts in the biomanufacturing of these complex molecules, highlighting how the methodological evolution in UGT discovery has evolved from traditional sequence homology to multi-omics and AI-driven predictive models. Multidimensional engineering of UGTs spanning from active-site remodeling to distal allosteric regulation and computational-design is elucidated to precisely manipulate catalytic efficacy, enzyme stability, substrate promiscuity, and catalytic regioselectivity. Bridging the gap between optimized biocatalysts and robust microbial cell factories requires critical systems metabolic engineering strategies, including the rewiring of intracellular UDP-sugar flux, the elimination of catabolic sinks, and the deployment of spatiotemporally decoupled microbial consortia. Cell-free synthesis cascades offer a highly controllable alternative to circumvent in vivo physiological constraints. A strategic roadmap for future research emphasizes AI-driven de novo enzyme design, autonomous single-cell dynamic regulation, and the valorization of lignocellulosic biomass to achieve unprecedented atom economy. Ultimately, this integrated framework provides a scalable, multidimensional blueprint for the sustainable and green biomanufacturing of high-value flavonoid glycosides.

version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_367:8018565f.titleZh: 基于合成生物学的生物制造：现状与未来展望
version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_367:8018565f.abstractZh: 利用生物系统生产化学品、药物和材料的生物制造在过去几十年中经历了变革性的变化，从基于传统基因工程的生產系統演变为基于合成生物学的新平台。本章深入概述了合成生物学影响下生物制造的发展，并讨论了用于通路设计、构建和优化的各种人工智能工具和策略，这些在克服传统方法的局限性方面发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，数据壁垒、模型可解释性不足以及通用性挑战仍然是当前的主要瓶颈。未来，随着跨学科融合和技术迭代，合成生物学将推动生物制造向可持续的生物经济演变，最终形成绿色低碳工业生产的新范式。
version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_367:8018565f.sourceTitle: Synthetic Biology-Based Biomanufacturing: Current Status and Future Prospects.
version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_367:8018565f.sourceAbstract: Biomanufacturing, which utilizes biological systems to produce chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and materials, has undergone transformative changes in recent decades, evolving from traditional genetic engineering-based production systems to new platforms based on synthetic biology. This chapter provides an in-depth overview of the development of biomanufacturing under the influence of synthetic biology and discusses various tools and strategies of artificial intelligence for pathway design, construction, and optimization, which play a crucial role in overcoming the limitations of traditional methods. However, data barriers, insufficient model interpretability, and generalizability challenges remain the current major bottlenecks. In the future, with interdisciplinary integration and technological iteration, synthetic biology will drive the evolution of biomanufacturing towards a sustainable bioeconomy, ultimately forming a new paradigm of green and low-carbon industrial production.

version:doi:10.1039/d6cc01792d:7afaaa4d-.titleZh: 合成生物学以实现可持续的丰裕：生物采矿、电微生物生产和超可工程化微生物。
version:doi:10.1039/d6cc01792d:7afaaa4d-.abstractZh: 在接下来的几十年里，迫切需要建立一种新的可持续能源基础设施，以取代自17世纪以来我们依赖的化石燃料系统。这种基础设施不仅要取代现有的系统，还要远远超越其能力，为更多人提供更大的电力，以满足发达国家和发展中国家不断增长的需求。但是，我们如何在不对地球造成伤害的情况下增加能源使用呢？生物学驱动着地球的地球化学循环，其元素和能量通量远超整个人类文明。这表明合成生物学可以解决我们的一些环境问题，同时提供获取更大能量的途径。然而，利用生物学仍然是一个巨大的挑战，部分原因是我们对于带来最独特和有用可持续性/能源能力的生物系统背后的基础科学了解得还不够。这一挑战并非生物学和可持续发展所独有——过去的突破性技术不仅需要好奇心驱动的基础研究，还需要应用启发的基础研究。在过去十年中，我们的实验室发现了构建合成生物学技术所需的新基础科学，并确立了自己在可持续发展和合成生物学领域的领先地位。本综述总结了我们在过去十年中在三个关键领域取得的突破：生物采矿、电驱动代谢和超可工程化微生物。
version:doi:10.1039/d6cc01792d:7afaaa4d-.sourceTitle: Synthetic biology for sustainable abundance: biomining, electromicrobial production, and hyper-engineerable microbes.
version:doi:10.1039/d6cc01792d:7afaaa4d-.sourceAbstract: Over the next few decades, there is a compelling need to build a new sustainable energy infrastructure to replace the fossil fuel system that we have relied on since the 1700s. This infrastructure must not only replace what exists but also far exceed its capabilities, delivering more power to more people to meet the growing demands from both developing and advanced economies. But how do we increase energy use without harming the Earth? Biology drives the Earth's geochemical cycles, operating with far greater elemental and energy fluxes than all of human civilization. This suggests that synthetic biology could solve at least some of our environmental problems while providing access to much greater energy. However, leveraging biology remains a formidable challenge, in part because we do not yet understand nearly enough about the basic science underlying the biological systems that bring the most unusual and useful capabilities to sustainability and energy. This challenge is not unique to biology and sustainability - groundbreaking technologies of the past have required not only curiosity-driven basic research but also use-inspired basic research. Over the past decade, our lab has discovered new basic science needed to build synthetic biology technologies and established itself as a leader in sustainability and synthetic biology. This review summarizes breakthroughs from our lab over the past decade in three key areas: biomining, electrically driven metabolism, and hyper-engineerable microbes.

version:doi:10.1111/dme.70511:ebf6eb8d-1.titleZh: 干细胞疗法在1型糖尿病中的前景
version:doi:10.1111/dme.70511:ebf6eb8d-1.abstractZh: 目的：1型糖尿病源于自身免疫系统对胰岛β细胞的破坏。尽管外源性胰岛素仍是标准治疗方法，但它无法恢复生理性血糖调节。将人多能干细胞分化为β细胞提供了一种可规模化的替代方案，用于取代尸体胰岛移植，在过去十年中进展迅速，导致了九个处于不同完成阶段的临床试验。尽管取得这些进展，但持久的移植物功能仍受两大挑战限制：缺乏关键的胰岛微环境成分，如血管、细胞外基质和支持细胞类型，以及持续易受自身免疫和同种异体免疫排斥的影响。方法学与结果：本综述考察了克服这些障碍的新兴技术方法。生物工程生态位，包括多谱系类器官、功能化水凝胶、脱细胞基质和生物打印，旨在重现天然胰岛微环境；而合成生物学方法，如低免疫基因编辑、基于CRISPR的转录控制和刺激响应性存活回路，则寻求增强移植物的韧性。计算和单细胞方法，包括基因调控网络分析和数字孪生框架，开始提供用于基准测试分化质量和预测移植物结果的预测工具。结论：综上所述，这些互补的策略，可能针对个体患者进行定制，代表了为1型糖尿病实现更安全、更有效且持久的β细胞替代疗法的现实路径。
version:doi:10.1111/dme.70511:ebf6eb8d-1.sourceTitle: The road ahead for stem cell therapies in type 1 diabetes.
version:doi:10.1111/dme.70511:ebf6eb8d-1.sourceAbstract: Aims Type 1 diabetes results from autoimmune destruction of insulin-producing pancreatic β-cells. Although exogenous insulin remains the standard treatment, it does not restore physiological glucose regulation. Differentiation of human pluripotent stem cells into β-cells offers a scalable alternative to cadaveric islet transplantation and has progressed rapidly over the past decade, resulting in nine clinical trials at various stages of completion. Despite this progress, durable graft function remains constrained by two major challenges: the absence of key islet microenvironment components, such as vasculature, extracellular matrix and supporting cell types and continued vulnerability to autoimmune and alloimmune rejection. Methods & results This review considers emerging technological approaches to overcome these barriers. Bioengineered niches, including multilineage organoids, functionalized hydrogels, decellularized matrices and bioprinting, aim to recreate the native islet microenvironment, while synthetic biology approaches, such as hypoimmune gene editing, CRISPR-based transcriptional control and stimulus-responsive survival circuits, seek to enhance grafts' resilience. Computational and single-cell approaches, including gene regulatory network analysis and digital twin frameworks, are beginning to provide predictive tools for benchmarking differentiation quality and forecasting graft outcomes. Conclusion Together, these complementary strategies, potentially tailored to individual patients, represent a realistic path towards safer, more effective and durable β-cell replacement therapies for type 1 diabetes.

version:doi:10.1002/btpr.88567:31f0e0d8-.titleZh: 单克隆抗体生物制造过程中产生的抑制性代谢废物综述
version:doi:10.1002/btpr.88567:31f0e0d8-.abstractZh: 中国仓鼠卵巢（CHO）细胞培养构成了大多数治疗性单克隆抗体的商业化生产基础，然而，在批次、补料分批和灌注工艺中积累的抑制性代谢副产物仍然限制了生产力和产品质量。尽管乳酸和铵离子长期以来主导了监测和控制策略，但非靶向代谢组学和稳定同位素示踪技术已大大扩展了生物工艺相关抑制剂的范围。本综述综合了对17种抑制性代谢物的当前理解，这些代谢物跨越八个代谢途径。其中包括支链氨基酸分解代谢物（异丁酸、异戊酸和2-羟基异己酸）、芳香族氨基酸衍生物（苯基乳酸、吲哚-3-羧酸盐）、核苷酸途径副产物（胞苷一磷酸、鸟苷一磷酸和琥珀酰腺苷），以及与凋亡相关的物质如甘油-3-磷酸胆碱和氧化型谷胱甘肽。报告整理了研究较多的抑制剂的浓度阈值，并总结了将积累与凋亡、生产力降低和糖基化改变联系起来的关联性证据。我们评估了用于发现的LC-MS和NMR结合分析工作流程、用于在线监测的拉曼光谱以及用于通路验证的稳定同位素示踪技术。对三个层级的控制策略进行了批判性比较：培养基和补料配方调整（氨基酸限制、动态pH或基于摄氧率的喂养）、靶向和多路复用基因工程（BCAT1敲除、LDHA/PDK联合编辑）以及酮酸前体取代。最后，我们确定了具体的差距，主要是缺乏独立于细胞系的抑制阈值，并认为将基因组规模代谢模型与过程分析技术（PAT）数据相结合是迈向预测性闭环单克隆抗体制造的合乎逻辑的下一步。

question.text: 单克隆抗体生物制造过程中积累的抑制性代谢副产物有哪些，及其对生产过程的影响和控制策略如何？

methods.text: 综述综合了17种抑制性代谢物的理解，评估了LC-MS、NMR、拉曼光谱和稳定同位素示踪等分析工作流程，并比较了培养基调整、基因工程和前体取代等控制策略。
