version:doi:10.1002/btpr.88567:31f0e0d8-.sourceTitle: A review of the inhibitory waste metabolites produced during mAb biomanufacturing.
version:doi:10.1002/btpr.88567:31f0e0d8-.sourceAbstract: Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cell culture underpins commercial manufacturing of most therapeutic monoclonal antibodies, yet productivity and product quality remain constrained by inhibitory metabolic by-products that accumulate across batch, fed-batch, and perfusion processes. While lactate and ammonium have historically dominated monitoring and control strategies, untargeted metabolomics and stable-isotope tracing have substantially expanded the inventory of bioprocess-relevant inhibitors. This review synthesizes current understanding of 17 inhibitory metabolites spanning eight metabolic pathways. These include branched-chain amino acid catabolites (isobutyrate, isovalerate, and 2-hydroxyisocaproate), aromatic amino acid derivatives (phenyllactate, indole-3-carboxylate), nucleotide-pathway by-products (cytidine monophosphate, guanosine monophosphate, and succinyladenosine), and apoptosis-correlated species such as glycerol-3-phosphocholine and oxidized glutathione. Reported concentration thresholds are compiled for better-studied inhibitors, while correlative evidence linking accumulation to apoptosis, reduced productivity, and altered glycosylation is summarized. We evaluate the analytical workflow combining LC-MS and NMR for discovery, Raman spectroscopy for in-line monitoring, and stable-isotope tracing for pathway validation. Control strategies are critically compared across three tiers: media and feed reformulation (amino acid limitation, dynamic pH, or oxygen-uptake-rate-driven feeding), targeted and multiplex genetic engineering (BCAT1 knockout, combined LDHA/PDK editing), and keto-acid precursor substitution. We close by identifying concrete gaps, chiefly the absence of cell-line-independent inhibition thresholds, and argue that coupling genome-scale metabolic models with PAT data is the logical next step toward predictive, closed-loop mAb manufacturing.

version:doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2026.102579:.titleZh: 利用通用体内进化系统升级基于酵母的低碳生物制造
version:doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2026.102579:.abstractZh: 非常规酵母正在成为低碳生物制造中的关键细胞工厂，但要释放其全部潜力，需要通过体内全基因组进化来优化复杂性状，如底物利用和高水平蛋白表达。为解决这一问题，我们开发了一种通用质粒载体，部署DNA解旋酶-激活诱导胞苷脱氨酶（Helicase-AID）以实现全基因组碱基编辑。该系统能够在多种酵母中实现跨物种诱变，包括耶氏假丝酵母（Yarrowia lipolytica）、毕赤酵母（Pichia pastoris）和克勒鲁维酵母（Kluyveromyces marxianus）。我们证明了耶氏假丝酵母中MCM5-AID的碱基编辑效率具有时间依赖性，在432小时内实现了每碱基对3.13 × 10^-5次突变的累积突变率。利用该系统，我们进化出了耶氏假丝酵母变体，其在乙酸上的最大比生长速率提高了37.77%，同时淀粉产量变化范围为-92.96%至17.45%。关键在于，我们利用该平台激活了异源蛋白的沉默表达，克服了微生物菌株工程中长期存在的瓶颈。进化、转录组和基因组分析显示，进化的耶氏假丝酵母变体通过减少蛋白水解降解，增强了难以天然表达的Cas13x蛋白的积累。相比之下，进化的毕赤酵母变体通过显著的转录上调、增强的蛋白质折叠和增加的氨基酸生物合成，获得了表达先前沉默的甜蛋白的能力。最终，这种通用的体内进化系统为跨多种工业酵母物种的基因组定向进化提供了稳健的平台，加速了对它们在低碳生物制造中潜力的系统性探索。
version:doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2026.102579:.sourceTitle: Upgrading yeast-based low-carbon biomanufacturing by harnessing a universal in vivo evolution system.
version:doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2026.102579:.sourceAbstract: Non-conventional yeasts are emerging as key cell factories in low-carbon biomanufacturing, but unlocking their full potential requires optimizing complex traits, such as substrate utilization and high-level protein expression, through in vivo genome-wide evolution. To address this, we developed a universal plasmid vector deploying a DNA Helicase-Activation-Induced Cytidine Deaminase (Helicase-AID) for genome-wide base editing. This system enables cross-species mutagenesis in diverse yeasts, including Yarrowia lipolytica, Pichia pastoris, and Kluyveromyces marxianus. We demonstrated that MCM5-AID base editing efficiency in Y. lipolytica is time-dependent, achieving a cumulative mutation rate of 3.13 × 10 -5 mutations per base pair (bp -1 ) over 432 h. Using this system, we evolved Y. lipolytica variants exhibiting a 37.77% increase in maximum specific growth rate on acetate, alongside altered starch production ranging from -92.96% to 17.45%. Crucially, we utilized this platform to activate the silent expression of heterologous proteins, overcoming a persistent bottleneck in microbial strain engineering. Evolutionary, transcriptomic and genomic analyses showed that evolved Y. lipolytica variants exhibited enhanced accumulation of Cas13x, a naturally difficult-to-express protein, via reduced proteolytic degradation. In contrast, evolved P. pastoris variants gained the ability to express previously silent thaumatin through significant transcriptional upregulation, enhanced protein folding, and increased amino acid biosynthesis. Ultimately, this universal in vivo evolution system provides a robust platform for genome-directed evolution across diverse industrial yeast species, accelerating the systematic exploration of their potential in low-carbon biomanufacturing.

version:doi:10.1016/j.bioadv.2026.215292.titleZh: 基于液-液相分离驱动的生物启发动态自组装凝聚体在治疗系统创新与应用中的综述
version:doi:10.1016/j.bioadv.2026.215292.abstractZh: 液-液相分离（LLPS）是细胞生理学和病理学中的一个关键生物物理现象，深刻影响细胞稳态和疾病进展。值得注意的是，基于LLPS原理开发的仿生干预策略已成为疾病治疗的前沿领域。本综述系统阐明了LLPS的分子基础和调控网络，特别强调其在治疗开发中的新兴应用：（1）针对致病性凝聚体动态特性的精确干预，为攻克难治性疾病提供了突破性的工具；（2）利用相变和动态组装特性构建下一代响应性递送平台，实现时空精确治疗；以及（3）LLPS驱动的仿生智能人工细胞，拓展了合成生物学的边界。我们进一步深入分析了紧迫的挑战，包括解码LLPS核心机制、区分病理性与生理性凝聚体的难度、递送系统中精确可控性的瓶颈、基于LLPS的递送系统在体内稳定性和免疫原性数据的有限性，以及工程可控性和大规模生产的挑战。最后，我们概述了潜在的未來研究方向，建议将LLPS研究与多学科方法相结合，可能为解决这些挑战提供新策略和技术支持。
version:doi:10.1016/j.bioadv.2026.215292.sourceTitle: Bioinspired dynamic self-assembling condensates driven by liquid-liquid phase separation for therapeutic system innovation and applications: A review.
version:doi:10.1016/j.bioadv.2026.215292.sourceAbstract: Liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS), a key biophysical phenomenon in cellular physiology and pathology, profoundly influences cellular homeostasis and disease progression. Notably, the development of biomimetic intervention strategies based on LLPS principles has emerged as a frontier in disease therapy. This review systematically elucidated the molecular basis and regulatory networks of LLPS, with particular emphasis on its emerging applications in therapeutic development: (1) precise interventions targeting the dynamic properties of pathogenic condensates, offering breakthrough tools for tackling refractory diseases; (2) construction of next-generation responsive delivery platforms by harnessing phase transition and dynamic assembly properties, enabling spatiotemporally precise treatment; and (3) LLPS-powered intelligent biomimetic artificial cells, expanding the boundaries of synthetic biology. We further provided an in-depth analysis of urgent challenges, including decoding of LLPS core mechanisms, the difficulty in selectively distinguishing pathological from physiological condensates, the bottleneck of precise controllability in delivery systems, limited in vivo stability and immunogenicity data of LLPS-based delivery systems, and challenges in engineering controllability and large-scale production. Finally, we outlined potential future research directions, suggesting that integrating LLPS studies with multidisciplinary approaches could provide new strategies and technical support to address these challenges.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.05.764556:e.titleZh: 注释数据的选择显著影响基因组规模代谢网络的自动重建
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.05.764556:e.abstractZh: 基因组规模代谢模型是研究代谢的有力工具，应用于代谢工程或理解人类疾病等领域。然而，经过人工整理的模型仅适用于有限数量的生物体，为其他生物体生成高质量模型仍是一个挑战。为了应对这一挑战，已开发出几种软件工具，能够以自动化的方式产生初始模型，但这些初始模型的质量落后于人工整理的模型。因此，仍有必要改进这些工具。先前的工作主要侧重于开发重建过程中每一步（如基因注释和间隙填充）的更好方法。在此，我们关注支撑这些方法的数据基础，例如蛋白质序列与功能之间的已知联系。我们发现，改变重建数据的来源对生成的模型内容和预测有重大影响。事实上，数据来源的影响可能比重建方法的选择更大。此外，我们表明重建过程对重建数据中基因注释的准确性敏感。最后，我们证明了拥有与待建模生物体密切相关的生物体的功能注释数据的重要性。这些观察结果突出了重建数据的重要性，并确定了在选择重建工具数据时应考虑的原则。作者摘要：基因组规模代谢模型是研究细胞内发生的化学反应的有用工具。不幸的是，构建这些模型具有挑战性。过去的努力产生了可以自动化构建代谢模型的软件工具；然而，这些工具产生的模型质量仍然低于人工整理的模型。我们没有关注这些工具中的算法或方法，而是探讨了这些工具所依赖的数据（我们称之为“重建数据”）的重要性。我们表明，使用不同的重建数据构建模型对模型质量的影响可能比使用不同方法更大。此外，我们证明生成模型的质量既对数据的准确性敏感，也对数据中代表的生物体敏感。这些结果强调了重建数据的重要性，并表明更多地关注重建数据有可能大幅提高自动网络重建的质量。
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.05.764556:e.sourceTitle: Choice of annotation data significantly impacts automated reconstruction of genome-scale metabolic networks
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.05.764556:e.sourceAbstract: Genome-scale metabolic models are valuable tools for studying metabolism in many applications, such as metabolic engineering or understanding human disease. However, curated models are available for only a limited number of organisms, and generating high-quality models for additional organisms remains a challenge. To help address this challenge, several software tools have been developed that can produce draft models in an automated fashion, but the quality of these draft models lags behind manually curated ones. Thus, there is still a need to improve these tools. Previous work has focused primarily on developing better methods for each step in the reconstruction process, such as gene annotation and gap-filling. Here, we focus on the data that underlies these methods, such as known connections between protein sequence and function. We find that changing the source of reconstruction data has a substantial impact on the contents and predictions of generated models. In fact, the source of data can have a bigger impact than the choice of reconstruction method. Additionally, we show that the reconstruction process is sensitive to the accuracy of gene annotations in the reconstruction data. Finally, we demonstrate the importance of having functional annotation data from an organism that is closely related to the one for which a model is being built. These observations highlight the importance of reconstruction data and identify principles that should be considered when selecting data for reconstruction tools. Author Summary Genome-scale metabolic models are helpful tools for studying the chemical reactions that take place inside of cells. Unfortunately, building these models is challenging. Past efforts have produced software tools that can build metabolic models in an automated fashion; however, the quality of models produced by these tools is still lower than manually curated models. Rather than focusing on the algorithms or methods in these tools, we instead explore the importance of the data that these tools rely on, which we call “reconstruction data”. We show that building models with different reconstruction data can have a bigger impact on the quality of the models than using a different method. Additionally, we demonstrate that the quality of generated models is sensitive to both the accuracy of the data and the organisms that are represented in the data. These results emphasize the importance of reconstruction data and indicate that focusing more attention on reconstruction data has the potential to substantially improve the quality of automated network reconstruction.

version:doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11223342/v1.titleZh: 基于CRISPR的微生物细胞工厂代谢工程以实现可持续生物制造：对1000项研究（2012–2026）的系统分析
version:doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11223342/v1.abstractZh: 摘要 CRISPR基因组编辑与微生物代谢工程现已协同工作。这种配对以实际方式改变了可持续生物制造。本综述汇集了2012年至2026年间发表的1,000篇同行评审文章。这些文章来自201种期刊。我们绘制了该领域的演变轨迹、技术的多样化情况、研究人员偏好的宿主底盘、针对的产品类别以及研究工作的地理分布。我们的方法结合了文献计量学、特征工程和多元统计。其中包括主成分分析、层次聚类、共现网络分析和相关性映射。我们追踪了CRISPR变体景观、宿主底盘分布、产品类别优先级以及研究成果的地理集中度。时间分析显示了一种转变。早期工作探索了许多CRISPR变体。近期工作侧重于应用。每篇文章的平均CRISPR变体数量从2018年的2.42下降到2026年的1.40。我们的发现为该领域的发展方向提供了定量路线图。它们还指出了在非传统酵母、丝状真菌和蓝细菌宿主中进行可持续生物制造的新兴机会。
version:doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11223342/v1.sourceTitle: CRISPR-Based Metabolic Engineering of Microbial Cell Factories for Sustainable Bio manufacturing: A Systematic analysis of 1,000 Studies (2012–2026)
version:doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11223342/v1.sourceAbstract: Abstract CRISPR genome editing and microbial metabolic engineering now work hand in hand. That pairing has changed sustainable bio manufacturing in real ways. This review pulls together 1,000 peer-reviewed articles from 2012 to 2026. They come from 201 journals. We mapped how the field evolved, how the technology diversified, which host chassis researchers prefer, what product classes they target, and where in the world the work gets done. Our approach mixed bibliometric, feature engineering, and multivariate statistics. That includes principal component analysis, hierarchical clustering, co-occurrence network analysis, and correlation mapping. We tracked the CRISPR variant landscape, host chassis distribution, product class priorities, and geographic concentration of research output. The temporal analysis shows a shift. Early work explored many CRISPR variants. Recent work focuses on applications. Mean CRISPR variants per article dropped from 2.42 in 2018 to 1.40 in 2026. Our findings give a quantitative roadmap of where the field is heading. They also point to emerging opportunities in non-conventional yeast, filamentous fungi, and cyanobacterial chassis for sustainable bio manufacturing.

version:doi:10.1128/aem.01504-26:9ae6a52.titleZh: 调控一般应激反应影响近乎不分裂酵母培养物中的蛋白表达、能量经济性和异质性
version:doi:10.1128/aem.01504-26:9ae6a52.abstractZh: 当生长受营养限制时，微生物细胞会调整其生理状态，在生存与产生蛋白质的能力之间取得平衡。在此，我们通过比较参考菌株（ScNTi001）和∆msn2∆msn4突变体（ScNTm001）的保留培养物（retentostat cultures），其中比生长速率低于0.001 h⁻¹，研究了酿酒酵母的这种适应机制。我们表明，一般应激反应转录因子Msn2和Msn4对于在这种极端热量限制下维持能量效率和生存至关重要。它们的缺失增加了种群异质性并降低了活力，强调了其在单纯应激抗性之外的作用。为了理解（异源）蛋白表达动力学，我们监测了应激诱导型启动子（PHSP12）和组成型启动子（PTEF1）如何影响蛋白水平。PHSP12在中等至低生长速率下保持活性，但在低于0.001 h⁻¹时表达急剧下降，而PTEF1维持蛋白表达，其活性与特定葡萄糖摄取率相关而非生长速率。这种解耦揭示了一种权衡：尽管在∆msn2∆msn4缺失的情况下，PTEF1驱动的ymNeongreen特异性生产率高出70%，但整体产物产量低了13%。重要性：本研究展示了Msn2和Msn4如何在近零生长速率下的极端营养限制条件下控制细胞稳健性。它还指导了生长无关生产过程中的启动子选择策略。更广泛地说，本研究表明保留培养物可作为有价值的工具，用于剖析微生物细胞工厂中的应激反应途径、生存机制和生长无关表达系统。
version:doi:10.1128/aem.01504-26:9ae6a52.sourceTitle: Modulation of the general stress response impacts protein expression, energy economy, and heterogeneity in virtually non-dividing yeast cultures.
version:doi:10.1128/aem.01504-26:9ae6a52.sourceAbstract: Microbial cells adapt their physiology when growth is restricted by nutrient limitation, balancing survival with the capacity to produce proteins. Here, we investigated this adaptation in Saccharomyces cerevisiae by comparing retentostat cultures, in which specific growth rates reached below 0.001 h⁻¹, of a reference strain (ScNTi001) and a ∆ msn2 ∆ msn4 mutant (ScNTm001). We show that general stress-response transcription factors Msn2 and Msn4 are crucial for maintaining energy efficiency and for survival under this extreme calorie restriction. Their absence increased population heterogeneity and reduced viability, underscoring a role beyond merely stress resistance. To understand (heterologous) protein expression dynamics, we monitored how a stress-inducible promoter (P HSP12 ) and a constitutive promoter (P TEF1 ) impacted protein levels. The P HSP12 remained active at moderate to low growth rates, but expression sharply dropped below 0.001 h⁻¹, whereas the P TEF1 sustained protein expression, with activity linked to specific glucose uptake rates rather than growth rate. This decoupling revealed a trade-off: although P TEF1 -driven ymNeongreen-specific production rates were 70% higher in the absence of ∆ msn2 ∆ msn4 , overall product yields were 13% lower. Importance This study demonstrates how Msn2 and Msn4 govern cellular robustness under extreme nutrient-limited conditions at near-zero growth rates. It also guides promoter selection strategies for growth-independent production processes. More broadly, this study shows that retentostats can be used as a valuable tool to dissect stress-response pathways, survival mechanisms, and growth-independent expression systems in microbial cell factories.

version:doi:10.1039/d6np00071a:c6cdf905-.titleZh: 利用基因编码生物传感器读取和重编程微生物宿主中的天然产物生物合成
version:doi:10.1039/d6np00071a:c6cdf905-.abstractZh: 涵盖：2000年至2026年。天然产物（NPs）是具有结构多样性的生物活性分子，在制药、营养补充剂、化妆品和其他高价值领域有广泛应用。微生物细胞工厂为NP生产提供了可编程平台，但其性能往往受到动态瓶颈的限制，这些瓶颈难以从终点滴度中推断出来，包括前体或辅因子供应有限、有毒中间体积累、异源酶功能效率低下以及与宿主代谢的竞争。基因编码的生物传感器将NP分子、通路相关代谢物或细胞状态转化为可测量、可选择或调控的输出。在此，我们批判性地审视了生物传感器的设计原则，并区分了所检测的变量、识别模式、输出和实施格式。随后，我们评估了直接产物传感、通路状态监测、动态调控、酶筛选、全基因组扰动和生长偶联进化如何支持微生物NP工程。重点在于传感器输出与预期工程目标之间的对应关系。该框架阐明了生物传感器何时能为重编程NP产生微生物宿主提供可操作的信息。

question.text: 如何评估基因编码生物传感器在支持微生物天然产物工程中的应用，特别是其设计原则及输出与工程目标的对应关系？
question.evidence: Here, we critically examine biosensor design principles and distinguish the variable detected, recognition modality, output, and implementation format.

methods.text: 批判性审视生物传感器设计原则，区分检测变量、识别模式、输出和实施格式；评估直接产物传感、通路状态监测、动态调控、酶筛选、全基因组扰动和生长偶联进化等策略对微生物NP工程的支持作用。
methods.evidence: We then assess how direct product sensing, pathway-state monitoring, dynamic regulation, enzyme screening, genome-wide perturbation, and growth-coupled evolution can support microbial NP engineering.

findings.text: 明确了生物传感器何时能为重编程天然产物产生微生物宿主提供可操作的信息。
findings.evidence: This framework clarifies when biosensors can provide actionable information for rewiring NP-producing microbial hosts.

version:doi:10.1039/d6np00071a:c6cdf905-.sourceTitle: Reading and rewiring natural-product biosynthesis in microbial hosts with genetically encoded biosensors.
version:doi:10.1039/d6np00071a:c6cdf905-.sourceAbstract: Covering: 2000 to 2026Natural products (NPs) are structurally diverse bioactive molecules with broad applications in pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, cosmetics, and other high-value sectors. Microbial cell factories provide programmable platforms for NP production, but their performance is often constrained by dynamic bottlenecks that are not readily inferred from end-point titers, including limited precursor or cofactor supply, toxic intermediate accumulation, inefficient heterologous enzyme function, and competition with host metabolism. Genetically encoded biosensors translate NP molecules, pathway-relevant metabolites, or cellular states into measurable, selectable, or regulatory outputs. Here, we critically examine biosensor design principles and distinguish the variable detected, recognition modality, output, and implementation format. We then assess how direct product sensing, pathway-state monitoring, dynamic regulation, enzyme screening, genome-wide perturbation, and growth-coupled evolution can support microbial NP engineering. Emphasis is placed on the correspondence between sensor output and the intended engineering objective. This framework clarifies when biosensors can provide actionable information for rewiring NP-producing microbial hosts.

version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1362.titleZh: 通过工程化甲基营养菌（Methylorubrum extorquens）的适应性实验室进化鉴定出降低甲氧胺形成的巯基酶变体
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1362.abstractZh: 精简微生物中的代谢途径是代谢工程的关键策略，通常旨在引导进化走向可预测的结果。在此研究中，通过对甲基营养菌 PA1 理性工程化删除冗余的甲酸脱氢酶操纵子（fdh234），将适应性实验室进化聚焦于甲醇胁迫下剩余的甲酸氧化步骤。基因组测序显示，从一个进化群体中分离出的五个终点菌株均携带 MetY-1 Y57D 取代突变，而保留的甲酸脱氢酶操纵子未检测到突变。对纯化后的 MetY-1 进行的体外生化分析表明，Y57D 改变了相对于野生型酶的甲氧胺剂量反应关系；在 5% (v/v) 甲醇条件下，野生型酶积累了 0.386 ± 0.085 µM 甲氧胺，而 Y57D 变体的甲氧胺水平低于 0.025 µM 的检测限。使用 Ellman 试剂测量的等同于同半胱氨酸的硫醇信号在测试条件下对两种酶均可检测。这些结果支持在甲醇存在下 MetY-1 产物特异性的微调模型。这些发现将该特异性确定为可能减轻甲醇毒性的候选位点；本研究未测试 Y57D 取代对细胞生长的贡献。
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1362.sourceTitle: Reduced methoxine formation by a sulfhydrylase variant identified through adaptive laboratory evolution of engineered Methylorubrum extorquens.
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1362.sourceAbstract: Streamlining metabolic pathways in microbes is a key strategy in metabolic engineering, often intended to channel evolution toward predictable outcomes. Here, Methylorubrum extorquens PA1 was rationally engineered by deleting redundant formate dehydrogenase operons (fdh234) to focus adaptive laboratory evolution on the remaining formate oxidation step under methanol stress. Genome sequencing identified a MetY-1 Y57D substitution in all five endpoint isolates from one evolving population, while the retained formate dehydrogenase operon carried no detected mutation. In vitro biochemical assays with purified MetY-1 showed that Y57D shifted the methoxine dose-response relative to the wild-type enzyme; at 5% (v/v) methanol the wild-type enzyme accumulated 0.386 ± 0.085 µM methoxine, whereas methoxine remained below the 0.025 µM detection limit for Y57D. A homocysteine-equivalent thiol signal, measured with Ellman reagent, remained detectable for both enzymes under the tested conditions. These results support a fine-tuning model for the product specificity of MetY-1 under methanol. The findings identify this specificity as a candidate point at which methanol toxicity may be mitigated; the contribution of the Y57D substitution to cellular growth was not tested here.

version:doi:10.1016/j.ebiom.2026.106540:.titleZh: 衰老靶向工程化CAR-T免疫治疗：工程化衰老清除免疫治疗的进展、挑战与展望
version:doi:10.1016/j.ebiom.2026.106540:.abstractZh: 细胞衰老是慢性组织和组织退化的核心驱动因素。传统的分子衰老药物在消除异质性衰老细胞群时面临关键局限性，包括靶点特异性差和脱靶毒性。本综述系统讨论了衰老靶向的工程化嵌合抗原受体（CAR）-T免疫治疗，该疗法通过识别特定的表面标志物实现对病理性衰老细胞的靶向清除。它总结了靶抗原评估框架，分析了衰老免疫抑制微环境屏障及相应的工程化策略，并概述了复合疗效评估体系和分层生物标志物监测工作流程。还解决了关键的转化瓶颈，如抗原特异性不完善和免疫逃逸。临床前研究验证了器官功能恢复和健康寿命延长，而临床证据仍然有限。未来CAR-T技术与智能纳米载体、合成生物学和人工智能的整合将促进其在衰老相关疾病中的临床转化。
version:doi:10.1016/j.ebiom.2026.106540:.sourceTitle: Senescence-targeted engineered CAR-T immunotherapy: advances, challenges and perspectives for engineered senolytic immunotherapy.
version:doi:10.1016/j.ebiom.2026.106540:.sourceAbstract: Cellular senescence acts as a core driver of chronic diseases and tissue degeneration. Conventional small-molecule senolytics face critical limitations including poor target specificity and off-target toxicity when eliminating heterogeneous senescent cell populations. This review systematically discusses senescence-targeted engineered chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-T immunotherapy, which achieves targeted clearance of pathological senescent cells by recognising specific surface markers. It summarises target-antigen evaluation frameworks, analyzes aged immunosuppressive microenvironment barriers and corresponding engineering strategies, and outlines composite efficacy assessment systems and tiered biomarker-monitoring workflows. Key translational bottlenecks such as imperfect antigen specificity and immune escape are also addressed. Preclinical studies verify organ function restoration and healthspan extension, while clinical evidence remains limited. Future integration of CAR-T technology with smart nanocarriers, synthetic biology and artificial intelligence will promote its clinical translation for senescence-associated disorders.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.07.765054:2.titleZh: 靶向缺失揭示先前未表征的C1固定簇基因为Clostridium autoethanogenum自养生长的必需因素
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.07.765054:2.abstractZh: 利用气体发酵从工业尾气和气化有机废物中回收碳氧化物，为燃料和化学品的生物制造提供了可持续的途径。乙酸生成菌在此方面是具有吸引力的生物催化剂，它们通过Wood-Ljungdahl通路（WLP）固定CO和CO2。然而，相关C1固定基因簇的功能注释不完整限制了乙酸生成菌细胞工厂的理性工程改造。在此，我们研究了五个高度保守但先前未表征的C1固定簇基因，通过靶向CRISPR/Cas9介导的单基因缺失、生理表征、比较计算结构分析、CRISPRi和功能基因组学，量化了它们对模式乙酸生成菌Clostridium autoethanogenum生长的贡献。重要的是，我们鉴定出acsV、lpdA、cooC和cooC2是自养生长所必需的，但对异养生长非必需，而gcvH的缺失降低了自养生长并将碳通量从乙酸转向2,3-丁二醇。氨基酸补充实验和计算分析表明，lpdA和gcvH主要不在甘氨酸或丝氨酸生物合成中发挥作用，而是在与WLP相关的C1和氧化还原代谢中发挥特殊作用。此外，遗传和生理分析显示，两个CooC家族ATP酶CooC和CooC2在生长中具有非冗余作用，只有cooC2的缺失损害了异养生长。乙酸补充测试显示，ΔacsV细胞尽管自养能力丧失但仍保留代谢活性，计算分析提示acsV可能在依赖ATP的钴胺素激活中发挥作用。令人惊讶的是，CRISPRi介导的acsV抑制受到翻译缓冲，导致碳分配改变但未损害自养生长。总之，我们的研究结果为乙酸生成菌中C1固定簇基因的生理重要性提供了见解，并支持将其作为气体发酵细胞工厂进行代谢工程改造。
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.07.765054:2.sourceTitle: Targeted Deletions Uncover Previously Uncharacterised C 1 -fixing Cluster Genes as Essential for Autotrophy in Clostridium autoethanogenum
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.07.765054:2.sourceAbstract: Recycling carbon oxides from industrial off-gases and gasified organic waste using gas fermentation offers a sustainable route for biomanufacturing of fuels and chemicals. Acetogens are attractive biocatalysts here and fix CO and CO 2 via the Wood-Ljungdahl pathway (WLP). However, the incomplete functional annotation of the associated C 1 -fixing gene cluster limits rational engineering of acetogen cell factories. Here, we investigated five highly conserved but previously uncharacterised C 1 -fixing cluster genes to quantify their contributions to the growth of the model-acetogen Clostridium autoethanogenum using targeted CRISPR/Cas9-mediated single-gene deletions, physiological characterisation, comparative computational structural analyses, CRISPRi, and functional genomics. Importantly, we identified acsV , lpdA , cooC, and cooC2 as essential for autotrophy but not heterotrophy, whereas deletion of gcvH reduced autotrophic growth and shifted carbon flux from acetate towards 2,3-butanediol. Amino acid supplementation experiments and computational analyses indicate that lpdA and gcvH do not primarily function in glycine or serine biosynthesis but instead fulfil specialised roles in WLP-associated C 1 and redox metabolism. Furthermore, genetic and physiological analyses showed that the two CooC-family ATPases, CooC and CooC2, have non-redundant roles in growth, with only cooC2 deletion impairing heterotrophy. Acetate supplementation tests revealed that Δ acsV cells retained metabolic activity despite abolished autotrophy, and computational analyses suggest a likely role for acsV in ATP-dependent corrinoid activation. Surprisingly, CRISPRi-mediated repression of acsV was translationally buffered, resulting in altered carbon partitioning without impairing autotrophy. Together, our findings provide insights into the physiological importance of the C 1 -fixing cluster genes in acetogens and support their metabolic engineering as gas-fermenting cell factories.

version:doi:10.1016/j.plaphy.2026.111946.titleZh: 利用植物氧化还原网络和细菌调控实现下一代作物非生物胁迫韧性
version:doi:10.1016/j.plaphy.2026.111946.abstractZh: 干旱、盐渍、重金属、高温和低温等非生物胁迫会破坏细胞氧化还原稳态，导致活性氧（ROS）过度产生和氧化损伤，从而对植物生长和生产力产生负面影响。在受控条件下，较低水平的ROS作为信号分子发挥作用，而在存在生物和非生物胁迫因素时，升高水平的ROS会导致细胞损伤。本综述批判性地考察了植物中氧化还原稳态涉及的分子机制，包括酶促和非酶促抗氧化系统。进一步讨论了植物激素信号传导和植物促生菌（PGPB）在调节ROS代谢、增强抗氧化能力和提高非生物胁迫耐受性方面的综合角色。通过评估转录调控、表观遗传修饰和氧化还原相关调控网络方面的最新进展，提供了植物胁迫适应的机制见解。此外，我们回顾了多组学方法在理解氧化还原调节以及识别参与胁迫韧性的关键分子成分方面的贡献。最后，探讨了合成生物学和人工智能作为工程化氧化还原调控网络以加速气候韧性作物开发的潜在工具的新兴应用。总体而言，本综述提供了一个整合的机制框架，概述了如何将氧化还原生物学、PGPB相互作用和下一代工程策略相结合，以在未来环境变化下增强作物韧性和可持续农业生产力。
version:doi:10.1016/j.plaphy.2026.111946.sourceTitle: Harnessing plant redox networks and bacterial modulation for next-generation abiotic stress resilience in crops.
version:doi:10.1016/j.plaphy.2026.111946.sourceAbstract: Abiotic stresses such as drought, salinity, heavy metals, heat, and cold disrupt cellular redox homeostasis, resulting in the excessive production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) and oxidative damage that negatively affect plant growth and productivity. Under controlled conditions, lower level of ROS act as signaling molecule, whereas, at elevated levels with biotic and abiotic stress factors, causes cellular damage. This review critically examines the molecular mechanisms involved in redox homeostasis in plants, including both enzymatic and non-enzymatic antioxidant systems. The integrated roles of phytohormone signaling and plant growth-promoting bacteria (PGPB) in regulating ROS metabolism, boosting antioxidant capacity, and enhancing abiotic stress tolerance are further discussed. Mechanistic insights into plant stress adaptation are provided by evaluating recent advances in transcriptional regulation, epigenetic modification, and redox-associated regulatory networks. Moreover, we review the contributions of multi-omics approaches toward understanding redox regulation and identifying key molecular components involved in stress resilience. Finally, emerging applications of synthetic biology and artificial intelligence are explored as potential tools for engineering redox regulatory networks to accelerate the development of climate-resilient crops. Overall, this review provides an integrated mechanistic framework outlining how redox biology, PGPB interactions, and next-generation engineering strategies can be combined to enhance crop resilience and sustainable agricultural productivity under future environmental shifts.

version:doi:10.1039/d6ra09938f:cb5a547e-.titleZh: 合成生物学前沿：用于下一代癌症治疗和基因递送的工程化溶瘤病毒和病毒载体
version:doi:10.1039/d6ra09938f:cb5a547e-.abstractZh: 病毒不再仅仅被用作天然存在的基因转移工具或粗放的细胞溶解剂。研究人员正在重写其基因组、衣壳、嗜性、调控元件和有效载荷，以创建能够感知疾病、执行条件程序并重塑病理组织的治疗系统。在肿瘤学中，工程化溶瘤病毒（OVs）可以将肿瘤选择性复制与免疫原性细胞死亡、抗原释放和局部免疫刺激相结合。与此同时，病毒载体工程，特别是AAV和LV，正在解决基因递送的核心局限性：预存中和抗体的普遍存在、全身给药和重复给药的困难（AAV），以及体外细胞治疗的制造瓶颈（LV）。临床记录令人鼓舞但不均衡：T-VEC表明，工程化的单纯疱疹病毒可以改善选定黑色素瘤病变的持久反应，而G47Δ/teserpaturev和新的武装HSV平台为难治性实体瘤提供了可行性、安全性和偶尔持久反应的证据。基于慢病毒载体的体内CAR-T细胞生成，以KLN-1010/inMMyCAR和相关首次人体试验项目为例，标志着远离体外制造的范式转变。然而，更广泛的领域尚未将其大量的临床前文献转化为比例相当的具有临床意义且可全身部署的药物。主要瓶颈仍然是递送、肿瘤异质性、免疫清除、次优的药效学生物标志物、制造复杂性、耐药性以及证明具有延迟或免疫介导效应产品的益处之困难。本综述通过一个统一的工程框架考察用于可编程病毒疗法的合成生物学工具包，该框架按设计原则而非按载体类别整合OVs、AAV和LVs。我们讨论了肿瘤选择性启动子、microRNA去靶向、重定向衣壳和配体、减毒、全基因组组装、免疫刺激有效载荷、双特异性和三特异性接合器、逻辑门控电路、安全开关、血清差异AAV衣壳、仿生伪装、细胞载体、生物材料递送系统以及体内CAR-T生成。我们的中心论点是，下一代病毒药物将不是由最复杂的基因组来选择的，而是由五个可衡量的成功因素的最连贯对齐来选择：肿瘤选择性、免疫重塑、递送和生物分布、可控安全性和可制造性。因此，新兴的范式是可编程病毒疗法：旨在在人肿瘤和人类免疫的限制内运行的环境敏感型生物药物。
version:doi:10.1039/d6ra09938f:cb5a547e-.sourceTitle: The synthetic biology frontier: engineered oncolytic viruses and viral vectors for next-generation cancer therapy and gene delivery.
version:doi:10.1039/d6ra09938f:cb5a547e-.sourceAbstract: Viruses are no longer used merely as naturally occurring tools for gene transfer or as blunt cytolytic agents. Researchers are rewriting their genomes, capsids, tropisms, regulatory elements, and payloads to create therapeutic systems that sense disease, execute conditional programs, and remodel pathological tissue. In oncology, engineered oncolytic viruses (OVs) can combine tumor-selective replication with immunogenic cell death, antigen release, and local immune stimulation. In parallel, viral-vector engineering, particularly AAV and LVs, is addressing central limitations of gene delivery: the prevalence of pre-existing neutralizing antibodies, the difficulty of systemic administration and repeat dosing (AAV), and the manufacturing bottleneck of ex vivo cell therapies (LV). The clinical record is encouraging but uneven: T-VEC has shown that an engineered herpes simplex virus can improve durable responses in selected melanoma lesions, while G47Δ/teserpaturev and newer armed HSV platforms provide evidence of feasibility, safety, and occasional durable responses in difficult solid tumors. Lentiviral vector-based in vivo CAR-T cell generation, exemplified by KLN-1010/inMMyCAR and related first-in-human programs, signals a paradigm shift away from ex vivo manufacturing. However, the broader field has not converted its large preclinical literature into a proportional number of clinically meaningful, systemically deployable medicines. The main bottlenecks remain delivery, tumor heterogeneity, immune clearance, suboptimal pharmacodynamic biomarkers, manufacturing complexity, resistance, and the difficulty of proving benefit for products with delayed or immunologically mediated effects. This review examines the synthetic biology toolkit for programmable viral therapeutics through a unified engineering framework that integrates OVs, AAV, and LVs by design principle rather than by vector class. We discuss tumor-selective promoters, microRNA detargeting, retargeted capsids and ligands, attenuation, genome-scale assembly, immune-stimulatory payloads, bispecific and trispecific engagers, logic-gated circuits, safety switches, serodivergent AAV capsids, biomimetic cloaking, cell carriers, biomaterial delivery systems, and in vivo CAR-T generation. Our central thesis is that the next generation of viral medicines will be selected not by the most elaborate genome, but by the most coherent alignment of five measurable success factors: tumor selectivity, immune remodeling, delivery and biodistribution, controllable safety, and manufacturability. The emerging paradigm is therefore programmable viral therapeutics: context-sensitive biological medicines designed to operate within the constraints of human tumors and human immunity.

version:doi:10.1039/d6sc05584b:a0f77f4f-.titleZh: 从CO2和N2解偶联电生物合成高价值生物产品
version:doi:10.1039/d6sc05584b:a0f77f4f-.abstractZh: 将大气中的二氧化碳（CO2）和氮气（N2）转化为高价值生物产品，为可持续化学、食品和材料生产提供了一条有希望的途径。然而，现有方法仍受限于狭窄的产品范围、低效的生物固定以及较差的可扩展性。在此，我们提出了一种空间解偶联的电生物系统，该系统将CO2和N2转化为γ-聚谷氨酸（γ-PGA），同时共生成具有细胞蛋白增值潜力的微生物生物量。Cu-N2单原子催化剂和等离子体过程从CO2和N2生成甲烷和硝酸盐，提供高度还原的碳源和氧化氮源。工程化甲烷营养菌异源表达γ-PGA生物合成基因，被设计用于将甲烷和硝酸盐转化为分子量高达700 kDa的γ-PGA。对碳、氮和能量通量的系统优化使30 L生物反应器中的γ-PGA滴度提高了125%，达到142.84 mg L-1，同时伴随产生9.47 g L-1的细胞蛋白。重要的是，模块化设计允许根据生物模块测得的碳、氮和氧需求调整电催化和等离子体辅助单元的产出，从而支持空间解偶联系统中的供需匹配。技术经济分析和生命周期评估分别确定了工艺经济性的关键决定因素并指出了该电生物系统的潜在环境效益。本研究展示了一个用于高价值生物产品生产解偶联平台，为工艺放大提供了模块化基础，并推动了基于空气的、可定制的从CO2和N2进行的生物制造。
version:doi:10.1039/d6sc05584b:a0f77f4f-.sourceTitle: Decoupled electro-biosynthesis of high-value bioproducts from CO 2 and N 2 .
version:doi:10.1039/d6sc05584b:a0f77f4f-.sourceAbstract: The conversion of atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) and nitrogen (N 2 ) into high-value bioproducts offers a promising pathway for sustainable chemistry, food, and material production. However, existing approaches remain constrained by narrow product scopes, inefficient biological fixation, and poor scalability. Here, we present a spatially decoupled electro-biosystem that converts CO 2 and N 2 into poly-γ-glutamic acid (γ-PGA), while co-generating microbial biomass with cell-protein valorization potential. A Cu-N 2 single-atom catalyst and plasma processes generate methane and nitrate from CO 2 and N 2 , providing highly reduced carbon and oxidized nitrogen sources. The engineered methanotrophs heterologously expressing γ-PGA biosynthesis genes were designed to convert methane and nitrate into γ-PGA with a molecular weight of up to 700 kDa. Systematic optimization of carbon, nitrogen, and energy fluxes boosted γ-PGA titer by 125% to 142.84 mg L -1 in a 30 L bioreactor, accompanied by 9.47 g L -1 of cell protein. Importantly, the modular design allows the outputs of the electrocatalytic and plasma-assisted units to be adjusted according to the measured carbon, nitrogen, and oxygen demands of the biological module, thereby supporting supply-demand matching across the spatially decoupled system. Techno-economic analysis and life-cycle assessment identify key determinants of process economics and indicate the potential environmental benefits of the electro-biosystem, respectively. This study demonstrates a decoupled platform for high-value bioproduct production, providing a modular basis for process scale-up and advancing customizable, air-derived biomanufacturing from CO 2 and N 2 .

version:doi:10.1038/s44355-026-00084-w:a.titleZh: 胆汁酸代谢紊乱与微生物菌群失调在儿童炎症性肠病中并发艰难梭菌感染
version:doi:10.1038/s44355-026-00084-w:a.abstractZh: 儿童炎症性肠病（IBD）患者发生艰难梭菌感染（CDI）的风险增加。本综述强调，由肠道微生物群失调和次级胆汁酸微生物产生减少驱动的胆汁酸代谢紊乱，是将儿童IBD与CDI易感性增加联系起来的关键因素。我们考察了IBD、菌群失调、胆汁酸代谢和C. difficile之间的相互作用，并讨论了旨在恢复胆汁酸稳态的基于微生物组的新兴干预措施。
version:doi:10.1038/s44355-026-00084-w:a.sourceTitle: Bile acid dysmetabolism and microbial dysbiosis coincide with Clostridioides difficile infection in pediatric inflammatory bowel disease.
version:doi:10.1038/s44355-026-00084-w:a.sourceAbstract: Pediatric inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) patients are at increased risk for Clostridioides difficile infection. This review highlights bile acid dysmetabolism, driven by gut microbiota dysbiosis and reduced microbial production of secondary bile acids, as a key factor linking pediatric IBD to increased CDI susceptibility. We examine interactions among IBD, dysbiosis, bile acid metabolism, and C. difficile , and discuss emerging microbiome-based interventions aimed at restoring bile acid homeostasis.

version:doi:10.1016/j.synbio.2026.09.005.titleZh: 一个涉及内质网-脂滴界面动态玉米黄质生物合成的生物合成悖论
version:doi:10.1016/j.synbio.2026.09.005.abstractZh: 传统代谢工程通常将脂滴（LDs）视为惰性储存库，并假设缩短酶与底物的距离固有地提高通路效率。利用耶氏酵母生产玉米黄质，我们揭示了一个挑战这一传统教条的关键“空间悖论”。选择性屏蔽策略首先鉴定出羟化酶Pa CrtZ是主要的生物合成瓶颈。亚细胞定位试验显示，直接将Pa CrtZ靶向富含β-胡萝卜素的LD表面意外产生了最低的玉米黄质相对比例（9.87%），显著低于胞质（27.15%）或过氧化物酶体靶向（43.16%）。为了调查这一反直觉现象，实施了多维工程策略以提高玉米黄质积累。随后，原位无标记受激拉曼散射（SRS）显微镜明确证明了β-胡萝卜素和玉米黄质在LD内的共定位，证实了底物不可接近性并非限制因素。在LD生物发生原理的指引下，这些发现使我们构想出一个动态的内质网（ER）-LD界面功能微环境模型。我们提出，稳健的Pa CrtZ催化羟化作用主要在瞬态ER-LD连接处维持，在那里疏水性β-胡萝卜素“掠取”与高效的O2和NADPH辅因子交换动态同步。该模型重新定义了脂质细胞器不仅是储存库，而是活跃的、有组织的代谢枢纽，为未来的细胞器靶向代谢界面设计提供了一个新颖的变革性框架。
version:doi:10.1016/j.synbio.2026.09.005.sourceTitle: A biosynthetic paradox implicating dynamic zeaxanthin biosynthesis at the ER-LD interface.
version:doi:10.1016/j.synbio.2026.09.005.sourceAbstract: Traditional metabolic engineering often treats lipid droplets (LDs) as inert storage sinks and assumes shortening enzyme-substrate distance inherently enhances pathway efficiency. Harnessing Yarrowia lipolytica for zeaxanthin production, we uncovered a pivotal "spatial paradox" challenging this conventional dogma. A selective shielding strategy first identified the hydroxylase Pa CrtZ as the primary biosynthetic bottleneck. Subcellular localization trials revealed that directly targeting Pa CrtZ to the β-carotene-rich LD surface unexpectedly yielded the lowest zeaxanthin relative fraction (9.87%), significantly underperforming compared to cytosolic (27.15%) or peroxisomal targeting (43.16%). To investigate this counterintuitive phenomenon, multidimensional engineering strategies were implemented to boost zeaxanthin accumulation. Subsequently, in situ , label-free stimulated Raman scattering (SRS) microscopy unequivocally demonstrated the co-localization of β-carotene and zeaxanthin within LDs, confirming that substrate inaccessibility was not the limiting factor. Guided by principles of LD biogenesis, these findings led us to conceptualize a dynamic endoplasmic reticulum (ER)-LD interface functional microenvironment model. We propose that robust Pa CrtZ-catalyzed hydroxylation is sustained predominantly at transient ER-LD junctions, where hydrophobic β-carotene "skimming" is dynamically synchronized with efficient O 2 and NADPH cofactor exchange. This model redefines lipid organelles as active, organized metabolic hubs beyond mere storage, offering a novel transformative framework for future organelle-targeted metabolic interface design.

version:doi:10.1128/aem.01631-26:5c6046d.titleZh: 通过单菌株一步发酵实现可持续的2-酮基-L-古龙酸生物合成
version:doi:10.1128/aem.01631-26:5c6046d.abstractZh: L-抗坏血酸（维生素C）是一种维持人体正常生理功能的重要抗氧化分子。目前，工业上主要依赖三菌种两步发酵工艺生产维生素C的直接前体2-酮基-L-古龙酸（2-KLG）。随后，2-KLG通过化学内酯化转化为维生素C。然而，该过程受到发酵周期长、混合培养系统稳定性差以及工艺控制复杂等限制。近年来，能够进行一步法2-KLG生物合成的工程化单菌株平台已成为更可持续的维生素C生产的一种有前景的策略。尽管如此，该系统中的L-山梨醇至2-KLG转化效率仍然较低，这是进一步提高2-KLG产量的主要瓶颈。本综述总结了以氧化葡萄糖酸杆菌（Gluconobacter oxydans）为底盘菌株的单菌株一步发酵系统的最新进展。重点介绍了包括遗传工具开发、代谢工程和关键酶优化在内的策略。旨在为优化和维生素C绿色生物制造系统的工业化提供理论基础和技术参考。
version:doi:10.1128/aem.01631-26:5c6046d.sourceTitle: Sustainable 2-keto-L-gulonic acid biosynthesis via single-strain one-step fermentation.
version:doi:10.1128/aem.01631-26:5c6046d.sourceAbstract: L-ascorbic acid (vitamin C) is an essential antioxidant molecule that maintains normal physiological functions in humans. Currently, industrial production relies primarily on a three-strain, two-step fermentation process to produce 2-keto-L-gulonic acid (2-KLG), the direct precursor of vitamin C. 2-KLG is then converted to vitamin C through chemical lactonization. However, this process is limited by prolonged fermentation cycles, poor stability of the mixed-culture system, and complex process control. In recent years, engineered single-strain platforms capable of one-step 2-KLG biosynthesis have emerged as a promising strategy for more sustainable vitamin C production. Nevertheless, the efficiency of L-sorbose-to-2-KLG conversion in this system remains low, making it a major bottleneck to further improving 2-KLG production. This review summarizes recent advances on single-strain, one-step fermentation systems using Gluconobacter oxydans as the chassis strain. It focuses on strategies including genetic tool development, metabolic engineering, and key enzyme optimization. The review aims to provide a theoretical basis and technical reference for optimizing and industrializing green biomanufacturing systems for vitamin C.

version:doi:10.1093/nar/gkag1121:2964142.titleZh: YEASTRACT+：2026年更新，聚焦全球定量转录调控数据与代谢工程应用
version:doi:10.1093/nar/gkag1121:2964142.abstractZh: YEASTRACT+（http://yeastract-plus.org/）是一种用于分析和预测酵母基因及基因组水平上转录调控数据的工具。它整合了三个数据库：YEASTRACT、PathoYeastract和NCYeastract，分别专注于酿酒酵母、致病性酵母以及具有生物技术相关性的非传统酵母。在此次更新中，YEASTRACT+提供了13种酵母物种的升级转录调控信息，将数据库扩展至担子菌门的两种额外酵母——致病性酵母Cryptococcus neoformans和具有生物技术重要性的Rhodotorula toruloides。所提供数据的质量发生了显著升级，因为转录因子（TFs）与靶基因之间的调控关联现在与定量评估相关联。转录因子对基因表达水平的定量影响促成了两个额外分析工具的构建和发布：基于转录因子的定量排名，用于预测给定转录组数据集背后最相关的转录因子；以及基于将转录因子表达的定量影响整合到全基因组规模代谢模型中的代谢工程方法。综上所述，此次发布的YEASTRACT+提供了对13种酵母物种中与基因表达控制相关的海量、经过策展的定量数据的无与伦比的访问权限，并提供了一套工具以支持其在基础、生物技术和健康相关应用中的充分利用。
version:doi:10.1093/nar/gkag1121:2964142.sourceTitle: YEASTRACT+: the 2026 update with focus on global quantitative transcription regulation data and metabolic engineering applications.
version:doi:10.1093/nar/gkag1121:2964142.sourceAbstract: YEASTRACT+ (http://yeastract-plus.org/) is a tool for the analysis, prediction, and modelling of transcription regulatory data at gene and genomic levels in yeasts. It incorporates three integrated databases: YEASTRACT, PathoYeastract, and NCYeastract, focused on Saccharomyces cerevisiae, pathogenic yeasts, and non-conventional yeasts of biotechnological relevance, respectively. In this release, YEASTRACT+ offers upgraded information on transcription regulation for 13 yeast species, extending the database to two additional yeasts of the basidiomycota phylum, the pathogenic yeast Cryptococcus neoformans, and the biotechnologically relevant Rhodotorula toruloides. A dramatic upgrade in the quality of the data provided occurred, as regulatory associations between transcription factors (TFs) and target genes are now associated with quantitative assessment. Quantitative impact of TFs on gene expression levels enabled the construction and release of two additional analytical tools: quantitative rank by TF, for the prediction of the most relevant TFs underlying a given transcriptomics dataset; and metabolic engineering based on integrating the quantitative impact of TF expression into genome-scale metabolic models. Altogether, this release of YEASTRACT+ provides unparalleled access to massive, curated, quantitative data associated with gene expression control in 13 yeast species, and a set of tools to enable its full exploitation towards fundamental, biotechnological, and health-related applications.

version:doi:10.1039/d6ay01815g:27eb1dfc-.titleZh: 基于拉曼/SERS的液滴微流控中的鉴定、分选与验证：生物制造中的潜力与挑战
version:doi:10.1039/d6ay01815g:27eb1dfc-.abstractZh: 高通量微生物代谢物检测和筛选支持菌株开发及生物制造中的设计-构建-测试-学习（DBTL）循环。液滴微流控为检测、分选和回收提供了独立的微反应器，但可靠的筛选还需要准确的鉴定、受控分离和独立验证。本综述讨论了含细胞和不含细胞的液滴、检测方法、表面增强拉曼散射（SERS）与液滴微流控的整合、发酵基质效应、拉曼激活的细胞和液滴分选以及性能评估。SERS通过分子指纹或特定识别系统提供信号以告知分选决策。然而，热点、探针状态、基质成分、液滴位置和采集条件会影响绝对强度，使得在没有充分校准的情况下，单次测量无法用于定量。内部标准、基质匹配校准以及对含有相同样本的液滴信号进行平均可以提高定量的可靠性，而高效液相色谱（HPLC）、液质联用（LC-MS）或功能测定可以提供分选后的独立验证。许多成熟的微液滴SERS演示使用标准品或生物医学模型；在真正的发酵样本和含细胞液滴中完成检测、分选和验证工作流程的研究仍然有限。围绕目标鉴定、物理分选和分选后验证，本综述评估了信号通量权衡、基质兼容性、检测-分选时机和不一致的评估标准。讨论了一条从模型液滴到发酵样本和含细胞液滴的分阶段验证路径。通过将发酵基质效应、分选可靠性和独立验证联系起来，本综述有助于识别筛选错误的来源，并评估这些方法在生物制造中的潜力和局限性。
version:doi:10.1039/d6ay01815g:27eb1dfc-.sourceTitle: Raman/SERS-based identification, sorting and validation in droplet microfluidics: potential and challenges for biomanufacturing.
version:doi:10.1039/d6ay01815g:27eb1dfc-.sourceAbstract: High-throughput microbial metabolite detection and screening support strain development and the design-build-test-learn (DBTL) cycle in biomanufacturing. Droplet microfluidics provides independent microreactors for detection, sorting and recovery, but reliable screening also requires accurate identification, controlled separation and independent validation. This review discusses cell-laden and non-cell-laden droplets, detection methods, integration of surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) with droplet microfluidics, fermentation-matrix effects, Raman-activated cell and droplet sorting, and performance assessment. SERS provides signals through molecular fingerprints or specific recognition systems to inform sorting decisions. However, hot spots, probe state, matrix composition, droplet position and acquisition conditions affect absolute intensity, making single measurements unreliable for quantification without adequate calibration. Internal standards, matrix-matched calibration and averaging signals from droplets containing the same sample can improve quantitative reliability, while HPLC, LC-MS or functional assays can provide independent post-sorting validation. Many well-developed microdroplet SERS demonstrations use standards or biomedical models; complete detection, sorting and validation workflows in genuine fermentation samples and cell-laden droplets remain limited. Organised around target identification, physical sorting and post-sorting validation, this review evaluates the signal-throughput trade-off, matrix compatibility, detection-sorting timing and inconsistent evaluation criteria. A staged validation route from model droplets to fermentation samples and cell-laden droplets is discussed. By linking fermentation-matrix effects, sorting reliability and independent validation, the review helps identify sources of screening errors and assess the potential and limitations of these approaches in biomanufacturing.

version:doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11228-6:7.titleZh: 一种用于自主生物分子操作的AI原生实验实验室
version:doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11228-6:7.abstractZh: 开发具有最少人类干预的自主科学探索能力的AI原生实验实验室是一个长期目标。尽管自主实验系统正在出现，尤其是在化学和材料科学领域，但它们主要局限于具有单一目标、明确工作流程和简单仪器的领域。这种限制可能反映了“附加”架构，即把AI用作特定任务工具，而不是赋予其对实验的全局理解，特别是在以工程为导向的情况下。在此，我们展示了AutoDNA，这是一个面向跨多种仪器多目标实验的AI原生自主生物分子工程实验室。通过模型、实验和仪器的协同设计，AutoDNA在端到端的多用户框架内实现了AI与自动化系统的协同进化。该系统自主协调20多种类型的仪器，执行超过11,000个步骤，以执行核心核酸操作，包括合成、转录、扩增和测序，而人类干预仅限于硬件维护任务，如试剂和实验耗材的补充。在四个代表性应用中，AutoDNA达到了专家优化的酶促DNA合成产率，将并发协议执行的加速了3.2倍，完成了端到端的DNA数据存储周期并精确恢复了原始数字内容，以及识别并验证了一种临床检测到的KRAS G13D突变。AutoDNA为“科学即服务”建立了蓝图，加速了生物学发现并推进了合成生物学和信息存储的各种应用。
version:doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11228-6:7.sourceTitle: An AI-native experimental laboratory for autonomous biomolecular operations.
version:doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11228-6:7.sourceAbstract: Developing artificial intelligence (AI)-native experimental laboratories for autonomous scientific exploration with minimal human intervention represents a long-standing goal. Although autonomous experimental systems are emerging 1-4 , especially in chemical and materials science, they remain largely confined to domains with singular objectives, well-defined workflows and simple instrumentation. This limitation may reflect an 'add-on' architecture that uses AI as a task-specific tool rather than providing it with a global understanding of experiments, especially under engineering-oriented circumstances. Here we present AutoDNA, an AI-native autonomous biomolecular engineering laboratory targeting multi-objective experiments across diverse instruments. Through the co-design of models, experiments and instruments, AutoDNA realizes the co-evolution of AI and the automation system within an end-to-end multi-user framework. The system autonomously orchestrates over 20 types of instruments across more than 11,000 steps to execute core nucleic acid operations including synthesis, transcription, amplification and sequencing, while human intervention is limited to hardware maintenance tasks, such as reagent and labware replenishment. Across four representative applications, AutoDNA matched expert-optimized enzymatic DNA synthesis yields, accelerated concurrent protocol execution by 3.2-fold, completed an end-to-end DNA data storage cycle with exact recovery of the original digital content, and identified and validated a clinically detected KRAS G13D mutation. AutoDNA establishes a blueprint towards science-as-a-service, accelerating biological discovery and advancing various applications in synthetic biology and information storage.

version:doi:10.1007/s00203-026-05273-y:e.titleZh: 芽孢杆菌介导的硒纳米颗粒生物合成：还原途径、细胞过程和应用的综述
version:doi:10.1007/s00203-026-05273-y:e.abstractZh: 硒纳米颗粒（SeNPs）因其独特的理化性质、相比无机硒化合物的低毒性以及多样的生物活性而引起了极大兴趣。微生物，特别是芽孢杆菌属物种，由于其对硒氧阴离子的耐受性以及在中温条件下将亚硒酸盐 Se(IV) 还原为元素硒 (Se0) 的能力，代表了高效的 SeNP 合成生物平台。本综述总结了关于芽孢杆菌介导 SeNP 生物合成的当前知识，重点在于微生物硒转化、细胞反应以及涉及纳米颗粒形成的生化过程。对与氧化还原相关的途径、还原当量、候选酶、代谢物和胞外生物分子在硒还原、成核和稳定中的作用进行了批判性讨论，同时强调了当前机制理解的局限性以及对进一步遗传验证的需求。此外，本综述考察了细菌菌株特征和培养条件如何影响 SeNP 的特性，包括粒径、表面化学、稳定性和生物活性。讨论了芽孢杆菌衍生的 SeNPs 的应用，包括抗菌、抗氧化、抗癌、农业和环境应用，并与纳米颗粒特性和生物性能相关联。在整个综述中，证据明确归因于相关来源系统，区分了芽孢杆菌衍生、其他微生物、化学合成、植物衍生和一般 SeNP 文献。目前关于芽孢杆菌介导 SeNPs 的生物医学证据主要基于体外研究。最后，突出了通过菌株选择、代谢工程化和工艺优化来改善微生物 SeNP 生产的新方法。本综述为芽孢杆菌介导 SeNP 生物合成提供了综合视角，确定了未来的研究方向，并为微生物学、生物工艺工程、动物营养学和农业生物技术领域的研究人员提供了见解。
version:doi:10.1007/s00203-026-05273-y:e.sourceTitle: Bacillus-mediated selenium nanoparticle biosynthesis: reduction pathways, cellular processes, and applications.
version:doi:10.1007/s00203-026-05273-y:e.sourceAbstract: Selenium nanoparticles (SeNPs) have attracted considerable interest due to their unique physicochemical properties, low toxicity compared with inorganic selenium (Se) compounds, and diverse biological activities. Microorganisms, particularly species of the genus Bacillus, represent efficient biological platforms for SeNP synthesis because of their tolerance to selenium oxyanions and their ability to reduce selenite Se (IV) to elemental selenium (Se 0 ) under mild conditions. Selenate-reduction is relatively poorly understood in this genus, so the candidate selenate-reductase system proposed here is inferred from selenium-respiring organisms and has not been genetically confirmed in Bacillus. This review summarizes current knowledge on Bacillus-mediated SeNP biosynthesis with an emphasis on microbial selenium transformation, cellular responses, and biochemical processes involved in nanoparticle formation. The roles of redox-associated pathways, reducing equivalents, candidate enzymes, metabolites, and extracellular biomolecules in selenium reduction, nucleation, and stabilization are critically discussed, while highlighting the limitations of current mechanistic understanding and the need for further genetic validation. In addition, this review examines how bacterial strain characteristics and cultivation conditions influence SeNP properties, including particle size, surface chemistry, stability, and biological activity. The applications of Bacillus-derived SeNPs, including antimicrobial, antioxidant, anticancer, agricultural, and environmental applications, are discussed in relation to the nanoparticle characteristics and biological performance. Throughout the review, evidence is explicitly attributed to the relevant source system, distinguishing among Bacillus-derived, other microbial, chemically synthesized, plant-derived, and general SeNP literature. Current biomedical evidence for Bacillus-mediated SeNPs is based predominantly on in-vitro studies. Finally, emerging approaches for improving microbial SeNP production through strain selection, metabolic engineering, and process optimization are highlighted. This review provides an integrated perspective on Bacillus-mediated SeNP biosynthesis, identifies future research directions and offers insights for researchers in microbiology, bioprocess engineering, animal nutrition and agricultural biotechnology.

version:doi:10.1017/pls.2026.10031:a3aac.titleZh: 全球卫生安全与天花：根除后生物安全与准备工作的战略综述
version:doi:10.1017/pls.2026.10031:a3aac.abstractZh: 由合成生物学进步和人群水平免疫力下降驱动的潜在关键转变，使全球生物安全框架面临挑战。本综述评估天花作为当代病原体治理和生物政治准备工作的核心案例研究。我们分析了两种主要风险的交汇：从头合成正痘病毒的技术可行性以及常规疫苗接种停止后不断扩大的免疫缺口。2022年猴痘的复燃被评估为揭示交叉保护免疫战略脆弱性的指示性事件。最终，这一观点认为，天花重新出现的风险不仅仅是一个技术副产品，而是一个根本性的全球治理危机。为了减轻这些威胁，我们提出了一个整合了“同一健康”原则和跨国协调的多维度框架。保持战略警惕和机构记忆被呈现为根除后卫生安全的关键政治能力。

question.text: 在合成生物学发展和疫苗接种停止导致免疫力下降的背景下，如何评估天花作为病原体治理案例的风险及应对策略？
question.evidence: The global biosecurity framework faces a potential critical transition driven by synthetic biology advancements and declining population-level immunity.

methods.text: 对天花进行案例研究评估，分析从头合成正痘病毒的技术可行性、免疫缺口扩大及2022年猴痘复燃事件，并提出整合“同一健康”原则和多维度的框架。
methods.evidence: We analyze the convergence of two primary risks: the technical feasibility of de novo orthopoxvirus synthesis and the expanding immunity gap following the cessation of routine vaccination.

findings.text: 天花重新出现的风险被视为根本性的全球治理危机；2022年猴痘复燃揭示了交叉保护免疫的战略脆弱性；保持战略警惕和机构记忆是关键的预防能力。
findings.evidence: Ultimately, this perspective argues that smallpox reemergence risk is not merely a technological byproduct, but a fundamental global governance crisis.

version:doi:10.1017/pls.2026.10031:a3aac.sourceTitle: Global health security and smallpox: A strategic review of post-eradication biosafety and preparedness.
version:doi:10.1017/pls.2026.10031:a3aac.sourceAbstract: The global biosecurity framework faces a potential critical transition driven by synthetic biology advancements and declining population-level immunity. This review evaluates smallpox as a central case study for contemporary pathogen governance and biopolitical preparedness. We analyze the convergence of two primary risks: the technical feasibility of de novo orthopoxvirus synthesis and the expanding immunity gap following the cessation of routine vaccination. The 2022 mpox resurgence is assessed as a sentinel event revealing strategic vulnerabilities in cross-protective immunity. Ultimately, this perspective argues that smallpox reemergence risk is not merely a technological byproduct, but a fundamental global governance crisis. To mitigate these threats, we propose a multidimensional framework integrated with One Health principles and transnational coordination. Maintaining strategic vigilance and institutional memory is presented as a critical political capacity for post-eradication health security.

version:doi:10.1093/milmed/usag514:3865c.titleZh: 生物战、生物恐怖主义与生物犯罪：基于循证历史分级的系统综述（1763-2019）
version:doi:10.1093/milmed/usag514:3865c.abstractZh: 引言 生物战涉及故意使用微生物或毒素在人类、动物或植物中引起疾病和死亡，发生在国家战争、生物恐怖主义、生物犯罪和意外实验室泄漏 across 各个层面。尽管有大量历史文献，但许多常被引用的事件缺乏严谨的一手资料记录，且二次审查经常传播未经证实的说法。本综述应用明确的证据标准来区分有充分记录的事故与争议性指控及未 substantiated 的主张，使用 Carus 的分类法根据行为者和意图对事件进行分类。材料与方法 遵循 PRISMA 指南（PROSPERO CRD42024592724），我们检索了截至 2024 年 4 月 4 日的 PubMed、Web of Science 和 Scopus，并辅以灰色文献和专家咨询。两名评审员应用预定义的纳入和排除标准进行标题/摘要和全文筛选。一个改编自 ROBIS 和 PRISMA 元素的 3 级证据框架（有充分记录、有争议和未证实）应用于在史前时代至 2019 年间确定的 48 个候选事件，并由主题专家进行裁决。定量分析仅限于 19 个有充分记录的事件，以将发现锚定在来自主要档案来源、法医调查和专门学术研究的佐证证据上。结果 19 个有充分记录的事件导致至少 21,595 人受伤和 10,079 人死亡，其中包括 17 起故意使用（89.5%）和 2 起主要意外泄漏（10.5%）。故意事件包括 6 起生物犯罪（31.6%）、5 起战争行为（26.3%）、4 起生物恐怖袭击（21.1%）和 2 起国家赞助的行为（10.5%）。31 次剂型实例中使用了 14 种生物制剂。CDC B 类制剂占主导地位（58.1%，n = 18），其次是 A 类（35.5%，n = 11）；2 种制剂不符合 CDC 分类（6.5%），未发现 C 类制剂。炭疽杆菌是最常用的制剂（22.6%，n = 7），其次是蓖麻毒素（12.9%，n = 4）和霍乱弧菌（9.7%，n = 3）。主要的扩散方法是受污染的食物和饮料（29.2%，n = 7）以及直接接种和受感染的动物或昆虫媒介（12.5%，n = 3），分别而言。事件发生在 9 个国家，美国受影响最频繁（31.6%，n = 6）。行为者来自 10 个国家，美国、英国和日本共同占有了超过一半的有充分记录的事件。在整个历史文献中确定的事件中，不到一半（n = 19；39.6%）符合有充分记录状态的标准，强调了在生物安全研究中采用一致证据标准的必要性。结论 鉴于其隐蔽性质、低技术扩散方法的可用性以及合成生物学、双重用途研究和人工智能带来的新兴风险，生物战仍然是一个重大关切。预防、早期检测和快速响应，辅以伦理研究监督和开源监控，对于减轻这些威胁至关重要。
version:doi:10.1093/milmed/usag514:3865c.sourceTitle: Biological Warfare, Bioterrorism, and Biocrime: A Systematic Review with Evidence-Based Historical Tiering (1763-2019).
version:doi:10.1093/milmed/usag514:3865c.sourceAbstract: Introduction Biological warfare involves the deliberate use of microorganisms or toxins to cause disease and death in humans, animals, or plants, and has occurred across state warfare, bioterrorism, biocrime, and accidental laboratory release. Despite a substantial historical literature, many commonly cited events lack rigorous primary-source documentation, and secondary reviews frequently perpetuate unverified claims. This review applies explicit evidentiary criteria to distinguish well-documented incidents from contested allegations and unsubstantiated claims, using Carus's typology to categorize events by actor and intent. Materials and methods Following PRISMA guidelines (PROSPERO CRD42024592724), we searched PubMed, Web of Science, and Scopus up to April 4, 2024, supplemented by grey literature and expert consultation. Two reviewers applied predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria to title/abstract and full-text screening. A 3-tier evidentiary framework (well-documented, contested, and unsubstantiated), adapted from elements of ROBIS and PRISMA, was applied to 48 candidate events identified between pre-historic times and 2019, with adjudication by subject-matter experts. Quantitative analysis was restricted to the 19 well-documented events to anchor findings to corroborated evidence from primary archival sources, forensic investigations, and specialist scholarship. Results The 19 well-documented events caused at minimum 21,595 injuries and 10,079 deaths, comprising 17 deliberate uses (89.5%) and 2 major accidental releases (10.5%). Deliberate events comprised 6 biocrimes (31.6%), 5 acts of warfare (26.3%), 4 bioterrorist attacks (21.1%), and 2 State-sponsored acts (10.5%). Fourteen biological agents were employed across 31 agent instances. CDC Category B agents predominated (58.1%, n = 18), followed by Category A (35.5%, n = 11); 2 agents did not fit into the CDC classification (6.5%), and no Category C agents were identified. Bacillus anthracis was the most frequently used agent (22.6%, n = 7), followed by ricin (12.9%, n = 4) and Vibrio cholerae (9.7%, n = 3). The principal dispersal methods were contaminated food and beverages (29.2%, n = 7) and direct inoculation and infected animals or insect vectors (12.5%, n = 3), respectively. Events occurred across 9 countries, with the United States most frequently affected (31.6%, n = 6). Perpetrators originated from 10 countries, with the United States, United Kingdom, and Japan together accounting for over half of the well-documented events. Fewer than half of the events identified across the historical literature (n = 19; 39.6%) met the criteria for well-documented status, underscoring the need for consistent evidentiary standards in biosecurity research. Conclusions Biological warfare remains a significant concern given its covert nature, the accessibility of low-technology dispersal methods, and emerging risks from synthetic biology, dual-use research, and artificial intelligence. Prevention, early detection, and rapid response, supported by ethical research oversight and open-source surveillance, are essential to mitigating these threats.

version:doi:10.1016/j.molp.2026.10.019:c.titleZh: 线粒体与质体间的代谢穿梭：关键转运蛋白在协调碳氮代谢中的作用
version:doi:10.1016/j.molp.2026.10.019:c.abstractZh: 植物细胞中的碳和氮代谢分布在多个细胞器中，需要广泛的代谢物交换以协调生长、发育和环境响应。线粒体和质体作为相互连接的代谢枢纽，通过跨膜转运碳骨架、氨基酸、有机酸和氧化还原当量而联系在一起。这些转运过程对于整合能量转换过程、氮同化和生物合成代谢至关重要。在本综述中，我们整合了关于介导细胞器间碳-氮交换的线粒体和质体被膜转运蛋白的最新知识，重点关注具有已确认底物的转运蛋白的最新表征。我们讨论了这些转运蛋白如何促进细胞代谢的协调，强调了关于其调控和整合的新兴概念，并确定了我们在理解细胞器间代谢通讯方面的主要知识空白。了解这些转运系统如何共同塑造碳-氮通量，对于解析代谢灵活性以及指导植物中的代谢工程策略至关重要。
version:doi:10.1016/j.molp.2026.10.019:c.sourceTitle: Metabolic shuttles between mitochondria and plastids: Roles of key transporters in coordinating carbon-nitrogen metabolism.
version:doi:10.1016/j.molp.2026.10.019:c.sourceAbstract: Carbon and nitrogen metabolism in plant cells is distributed across multiple organelles, requiring extensive metabolite exchange to coordinate growth, development and environmental responses. Mitochondria and plastids function as interconnected metabolic hubs linked through the transport of carbon skeletons, amino acids, organic acids, and redox equivalents across organellar membranes. These transport processes are essential for integrating energy conversion processes, nitrogen assimilation, and biosynthetic metabolism. In this review, we integrate current knowledge of mitochondrial and plastid envelope transporters that mediate carbon-nitrogen exchange between organelles, focusing on recent characterisation of transporters with confirmed substrates. We discuss how these transporters contribute to the coordination of cellular metabolism, highlight emerging concepts regarding their regulation and integration, and identify major knowledge gaps in our understanding of interorganellar metabolic communication. Understanding how these transport systems collectively shape carbon-nitrogen fluxes is essential for deciphering metabolic flexibility and guiding metabolic engineering strategies in plants.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.03.763959:7.titleZh: 通过代谢工程改造酿酒酵母以提高多聚磷酸盐产量
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.03.763959:7.abstractZh: 有限的高品位磷矿石储量和对磷回收日益增长的立法需求，催生了将含磷残余流转化为有价值产品的工艺需求。微生物合成无机多聚磷酸盐（polyP）可以补充其高能耗的化学制造过程，同时实现磷在从食品加工到阻燃剂和肥料等各种应用中的增值产品回收。在正磷酸盐（Pi）饥饿和重新喂养后，酿酒酵母自然积累polyP作为细胞Pi储备，但当前的多阶段工艺使工业化实施变得复杂。在此，我们通过系统评估57株工程化酿酒酵母CEN.PK113-7D菌株，确定了将polyP积累与Pi饥饿解耦的代谢干预措施。PHO调控组的组成型激活产生了最强的polyP增加，而肌醇焦磷酸合成、Pi输入或液泡转运体伴侣复合物的破坏则损害了积累。这种模式表明，有效的polyP积累取决于Pi获取和液泡聚合的协调激活。值得注意的是，PHO80的缺失将瞬态饥饿反应转化为组成型生产表型，从而在生长期间实现高polyP积累。优化生长培养基进一步提高了polyP含量，并证明了所供应Pi的有效利用，而电子显微镜结合能量色散X射线光谱支持了增加的液泡储存。在有氧指数分批培养过程中，pho80Δ突变体同时形成生物量和polyP，达到细胞干重22.1%的polyP含量和8.2 g/L的效价，均以KPO3当量表示。这些发现确立了酿酒酵母pho80Δ作为生物polyP生产和磷回收的有前景的平台。摘要图
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.03.763959:7.sourceTitle: Metabolic engineering of Saccharomyces cerevisiae for improved polyphosphate production
version:doi:10.64898/2026.11.03.763959:7.sourceAbstract: Finite high-grade phosphate rock reserves and rising legislative demand for phosphorus recycling create a need for processes converting phosphorus-containing residual streams into valuable products. Microbial synthesis of inorganic polyphosphate (polyP) could complement its energy-intensive chemical manufacturing while enabling phosphorus recovery in a value-added product with applications ranging from food processing to flame retardants and fertilizer. After orthophosphate (P i ) starvation and refeeding, Saccharomyces cerevisiae naturally accumulates polyP as a cellular P i reserve, but the current multistage process complicates industrial implementation. Here, we identified metabolic interventions that uncouple polyP accumulation from P i starvation by systematic evaluation of 57 engineered S. cerevisiae CEN.PK113-7D strains. Constitutive activation of the PHO regulon produced the strongest increase in polyP, whereas disruption of inositol pyrophosphate synthesis, P i import, or the vacuolar transporter chaperone complex impaired accumulation. This pattern indicates that efficient polyP accumulation depends on coordinated activation of P i acquisition and vacuolar polymerization. Notably, deletion of PHO80 converted a transient starvation response into a constitutive production phenotype, enabling high polyP accumulation during growth. Optimization of the growth medium increased the polyP content further, and efficient use of the supplied P i was demonstrated, while electron microscopy paired with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy supported increased vacuolar storage. During aerobic exponential fed-batch cultivation, pho80Δ simultaneously formed biomass and polyP, reaching a polyP content of 22.1% of cell dry weight and a titer of 8.2 g/L, both expressed as KPO 3 equivalents. These findings establish S. cerevisiae pho80Δ as a promising platform for biological polyP production and phosphorus recovery. Abstract Figure

version:doi:10.1016/j.cellimm.2026.10516.titleZh: 下一代CAR-NK疗法：针对实体瘤的分子工程策略
version:doi:10.1016/j.cellimm.2026.10516.abstractZh: 自然杀伤（NK）细胞是先天淋巴细胞，能够在无需预先抗原致敏的情况下对恶性肿瘤和病毒感染细胞发挥细胞毒性作用。嵌合抗原受体（CAR）工程化的NK（CAR-NK）细胞将依赖CAR的肿瘤抗原识别与依赖于内源性NK细胞受体的、针对应激诱导配体及HLA I类表达降低的肿瘤细胞的细胞毒性相结合。同种异体CD19 CAR-NK细胞的临床研究报道了抗肿瘤反应，且未出现明显的细胞因子释放综合征、神经毒性或移植物抗宿主病。CAR-NK细胞还支持用于现成式细胞疗法的同种异体制造。包括DAP10、DAP12、2B4和CD3ζ在内的NK相关胞内结构域、使用IL-15或IL-21进行的细胞因子表达，以及抑制性分子的基因编辑已被纳入CAR-NK设计中。PI3K-AKT-mTORC1和JAK-STAT信号通路、糖酵解代谢、线粒体活性以及转录控制有助于CAR-NK的细胞毒性功能。近期的CAR-NK研究还考察了抑制性受体编辑、趋化因子受体表达和代谢工程，以提高在实体瘤中的细胞毒性活性、瘤内浸润以及对缺氧和免疫抑制信号的抵抗力。本综述考察了涉及NK细胞激活和代谢的分子机制，并评估了下一代CAR-NK疗法在实体瘤中的分子工程策略。
version:doi:10.1016/j.cellimm.2026.10516.sourceTitle: Next-generation CAR-NK therapies: molecular engineering strategies for solid tumors.
version:doi:10.1016/j.cellimm.2026.10516.sourceAbstract: Natural killer (NK) cells are innate lymphocytes that exert cytotoxic activity against malignant and virus-infected cells without prior antigen sensitization. Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-engineered NK (CAR-NK) cells combine CAR-dependent tumor-antigen recognition with endogenous NK-cell receptor-dependent cytotoxicity against stress-induced ligands and tumor cells with reduced HLA class I expression. Clinical studies of allogeneic CD19 CAR-NK cells have reported antitumor responses without notable cytokine release syndrome, neurotoxicity, or graft-versus-host disease. CAR-NK cells also support allogeneic manufacturing for off-the-shelf cellular therapy. NK-associated intracellular domains including DAP10, DAP12, 2B4, and CD3ζ, cytokine expression using IL-15 or IL-21, and gene editing of inhibitory molecules have been incorporated into CAR-NK designs. PI3K-AKT-mTORC1 and JAK-STAT signaling, glycolytic metabolism, mitochondrial activity, and transcriptional control contribute to CAR-NK cytotoxic function. Recent CAR-NK studies have also examined inhibitory-receptor editing, chemokine receptor expression, and metabolic engineering to improve cytotoxic activity, intratumoral infiltration, and resistance to hypoxia and immunosuppressive signaling in solid tumors. This review examines the molecular mechanisms involved in NK-cell activation and metabolism and evaluates molecular engineering strategies for next-generation CAR-NK therapy in solid tumors.

version:doi:10.1038/s41467-026-77614-w:2.titleZh: 增强环状RNA翻译的RNA结合蛋白的系统筛选
version:doi:10.1038/s41467-026-77614-w:2.abstractZh: 可翻译的环状RNA（circRNAs）因其稳定性提高从而产生更长的表达窗口，已成为传统mRNA治疗的有希望的替代方案。circRNAs的翻译主要由内部核糖体进入位点（IRES）或类IRES元件驱动，这一过程受到各种反式作用RNA结合蛋白（RBPs）的严格调控。在此，我们开发了一种基于细胞的系统来筛选能够增强circRNAs翻译的RBPs，鉴定出68种作为非经典翻译潜在激活剂的蛋白。这些翻译激活剂参与广泛的生物过程，包括RNA加工、核糖体生物发生和翻译起始。我们进一步设计了一种机器学习算法，以提取这些激活剂的共同序列特征，并预测更多具有翻译激活活性的潜在RBPs。新鉴定出的和预测出的激活剂随后被验证为以上下文依赖的方式促进IRES介导的circRNA翻译。总体而言，本研究为IRES相关的反式作用因子提供了新的见解，并扩大了RNA合成生物学中工程化RBPs的工具箱。
version:doi:10.1038/s41467-026-77614-w:2.sourceTitle: Systematic screen of RNA binding proteins that enhance circular RNA translation.
version:doi:10.1038/s41467-026-77614-w:2.sourceAbstract: Translatable circular RNAs (circRNAs) have emerged as a promising alternative to conventional mRNA therapy due to their improved stability that results in a prolonged expression window. The translation of circRNAs is mainly driven by internal ribosome entry site (IRES) or IRES-like elements, which is tightly regulated by various trans-acting RNA binding proteins (RBPs). Here we develop a cell-based system to systematically screen RBPs that enhance translation of circRNAs, identifying 68 proteins as putative activators of noncanonical translation. These translation activators are involved in a broad range of biological processes including RNA processing, ribosomal biogenesis, and translation initiation. We further design a machine learning algorithm to extract common sequence features of these activators and predict more potential RBPs with translation activator activities. The newly identified and predicted activators are subsequently validated to promote the IRES-mediated circRNA translation in a context-dependent fashion. Overall, this study provides new insights into IRES-related trans-acting factors and expands the toolbox for engineered RBPs in RNA synthetic biology.

version:doi:10.1016/j.actbio.2026.11.007.titleZh: 蛋白纳米笼：用于治疗、生物成像和诊断的可编程生物材料平台
version:doi:10.1016/j.actbio.2026.11.007.abstractZh: 蛋白纳米笼是通过蛋白质亚基的对称自组装形成的单分散空心结构。其遗传编码的架构将纳米级组装的几何精度与天然进化蛋白固有的生物相容性和功能多样性相结合。明确定义的内部腔室以及可工程化的内外表面，使得在单一纳米级平台内对治疗载荷、分子识别元件和生物活性成分进行空间组织成为可能。在本综述中，我们考察了代表性蛋白纳米笼（包括铁蛋白、丙酮酸脱氢酶E2核心、饥饿细胞DNA结合蛋白（Dps）、小热休克蛋白（sHSPs）、包囊蛋白和核黄素合酶）的结构组织、自组装机制、理化性质和功能多样性。我们讨论了它们的结构特征和组装行为如何决定生物性能，并支持靶向药物递送、癌症免疫治疗、疫苗开发以及体内和体外诊断等生物医学应用。除了描述各个平台外，我们建立了一个统一的框架，将蛋白纳米笼定位为可编程的分子组织者，并突出了五项可转移的设计原则：多价配体展示、空间区室化、受体引导的靶向、报告分子的组织和信号增强，以及刺激响应性货物释放和功能激活。我们还考察了结构稳定性、免疫原性、规模化制造和临床转化方面的持续挑战，以及蛋白质工程、合成生物学和计算蛋白质设计方面的新兴机遇。综上所述，这些原则确立了蛋白纳米笼作为集成传感、靶向、成像和治疗功能的通用生物材料平台的地位，为下一代精准纳米医学奠定了基础。重要性声明：综述通常单独处理蛋白纳米笼，掩盖了共享的结构特征以及设计策略在不同系统间的转移程度。本综述通过建立一个跨越结构多样纳米笼的比较框架来解决这一空白，并将它们的相似之处提炼为一组简洁的通用设计原则。该框架将蛋白纳米笼重新定义为不仅仅是被动的递送载体，而是能够以受控的空间排列和化学计量比组织货物的可编程分子支架。该框架为生物材料研究人员提供了工程化蛋白组装以实现精准纳米医学的可转移基础，同时确定了必须解决的关键挑战，包括结构稳定性、免疫原性和规模化制造，以促进临床转化。

question.text: 综述旨在确立一个比较框架，将蛋白纳米笼定位为可编程的分子组织者，并提炼出通用的设计原则，以解决以往综述单独处理各类纳米笼而忽视其共享特征和设计策略转移性的问题。

version:doi:10.1016/j.actbio.2026.11.007.sourceTitle: Protein nanocages: Programmable biomaterial platforms for therapeutics, bioimaging, and diagnostics.
version:doi:10.1016/j.actbio.2026.11.007.sourceAbstract: Protein nanocages are monodisperse, hollow structures formed through the symmetric self-assembly of protein subunits. Their genetically encoded architectures combine the geometric precision of nanoscale assemblies with the intrinsic biocompatibility and functional versatility of naturally evolved proteins. Well-defined internal cavities and engineerable interior and exterior surfaces enable the spatial organization of therapeutic cargoes, molecular recognition elements, and bioactive components within a single nanoscale platform. In this Review, we examine the structural organization, self-assembly mechanisms, physicochemical properties, and functional diversity of representative protein nanocages, including ferritin, the pyruvate dehydrogenase E2 core, DNA-binding proteins from starved cells (Dps), small heat shock proteins (sHSPs), encapsulins, and lumazine synthase. We discuss how their structural features and assembly behavior govern biological performance and support biomedical applications in targeted drug delivery, cancer immunotherapy, vaccine development, and in vivo and in vitro diagnostics. Beyond describing individual platforms, we establish a unifying framework that positions protein nanocages as programmable molecular organizers and highlights five transferable design principles: multivalent ligand display, spatial compartmentalization, receptor-guided targeting, reporter organization and signal enhancement, and stimulus-responsive cargo release and functional activation. We also examine persistent challenges in structural stability, immunogenicity, scalable manufacturing, and clinical translation, alongside emerging opportunities in protein engineering, synthetic biology, and computational protein design. Collectively, these principles establish protein nanocages as versatile biomaterial platforms for integrating sensing, targeting, imaging, and therapy within a single molecular architecture, providing a foundation for next-generation precision nanomedicine. STATEMENT OF SIGNIFICANCE: Reviews typically treat protein nanocages individually, obscuring shared structural features and the extent to which design strategies transfer across systems. This Review addresses this gap by establishing a comparative framework spanning structurally diverse nanocages and distilling their similarities into a concise set of generalizable design principles. It reframes protein nanocages not merely as passive delivery vehicles but as programmable molecular scaffolds that organize cargo with controlled spatial arrangement and stoichiometry. This framework provides biomaterials researchers with a transferable basis for engineering protein assemblies for precision nanomedicine while identifying key challenges in structural stability, immunogenicity, and scalable manufacturing that must be addressed to facilitate clinical translation.

version:doi:10.1093/plphys/kiag811:f87e4.titleZh: 一个世纪的豆类育种提高了光合能力，但未提高非光化学淬灭（NPQ）的弛豫速度。
version:doi:10.1093/plphys/kiag811:f87e4.abstractZh: 加速光保护调节以改善碳同化是提高作物产量的有前景的策略。尽管通过代谢工程已验证快速非光化学淬灭（NPQ）弛豫是一个目标，但常规育种是否改善了这一性状尚不清楚。在此，我们调查了超过一个世纪的豆类育种是否在光饱和碳同化和种子性状增强的同时增强了NPQ弛豫。我们通过整合NPQ弛豫、气体交换参数、叶黄素循环色素谱、关键光保护基因（VDE、PsbS和ZEP）的表达、种子数量和种子重量，对24个豆类基因型在营养和生殖发育阶段的历史面板进行了评估。NPQ弛豫参数与两个发育阶段的基因型发布年份、种子数量或种子重量均无一致关联。唯一的例外是快速弛豫NPQ组分的振幅（AqE），它在生殖阶段与这三个变量呈负相关。相比之下，基因型发布年份与最大净CO2同化率（Amax）、Rubisco的最大羧化速率（Vcmax）、最大电子传递速率（Jmax）、种子数量和种子重量呈正相关，而Amax和Vcmax与种子数量和种子重量呈正相关。这些发现表明，现代基因型更高的光合能力并未伴随更快的光保护响应。因此，在田间条件下，光保护调节未能跟上光合能力的增益步伐。我们得出结论，快速NPQ弛豫仍然是同步光保护与现代豆类品系高光合能力的重要目标。

version:doi:10.1093/plphys/kiag811:f87e4.sourceTitle: A century of soybean breeding increased photosynthetic capacity but not NPQ relaxation.
version:doi:10.1093/plphys/kiag811:f87e4.sourceAbstract: Accelerating photoprotective regulation to improve carbon assimilation is a promising strategy to increase crop productivity. Although rapid non-photochemical quenching (NPQ) relaxation has been validated as a target through metabolic engineering, it remains unclear whether conventional breeding has improved this trait. Here, we investigated whether more than a century of soybean breeding enhanced NPQ relaxation alongside light-saturated carbon assimilation and seed traits. We evaluated a historical panel of 24 soybean genotypes across vegetative and reproductive developmental stages by integrating NPQ relaxation, gas exchange parameters, xanthophyll-cycle pigment profiles, expression of key photoprotective genes (VDE, PsbS, and ZEP), seed number and seed weight. NPQ relaxation parameters were not consistently associated with genotype release year, seed number, or seed weight at either developmental stage. The only exception was the amplitude of the rapidly relaxing NPQ component (AqE), which was negatively correlated with all three variables during the reproductive stage. In contrast, genotype release year was positively associated with maximum net CO2 assimilation rate (Amax), maximum carboxylation rate of Rubisco (Vcmax), maximum electron transport rate (Jmax), seed number, and seed weight, while Amax and Vcmax were positively correlated with seed number and seed weight. These findings indicate that the greater photosynthetic capacity of modern genotypes was not accompanied by faster photoprotective response. Thus, photoprotective regulation has not kept pace with gains in photosynthetic capacity under field conditions. We conclude that rapid NPQ relaxation remains an important target for synchronizing photoprotection with the high photosynthetic capacity of modern soybean lines.

version:doi:10.1002/mco2.71103:a4477fa1-.titleZh: 脂肪来源间充质干细胞：分离、起源、表型应用与挑战
version:doi:10.1002/mco2.71103:a4477fa1-.abstractZh: 传统的脂肪来源间充质干细胞（AD-MSCs）研究依赖于未分选的混合群体，其治疗功效受到细胞异质性、培养诱导的表型漂移以及移植后快速的功能衰竭的限制，导致结果不一致并阻碍了临床转化。本综述系统考察了AD-MSCs的发育起源、组织微环境、分离与纯化策略、功能表型以及生物制造瓶颈。它整合了AD-MSCs及其细胞外囊泡（EVs）在骨和软骨再生、慢性皮肤疾病、神经系统疾病、心血管疾病及其他病症中的临床前和临床证据。这些疗法通过免疫代谢重编程、抗纤维化信号传导、血管生成、线粒体转移和旁分泌调节来重塑受损的微环境，而非直接的组织替代。主要的转化障碍包括细胞异质性、安全性问题、转分化争议、非标准化的预处理、培养诱导的表型漂移以及移植后的低细胞留存率。我们提出，临床转化应基于功能性亚群的 prospective 分离，并结合定制化的预处理、精准基因编辑、三维生物材料、EV工程化和自动化封闭式系统的生物制造。该框架旨在保持效力、表型稳定性和旁分泌功能，将AD-MSCs及其生物活性衍生物从可变、未分选的制剂转变为特征明确、标准化、高效力的精准生物制品。更广泛地说，它为下一代再生医学提供了一条机制驱动、功能定义、工程赋能且临床可及的路线图。
version:doi:10.1002/mco2.71103:a4477fa1-.sourceTitle: Adipose-Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells: Isolation, Origin, Phenotype Applications, and Challenges.
version:doi:10.1002/mco2.71103:a4477fa1-.sourceAbstract: Traditional adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells (AD-MSCs) research has relied on unfractionated bulk populations, whose therapeutic efficacy is constrained by cellular heterogeneity, culture-induced phenotypic drift, and rapid postengraftment functional exhaustion, resulting in inconsistent outcomes and impeding clinical translation. This review systematically examines AD-MSC developmental origins, tissue niches, isolation and purification strategies, functional phenotypes, and biomanufacturing bottlenecks. It integrates preclinical and clinical evidence for AD-MSCs and their extracellular vesicles (EVs) in bone and cartilage regeneration, chronic cutaneous diseases, neurological disorders, cardiovascular diseases, and other conditions. These therapies remodel injured microenvironments through immunometabolic reprogramming, antifibrotic signaling, angiogenesis, mitochondrial transfer, and paracrine regulation rather than direct tissue replacement. Major translational barriers include cellular heterogeneity, safety concerns, the transdifferentiation controversy, nonstandardized preconditioning, culture-induced phenotypic drift, and low cell retention after transplantation. We propose that clinical translation should be based on prospective isolation of functional subpopulations, coupled with tailored preconditioning, precision gene editing, three-dimensional biomaterials, EV engineering, and automated closed-system biomanufacturing. This framework aims to preserve potency, phenotypic stability, and paracrine function, transforming AD-MSCs and their bioactive derivatives from variable, unfractionated preparations into well-characterized, standardized, highly potent precision biologics. More broadly, it offers a mechanism-driven, function-defined, engineering-enabled, and clinically accessible roadmap for next-generation regenerative medicine.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.31.762157:8.titleZh: 生物传感器引导的全基因组CRISPR筛选实现酵母中顺,顺-粘康酸的过量生产
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.31.762157:8.abstractZh: 传统的途径代谢工程依赖于通过引入理性识别的遗传扰动来提高菌株生产力，虽然有用，但耗时且会遗漏非直观的靶点。全基因组CRISPR筛选提供了一种替代方案，通过高效采样基因组，能够工程化新型表型，当与高通量菌株检测方法结合时，其效果进一步增强。在此，我们使用酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae），利用潮霉素B（zeocin）抗性和荧光作为信号输出，将小分子生物传感器工程化为群体富集工具。随后，我们引入了多功能全基因组CRISPR（MAGIC）文库，该文库针对每个基因进行激活、干扰或删除，从而创建了生物传感器辅助的MAGIC，即senMAGIC。作为一项案例研究，我们利用senMAGIC来鉴定提高尼龙前体原儿茶酸和顺,顺-粘康酸（PCA和ccM）生产力的单一遗传决定因子。然后将这些随机组装为三重gRNA-tRNA阵列以进行多重基因扰动，从而鉴定组合效应。随后在不含senMAGIC的生产菌株中使用直接基因组整合确认了最佳gRNA命中结果，从而确定了已知以及增加PCA和ccM滴度的新靶点。我们的结果证明了senMAGIC是一种稳健的、易于自动化的全基因组进化工具，并强调了该方法的局限性，为未来优化宿主代谢以实现高效生物工艺的多功能CRISPR筛选提供了路线图。
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.31.762157:8.sourceTitle: Biosensor-guided genome-wide CRISPR screens enable cis , cis -muconic acid overproduction in yeast
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.31.762157:8.sourceAbstract: ABSTRACT Classical pathway metabolic engineering relies on enhancing strain productivity through the introduction of rationally identified genetic perturbations, which while useful, are time-consuming and miss unintuitive targets. Genome-wide CRISPR screens offer an alternative by efficiently sampling genomes, enabling the engineering of novel phenotypes, and are further enhanced when combined with high-throughput strain interrogation methods. Here, using Saccharomyces cerevisiae , we engineered small molecule biosensors into population enrichment tools using zeocin resistance and fluorescence as signal outputs. We then introduced the multi-functional genome-wide CRISPR (MAGIC) library that targets every gene for activation, interference, or deletion, thus creating biosensor-aided MAGIC, or senMAGIC. As a case study, we utilized senMAGIC to identify single genetic determinants that improve productivity of the nylon precursors protocatechuic and cis , cis -muconic acids (PCA and ccM). These were then randomly assembled as triple gRNA-tRNA arrays for multiplexed gene perturbations to identify combinatorial effects. Top gRNA hits were then confirmed using direct genomic integrations in senMAGIC-free production strains, resulting in identifying known as well as novel targets that increase PCA and ccM titres. Our results demonstrate senMAGIC as a robust automation-friendly whole-genome evolution tool and highlight limitations of the method, providing a roadmap for future multifunctional CRISPR screens to optimize host metabolism for efficient bioprocesses.

version:doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2026.102577:.titleZh: 推进酿酒酵母中萜类生物合成：用于高效长叶烯合成的合成生物学策略
version:doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2026.102577:.abstractZh: 高价值萜类化合物（如长叶烯）的可持续微生物生产是绿色制造的关键前沿领域，但通常受到宿主微生物系统代谢低效的阻碍。为解决这一问题，我们在酿酒酵母中提出了一种综合的系统代谢工程框架，整合了三个互补模块以克服酶催化、辅因子供应和前体可用性这三个关键瓶颈。首先，我们通过增强催化模块，采用RIDD-RIAD肽介导的酶组装以及结构指导的松木长叶烯合酶（psTPS）变体筛选，改善了测试条件下的全细胞长叶烯产量。其次，为了解决烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸磷酸（NADPH）辅因子失衡问题，我们构建了双重再生系统，通过引入外源甲酸脱氢酶（FDH）并同时扩增内源戊糖磷酸途径（PPP）通量来实现。第三，我们通过整合非氧化糖酵解（NOG）途径并删除转录抑制因子DOS2和YNR063W来重编程中心碳代谢，这与作为重要萜类前体的胞质乙酰辅酶A稳态池增大有关。这种多管齐下的策略最终培育出一种高度优化的菌株，在摇瓶培养中实现了92.84 mg/L的滴度。关键在于，该工艺成功放大至5 L生物反应器中的补料分批条件下，在204小时时总长叶烯产量达到4181.51 mg/L（其中细胞外3484.79 mg/L，细胞结合696.72 mg/L），这是补充表S4中识别出的微生物报道中最高的总滴度。产品回收和培养方案的差异限制了直接的过程比较。我们的工作表明，酶组装、辅因子再生和碳流重编程的协调优化可以显著提高酿酒酵母中长叶烯的生物合成。本研究提供了一个以长叶烯为重点的模块化途径优化案例研究，而将该策略更广泛地应用于其他萜类或天然产物将需要进一步的途径特异性验证。
