version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.16.759771:d.sourceTitle: Multiplexed mammalian gene control via modular splicing riboswitches
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.16.759771:d.sourceAbstract: Precise, multiplexed gene regulation in mammalian cells remains constrained by a heavy reliance on heterologous protein regulators, whose associated immunogenicity and strict cargo-size limits impede clinical translation. Here, we introduce SpliceRACER (Splice-based R iboswitch A rray for C ombinatorial E xpression R egulation), a multiplexed RNA switch platform that achieves scalable, orthogonal, and combinatorial control of gene expression in mammalian cells through alternative splicing, eliminating the need for exogenous protein co-expression. SpliceRACER independently orchestrates three orthogonal channels to regulate fluorescent reporter outputs, yielding 3³ = 27 discrete combinatorial expression states, vastly exceeding the capacity of conventional binary gene switches. Furthermore, we engineered three generalizable strategies to effectively suppress the basal leakage inherent to synthetic riboswitches, thereby enabling tight OFF-state control of the potent pyroptotic effector GSDMD-NT for precise cell-death induction. This work offers broad utility in synthetic biology and therapeutic applications. Graphical abstract

version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.18.759890:8.titleZh: RegDesign-Bench：用于细胞类型特异性调控DNA设计的计算方法基准测试
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.18.759890:8.abstractZh: 从头设计驱动细胞类型特异性基因表达的调控DNA序列，有望在合成生物学、细胞工程和基因治疗中实现精确的基因控制。为此任务开发了多种计算方法，但针对不同设计目标指导方法选择的系统比较仍然有限。在此，我们介绍了RegDesign-Bench，这是一个标准化的框架，通过一系列全面的计算分析来评估细胞类型特异性顺式调控元件的设计。在所测试的方法中，强预测活性并未始终伴随细胞类型选择性可及性或显著的细胞类型相关基序信号。与参考序列分布的相似性也不能确保高预测靶细胞活性或特异性。这些发现表明，单个测量的有利表现并不一定延伸到其他调控特性和文库特征，揭示了当前设计方法的依赖应用的优缺点。总体而言，RegDesign-Bench提供了一个通用的计算框架，用于比较和选择设计驱动细胞类型特异性基因表达的调控DNA的方法。
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.18.759890:8.sourceTitle: RegDesign-Bench: Benchmarking computational methods for cell-type-specific regulatory DNA design
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.18.759890:8.sourceAbstract: The de novo design of regulatory DNA sequences that drive cell-type-specific gene expression could enable precise gene control in synthetic biology, cell engineering and gene therapy. Various computational methods have been developed for this task, yet systematic comparisons that guide method selection for different design objectives remain limited. Here, we introduce RegDesign-Bench, a standardized framework for evaluating cell-type-specific cis-regulatory element design through a comprehensive set of computational analyses. Among the methods tested, strong predicted activity was not consistently accompanied by cell-type-selective accessibility or prominent cell-type-associated motif signals. Similarity to reference sequence distributions also did not ensure high predicted target-cell activity or specificity. These findings demonstrate that favourable performance on individual measurements does not necessarily extend across regulatory properties and library characteristics, revealing application-dependent strengths and limitations of current design methods. Overall, RegDesign-Bench offers a general-purpose computational framework for comparing and selecting methods to design regulatory DNA that drives cell-type-specific gene expression.

version:doi:10.2147/jir.s641770:9805c1de.titleZh: 微生物群相关代谢物作为肾小球炎症的免疫代谢调节剂：疾病特异性机制与治疗机遇
version:doi:10.2147/jir.s641770:9805c1de.abstractZh: 背景 免疫球蛋白A肾病（IgAN）、膜性肾病（MN）和狼疮肾炎（LN）是免疫介导的肾小球疾病，其中失调的适应性免疫与先天炎症及滤过屏障损伤相汇聚。尽管上游免疫控制得到管理，但临床复发和恢复不完全促使对其他损伤修饰因子的调查。主体 本综述评估了五类微生物群相关代谢物家族——短链脂肪酸（SCFAs）、色氨酸衍生物、芳香族氨基酸衍生的尿毒症溶质、氧化三甲胺（TMAO）和胆汁酸——在三个模块中的作用：免疫耐受失败、先天炎症放大和滤过屏障破坏。在IgAN中，多组学数据显示全身乙酸水平保持或升高，而肾小球游离脂肪酸受体2/3（FFAR2/FFAR3）相关信号传导降低，提示肾脏SCFA感知受损，但这并未确立受体功能状态为主要靶点。在MN中，疾病特异性研究支持由补体C3a及其受体（C3a/C3aR）以及补体相关的含NOD、LRR和吡啶结构域蛋白3（NLRP3）-caspase-1-gasdermin D（GSDMD）焦亡介足的足细胞损伤，而提出的SCFA调节调节性T细胞（Treg）-B细胞相互作用及SCFA-炎症小体相互作用仍主要处于假设生成阶段；实验性乳杆菌-吲哚-芳烃受体（AhR）数据提供了初步证据。在LN中，微生物依赖性色氨酸通路扰动和治疗相关的代谢组学变化支持犬尿氨酸与色氨酸比率作为易于测量的候选生物标志物，需前瞻性验证。跨疾病解读时，需区分微生物产生与肾脏滞留、代谢物丰度与受体信号传导能力，以及总暴露量与未结合暴露量（针对蛋白结合溶质）。结论 微生物群相关代谢物构成了免疫介导肾小球疾病中一个合理的免疫代谢层，而非已确立的因果通路。优先事项包括疾病特异性纵向表型分析、隔室分辨代谢物测量、靶点参与研究和嵌入生物标志物的临床试验，在此之后方可推进治疗主张。
version:doi:10.2147/jir.s641770:9805c1de.sourceTitle: Microbiota-Associated Metabolites as Immunometabolic Regulators of Glomerular Inflammation: Disease-Specific Mechanisms and Therapeutic Opportunities.
version:doi:10.2147/jir.s641770:9805c1de.sourceAbstract: Background Immunoglobulin A nephropathy (IgAN), membranous nephropathy (MN), and lupus nephritis (LN) are immune-mediated glomerular diseases in which dysregulated adaptive immunity converges with innate inflammatory and filtration-barrier injury. Clinical relapse and incomplete recovery despite upstream immune control motivate investigation of additional injury modifiers. Main body This review evaluates five microbiota-associated metabolite families-short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), tryptophan-derived metabolites, aromatic amino acid-derived uremic solutes, trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO), and bile acids-across three modules: immune-tolerance failure, innate inflammatory amplification, and filtration-barrier disruption. In IgAN, multi-omics data showing preserved or elevated systemic acetate with reduced glomerular free fatty acid receptor 2/3 (FFAR2/FFAR3)-associated signaling suggest impaired renal SCFA sensing, but do not establish receptor competence as the dominant target. In MN, disease-specific studies support podocyte injury mediated by complement C3a and its receptor (C3a/C3aR) and complement-associated NOD-, LRR- and pyrin domain-containing protein 3 (NLRP3)-caspase-1-gasdermin D (GSDMD) pyroptosis as related injury processes, whereas proposed SCFA-regulatory T cell (Treg)-B-cell and SCFA-inflammasome interactions remain largely hypothesis-generating; experimental Lactobacillus-indole-aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) data provide preliminary evidence. In LN, microbiota-dependent tryptophan pathway perturbation and treatment-associated metabolomic changes support the kynurenine-to-tryptophan ratio as a readily measurable candidate biomarker requiring prospective validation. Across diseases, interpretation requires separating microbial production from renal retention, metabolite abundance from receptor signaling competence, and total from unbound exposure for protein-bound solutes. Conclusion Microbiota-associated metabolites constitute a plausible immunometabolic layer rather than established causal pathways in immune-mediated glomerular disease. Priorities include disease-specific longitudinal phenotyping, compartment-resolved metabolite measurement, target-engagement studies, and biomarker-embedded clinical trials before therapeutic claims are advanced.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.16.759639:4.titleZh: SYNBRIDGE：一种用于BioBricks与Golden Gate组装标准之间双向转换的通用框架
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.16.759639:4.abstractZh: 组件的可重用性和互操作性是合成生物学的基础。虽然BioBricks为部件驯化奠定了基础，但基于Golden Gate的组装标准，特别是模块化克隆（MoClo），彻底改变了多片段组装。尽管已被广泛采用，但由于序列不兼容性，在这两种流行框架之间进行标准化转换仍然具有挑战性。尽管从头合成仍受成本和序列复杂性的限制，但传统的基于PCR的转换方法会受到多基因装置中序列冗余驱动的脱靶结合、不可扩展的引物优化成本以及扩增子大小限制的影响。为了从工程角度解决相互转换问题，我们提出了SynBridge：一个围绕两个核心操作Bri2Mo和Mo2Bri构建的双向BioBrick-MoClo转换闭环幂等工作流。作为概念验证，我们通过构建一个复合遗传系统验证了SynBridge，该系统整合了用于LuxR介导RFP表达的BioBrick模块和用于热调控GFP表达的MoClo组装装置。定量克隆效率和功能表征确认了一种稳健且可重复的工作流，无需依赖临时解决方案即可运行。SynBridge提供了一种通用的工程工具，确保向后兼容性，最大化部件可重用性，并建立适合自动化程序的标准互换框架。图形摘要
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.16.759639:4.sourceTitle: SYNBRIDGE: A VERSATILE FRAMEWORK FOR BIDIRECTIONAL INTERCONVERSION BETWEEN BIOBRICKS AND GOLDEN GATE ASSEMBLY STANDARDS
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.16.759639:4.sourceAbstract: ABSTRACT Component reusability and interoperability are fundamental to synthetic biology. While BioBricks laid the groundwork for part domestication, Golden Gate-based assembly standards, in particular Modular Cloning (MoClo), revolutionized multipart assembly. Despite widespread adoption, standardized conversion between these two popular frameworks remains challenging due to sequence incompatibilities. While de novo synthesis remains constrained by cost and sequence complexity, conventional PCR-based conversion suffers from off-target binding driven by sequence redundancy in multigene devices, unscalable primer optimization costs, and amplicon size constraints. To address interconversion from an engineering perspective, we present SynBridge: a closed-loop idempotent workflow for bidirectional BioBrick-MoClo conversion built around two core operations, Bri2Mo and Mo2Bri. As a proof of concept, we validated SynBridge by constructing a composite genetic system integrating a BioBrick module for LuxR-mediated RFP expression with a MoClo-assembled device for thermoregulated GFP expression. Quantitative cloning efficiency and functional characterization confirmed a robust and reproducible workflow that operates without requiring ad-hoc solutions. SynBridge provides a versatile engineering tool that ensures backward compatibility, maximizes part reusability, and establishes a standardized interchangeability framework suitable for automated procedures. GRAPHICAL ABSTRACT

version:doi:10.1080/17460913.2026.275116.titleZh: 靶向苯酚可溶性调节蛋白：对抗金黄色葡萄球菌生物膜的环保型诊疗策略
version:doi:10.1080/17460913.2026.275116.abstractZh: 金黄色葡萄球菌和耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）对抗生素的耐药性日益增强，构成全球健康威胁。传统抗生素作用于细菌的活力，而新型抗生素越来越多地针对毒力因子。苯酚可溶性调节蛋白（PSMs）是重要的毒力因子，在炎症、中性粒细胞裂解、细胞毒性和生物膜形成中发挥重要作用。使用PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar检索了2010年至2026年间发表的文献。研究发现，绿色合成的金属纳米颗粒（NPs）能够通过诱导活性氧（ROS）产生、造成膜损伤以及干扰细菌的群体感应机制并抑制Agr系统来改变这些机制。基于纳米颗粒的干预措施的优化可以得到基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学和代谢组学等多组学方法的支持。其他潜在的靶向PSM通路和Agr通路抑制的方法也存在，例如CRISPR-Cas9和dCas9，但存在递送难题。结合纳米技术、基因编辑、多组学、人工智能和合成生物学的潜在用途，可能有助于开发更先进的针对PSM的金黄色葡萄球菌感染的抗毒力策略。

question.text: 如何靶向苯酚可溶性调节蛋白（PSMs）以对抗金黄色葡萄球菌生物膜及耐药性问题？

version:doi:10.1080/17460913.2026.275116.sourceTitle: Targeting phenol-soluble modulins: eco-friendly theragnostic strategies against Staphylococcus aureus biofilms.
version:doi:10.1080/17460913.2026.275116.sourceAbstract: The growing resistance to antibiotics by Staphylococcus aureus and methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) is a global health threat. Traditional antibiotics act on the viability of bacteria, whereas new ones are now increasingly targeting virulence factors. Phenol-soluble modulins (PSMs) are essential virulence factors that play important roles in inflammation, neutrophil lysis, cytotoxicity and biofilm formation. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science and Google Scholar were used for literature search of articles published between 2010 and 2026. Green-synthesized metal nanoparticles (NPs) have been found to be capable of altering these mechanisms by inducing reactive oxygen species (ROS) production, membrane damage, and by interfering with the quorum-sensing mechanism of the bacteria, along with inhibiting the Agr system. Optimization of NP-based interventions can be supported by multi-omics approaches such as genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics and metabolomics. Other potential methods of targeted PSM pathway and Agr pathway suppression are also available, such as CRISPR-Cas9 and dCas9, but there are delivery difficulties. The potential use of combining nanotechnology, gene editing, multi-omics, artificial intelligence, and synthetic biology could allow for development of more advanced anti-virulence strategies against S. aureus infections targeted at PSM.

version:doi:10.3390/v18101159:1ebd63df-2.titleZh: 脱硫弧菌内源性噬菌体基因组的合成重建与表征
version:doi:10.3390/v18101159:1ebd63df-2.abstractZh: 由硫酸盐还原菌（SRB）引起的微生物影响腐蚀（MIC）是工业基础设施面临的主要挑战，然而，由于缺乏充分表征的噬菌体，阻碍了基于噬菌体的控制策略的发展。在此，我们提出了一种整合的基因组引导工作流程，用于从模式硫酸盐还原菌脱硫弧菌 Hildenborough 中发现、验证和内源前噬菌体的合成重建。使用 PHASTEST 的生物信息学分析在细菌染色体中鉴定出七个分布的前噬菌体样区域，其中五个被归类为完整前噬菌体。紫外线（UV）介导的诱导结合纯化噬菌体 DNA 的全基因组测序实验验证了在所有三个生物学重复中检测到的四个可诱导前噬菌体位点（区域 1、5、6 和 7），以及一个检测一致性较低的第五个位点（区域 2），显示出计算预测与生物活性之间的高度一致性。比较分析进一步表明，前噬菌体功能性与计算完整性并不总是相关，因为一个计算上“可疑”的区域表现出强烈的诱导性，而另一个“完整”的区域在测试条件下保持非活性。基于这些结果，选择了一个高诱导性的前噬菌体进行合成工程改造。利用长片段 PCR 和无痕等温 DNA 组装技术构建了三种逐渐截短的合成前噬菌体基因组（约 36、33 和 29 kb），并通过 Nanopore 测序验证，确认了无可见重排的精确实重建。经电穿孔导入 D. vulgaris 并进行 UV 诱导后，工程化基因组产生了可重现的局部浑浊表型，而非经典的溶菌斑，表明合成构建体仍具有生物活性，但在所检查的实验条件下未进行有效的裂解传播。对野生型细胞中代表性结构和裂解基因的定量 PCR 分析显示，UV 诱导后 21 小时内发生协调的转录激活，定义了后续表征的实际收获时间。总之，这项工作建立了一个整合的计算和合成生物学框架，用于工程化厌氧 SRB 的内源前噬菌体。该方法为研究 D. vulgaris 中的温和噬菌体生物学奠定了基础，并代表了未来开发用于 MIC 控制的工程化噬菌体平台的重要一步。
version:doi:10.3390/v18101159:1ebd63df-2.sourceTitle: Synthetic Reconstruction and Characterization of Endogenous Bacteriophage Genomes from Desulfovibrio vulgaris .
version:doi:10.3390/v18101159:1ebd63df-2.sourceAbstract: Microbiologically influenced corrosion (MIC) caused by sulfate-reducing bacteria (SRB) is a major challenge in industrial infrastructure, yet the limited availability of well-characterized bacteriophages has hindered the development of phage-based strategies for controlling these organisms. Here, we present an integrated genome-guided workflow for the discovery, validation, and synthetic reconstruction of endogenous prophages from the model sulfate-reducing bacterium Desulfovibrio vulgaris Hildenborough. Bioinformatic analysis using PHASTEST identified seven prophage-like regions distributed throughout the bacterial chromosome, including five classified as intact prophages. Ultraviolet (UV)-mediated induction followed by whole-genome sequencing of purified phage DNA experimentally validated four inducible prophage loci (Regions 1, 5, 6 and 7) detected in all three biological replicates, together with a fifth locus (Region 2) detected less consistently, demonstrating strong agreement between computational prediction and biological activity. Comparative analysis further showed that prophage functionality was not always correlated with computational completeness, as one computationally "questionable" region exhibited robust induction whereas another "intact" region remained inactive under the conditions tested. Based on these results, one highly inducible prophage was selected for synthetic engineering. Three progressively truncated synthetic prophage genomes (approximately 36, 33, and 29 kb) were assembled using long-range PCR and scarless isothermal DNA assembly and verified by Nanopore sequencing, which confirmed accurate reconstruction without detectable rearrangements. Following electroporation into D. vulgaris and UV induction, the engineered genomes produced reproducible localized turbid phenotypes rather than classical lytic plaques, indicating that the synthetic constructs remained biologically active but did not undergo efficient lytic propagation under the experimental conditions examined. Quantitative PCR analysis of representative structural and lytic genes in wild-type cells revealed coordinated transcriptional activation by 21 h after UV induction, defining a practical harvest time for subsequent characterization. Collectively, this work establishes an integrated computational and synthetic biology framework for engineering endogenous prophages from anaerobic SRB. The approach provides a foundation for investigating temperate phage biology in D. vulgaris and represents an important step toward the future development of engineered phage platforms for MIC control.

version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.titleZh: 通过代谢工程改造高葡萄糖适应性植物乳杆菌实现高效的色氨酸-3-乳酸全细胞生物转化
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.abstractZh: 由乳酸菌（LAB）和双歧杆菌生产高价值健康促进代谢益生菌色氨酸-3-乳酸（3-ILA）的生物制造仍局限于微摩尔水平。这一限制主要归因于丙酮酸与吲哚-3-丙酮酸（3-IPYA）竞争乳酸脱氢酶（LDH）和NADH，导致乳酸积累并抑制3-ILA的合成。在本研究中，评估了先前开发的高葡萄糖适应性植物乳杆菌菌株LP-D-4G和LP-D-10E作为增强3-ILa生产的底盘细胞。与亲本菌株相比，这些适应性菌株在静息细胞生物转化过程中表现出更高的L-色氨酸（L-Trp）利用率和3-ILA产量，同时丙酮酸衍生的产物分布和细胞内NAD(H)谱发生改变。通过系统基因组挖掘和在埃希氏菌中的异源表达，鉴定出五种活性乳酸脱氢酶（LDH2/3/5/6/7）和一种芳香族氨基酸转氨酶（ArAT2）。在菌株LP-D-4G中共表达LDH7和ArAT2，在全细胞生物转化中实现了6.06 mM的3-ILA产量、0.95 mol/mol的L-Trp转化率以及0.31 mol/mol的3-ILA/(3-ILA + 乳酸)比率。此外，优化L-Trp和葡萄糖的补料策略提高了3-ILA的生产。在放大的150-mL分批补料系统中，过表达LDH7和ArAT2的菌株LP-D-4G在96小时产生了20.09 mM的3-ILA，代表了迄今为止报道的基于LAB的3-ILA生产的最高滴度。峰值时，3-ILA得率、生产速率和3-ILA/(3-ILA + 乳酸)比率分别达到0.84 mol/mol L-Trp、69.45 mg/L/h和0.25 mol/mol。本研究建立了一个食品级平台用于生物活性3-ILA的生产，并证明了一种结合高葡萄糖适应性底盘与通路强化以减少乳酸并增强3-ILA的有效策略。
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.sourceTitle: Efficient whole-cell bioconversion of indole-3-lactate by metabolic engineering of high-glucose-adaptive Lactiplantibacillus plantarum.
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.sourceAbstract: Bio-production of the high-value health-promoting metabiotic indole-3-lactate (3-ILA) by lactic acid bacteria (LAB) and bifidobacteria remains constrained to micromolar levels. This limitation is largely due to pyruvate outcompeting indole-3-pyruvate (3-IPYA) for LDH and NADH, leading to lactate accumulation and suppressed 3-ILA synthesis. In this study, previously developed high-glucose-adaptive Lactiplantibacillus plantarum strains LP-D-4G and LP-D-10E were evaluated as chassis for enhanced 3-ILA production. Compared with the parental strain, the adaptive strains exhibited increased l-tryptophan (l-Trp) utilization and 3-ILA production during resting-cell bioconversion, together with altered pyruvate-derived product distributions and intracellular NAD(H) profiles. Systematic genome mining and heterologous expression in Escherichia coli identified five active lactate dehydrogenases (LDH2/3/5/6/7) and one aromatic-amino-acid aminotransferase (ArAT2). Co-expression of LDH7 and ArAT2 in strain LP-D-4G achieved 6.06 mM 3-ILA, 0.95 mol/mol l-Trp conversion, and a 3-ILA/(3-ILA + lactate) ratio of 0.31 mol/mol in whole-cell bioconversion. Furthermore, optimization of l-Trp and glucose feeding strategies improved 3-ILA production. In a scaled-up 150-mL fed-batch system, strain LP-D-4G overexpressing LDH7 and ArAT2 produced 20.09 mM 3-ILA at 96 h, representing the highest titer reported to date for LAB-based 3-ILA production. At peak, 3-ILA yield, productivity, and the 3-ILA/(3-ILA + lactate) ratio reached 0.84 mol/mol l-Trp, 69.45 mg/L/h, and 0.25 mol/mol, respectively. This study establishes a food-grade platform for bioactive 3-ILA production and demonstrates an effective strategy to reduce lactate and enhance 3-ILA by combining a high-glucose-adaptive chassis with pathway reinforcement.

version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.titleZh: 可编程细菌疫苗载体：精准免疫工程的构建-设计-控制框架
version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.abstractZh: 活体细菌载体将内在的佐剂效应、黏膜靶向性和可编程抗原递送结合在一个可工程化的底盘中，然而其开发历史上依赖于经验性减毒而非系统设计。我们提出了一种源自合成生物学范式的“构建-设计-控制”（Design-Build-Control）框架，将细菌载体工程重构为一个统一的生物技术问题。设计原则规范了安全性、免疫原性、组织嗜性和给药途径之间的权衡。构建阶段策略通过减毒、平衡致死系统和无抗生素质粒维持，将这些原则转化为遗传稳定的载体平台。控制阶段工具，包括诱导型启动子、群体感应回路和自杀开关，能够动态调节宿主内载体的行为。我们将此框架应用于主要平台类别，包括减毒革兰氏阴性和阳性菌、益生菌底盘以及非复制系统如外膜囊泡、细菌幽灵和孢子，并考察基于生物材料的制剂（包括包封和粘附涂层）如何将工程控制扩展到制造和递送环节。我们评估了转化决定因素，包括遗传稳定性、环境 containment 和监管合规性，以及涵盖传染病、肿瘤学和兽医学的应用。我们进一步评估了人工智能在细菌载体设计中的新兴作用，区分了既定的计算应用、经实验验证的方法以及仍需实验验证的前瞻性用途。通过整合合成生物学、生物材料和计算设计的进展，本综述将可编程细菌载体呈现为一项新兴的生物技术创新平台，并提出了一个用于系统评估生物安全性、可制造性和临床转化的“构建-设计-控制”（DBC）框架。

question.text: 如何克服活体细菌载体开发中依赖经验性减毒的历史局限，实现系统性设计？
question.evidence: Live bacterial vectors combine intrinsic adjuvanticity, mucosal targeting, and programmable antigen delivery within a single engineerable chassis, yet their development has historically relied on empirical attenuation rather than systematic design.

methods.text: 提出“构建-设计-控制”（DBC）框架，涵盖设计原则、构建策略（减毒、平衡致死、无抗生素质粒维持）、控制工具（诱导启动子、群体感应、自杀开关），并分析不同载体平台及生物材料制剂的应用；评估AI在载体设计中的应用现状与前景。
methods.evidence: We present a Design-Build-Control framework, adapted from synthetic biology paradigms, that reframes bacterial vector engineering as a unified biotechnological problem.

findings.text: DBC框架通过将细菌载体工程重构为统一问题，整合了安全性、免疫原性等权衡的设计原则，利用多种遗传稳定化策略和控制回路实现动态调节，并适用于多种细菌平台及生物材料制剂，同时明确了AI应用的分类及转化所需的评估维度。
findings.evidence: By integrating advances in synthetic biology, biomaterials, and computational design, this review presents programmable bacterial vectors as an emerging biotechnology platform and proposes a Design-Build-Control (DBC) framework for systematically evaluating biosafety, manufacturability, and clinical translation.

version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.sourceTitle: Programmable bacterial vaccine vectors: A Design-Build-Control framework for precision immune engineering.
version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.sourceAbstract: Live bacterial vectors combine intrinsic adjuvanticity, mucosal targeting, and programmable antigen delivery within a single engineerable chassis, yet their development has historically relied on empirical attenuation rather than systematic design. We present a Design-Build-Control framework, adapted from synthetic biology paradigms, that reframes bacterial vector engineering as a unified biotechnological problem. Design principles govern trade-offs among safety, immunogenicity, tissue tropism, and route of administration. Build-stage strategies translate these principles into genetically stable vector platforms through attenuation, balanced-lethal systems, and antibiotic-free plasmid maintenance. Control-stage tools, including inducible promoters, quorum-sensing circuits, and kill switches, enable dynamic regulation of vector behavior within the host. We apply this framework across major platform classes, including live attenuated Gram-negative and Gram-positive bacteria, probiotic chassis, and non-replicating systems such as outer membrane vesicles, bacterial ghosts, and spores, and examine how biomaterial-based formulation, including encapsulation and mucoadhesive coatings, extends engineering control into manufacturing and delivery. We evaluate translational determinants, including genetic stability, environmental containment, and regulatory compliance, alongside applications spanning infectious disease, oncology, and veterinary medicine. We further assess the emerging role of artificial intelligence in bacterial-vector design, distinguishing established computational applications, experimentally validated approaches, and prospective uses that still require experimental validation. By integrating advances in synthetic biology, biomaterials, and computational design, this review presents programmable bacterial vectors as an emerging biotechnology platform and proposes a Design-Build-Control (DBC) framework for systematically evaluating biosafety, manufacturability, and clinical translation.

version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.titleZh: 基于蔗糖利用筛选标记在毕赤酵母中生产重组人蛋白且无抗生素抗性
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.abstractZh: 毕赤酵母（K. phaffii）是用于重组蛋白生产的最广泛使用的真核表达系统之一。然而，其工业应用受到对传统基于抗生素的筛选的依赖以及无法利用蔗糖的限制。基于在黑曲霉 SucF 蔗糖水解酶在 K. phaffii 中的异源表达，该菌株获得了利用蔗糖的能力。验证表明，该性状可作为蔗糖选择性条件下的显性筛选标记，使 SucF 成为无抗生素菌株构建的筛选标记。在 40 g/L 蔗糖的选择压力下，基因整合效率达到 100%，与传统抗生素筛选相当。值得注意的是，该系统允许用蔗糖替代原始甘油碳源进行发酵。为了提高 SucF 的筛选效率，通过计算机辅助蛋白质工程鉴定出三重突变体（T65A/R322Q/S323G），与野生型相比，其蔗糖水解速率提高了 57%。结构分析显示，这种突变重塑了蔗糖结合口袋。最终，SucF 突变体与组氨酸营养缺陷型标记（HIS4）结合用作筛选标记，在 GS115 中实现了人乳铁蛋白（hLF）和人骨桥蛋白（hOPN）的分泌表达，所得重组菌株不含抗生素基因残留。这种基于蔗糖的无抗生素平台为绿色生物制造和 devoid of antibiotic resistance genes 的重组蛋白工业生产提供了有前景的策略。
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.sourceTitle: Production of recombinant human proteins in Komagataella phaffii using a sucrose-utilization-based selection marker without antibiotic resistance.
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.sourceAbstract: Komagataella phaffii (K. phaffii) is one of the most widely used eukaryotic expression systems for recombinant protein production. However, its industrial application is constrained by reliance on traditional antibiotic-based selection and the inability to utilize sucrose. Based on the heterologous expression of the sucrose hydrolase SucF from Aspergillus flavus in K. phaffii, the strain acquired the ability to utilize sucrose. It was verified that this trait can serve as a dominant selection marker under sucrose-selective conditions, making SucF a selection marker for antibiotic-free strain construction. Under a selection pressure of 40 g/L sucrose, the gene integration efficiency reached 100 %, comparable to that of traditional antibiotic selection. Notably, this system enables the substitution of the original glycerol carbon source with sucrose for fermentation. To improve the selection efficiency of SucF, a triple mutant (T65A/R322Q/S323G) was identified through computer-aided protein engineering, exhibiting a 57 % increase in sucrose hydrolysis rate compared to the wild type. Structural analysis revealed that this mutation remodels the sucrose-binding pocket. Ultimately, the SucF mutant was used as a selection marker in combination with the histidine auxotrophic marker (HIS4) to achieve secretory expression of human lactoferrin (hLF) and human osteopontin (hOPN) in the GS115, and the resulting recombinant strain was free of antibiotic gene residues. This sucrose-based antibiotic-free platform in K. phaffii provides a promising strategy for green biomanufacturing and industrial production of recombinant proteins devoid of antibiotic resistance genes.

version:doi:10.1080/14786419.2026.274776.titleZh: 喜树（Taxus wallichiana Zucc.）（喜马拉雅红豆杉）：植物化学、治疗潜力、生物技术和保护视角
version:doi:10.1080/14786419.2026.274776.abstractZh: 喜马拉雅红豆杉是印度喜马拉雅地区及邻国的一种濒危针叶树，被公认为紫杉醇（Taxol®）及其前体10-去乙酰巴卡丁III（10-DAB）的天然来源。本综述综合整理了关于其植物化学、药理潜力、生物技术和保护的当前知识，强调了最近的进展、研究空白和未来方向。植物化学研究鉴定了多种生物活性化合物，包括紫杉烷类（紫杉醇、海索康宁和walitaxanes）、黄酮类、木质素和酚酸，这些成分赋予了其抗氧化、抗炎、抗菌和抗癌特性。组织培养、代谢工程和内生真菌研究的进展为紫杉烷的生产提供了有希望的替代方案，有望减少破坏性的树皮采集。尽管具有医药和制药意义，喜马拉雅红豆杉仍面临过度开发、再生不良、栖息地退化和放牧压力的严重威胁。保护措施包括迁地繁殖、遗传多样性评估、栖息地恢复以及可再生枝叶和内源性衍生物代谢产物的可持续利用。通过整合民族医学知识、植物化学多样性、药理应用、生物技术革新和保护优先事项，本综述为该物种的科学和生态重要性提供了多学科视角。未来的研究应加强可持续生产系统，阐明其生物活性化合物的治疗潜力，并将传统生态知识与现代生物技术和保护生物学相结合，以支持这种珍贵的喜马拉雅药用针叶树的长期生存和可持续利用。
version:doi:10.1080/14786419.2026.274776.sourceTitle: Taxus wallichiana zucc. (Himalayan yew): phytochemistry, therapeutic potential, biotechnology, and conservation perspectives.
version:doi:10.1080/14786419.2026.274776.sourceAbstract: Taxus wallichiana Zucc. (Himalayan yew) is an endangered conifer of the Indian Himalayan Region and adjoining countries, recognised as a natural source of paclitaxel (Taxol ® ) and its precursor 10-deacetylbaccatin III (10-DAB). This review comprehensively synthesises current knowledge of its phytochemistry, pharmacological potential, biotechnology, and conservation, highlighting recent advances, research gaps, and future directions. Phytochemical investigations have identified diverse bioactive compounds, including taxoids (paclitaxel, cephalomannine, and wallitaxanes), flavonoids, lignans, and phenolic acids, contributing to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer properties. Advances in tissue culture, metabolic engineering, and endophytic fungal research offer promising alternatives for taxoid production, potentially reducing destructive bark harvesting. Despite its medicinal and pharmaceutical significance, Taxus wallichiana faces serious threats from overexploitation, poor regeneration, habitat degradation, and grazing pressure. Conservation approaches include ex situ propagation, genetic diversity assessment, habitat restoration, and sustainable utilisation of renewable foliage and endophyte-derived metabolites. By integrating ethnomedicinal knowledge, phytochemical diversity, pharmacological applications, biotechnological innovations, and conservation priorities, this review provides a multidisciplinary perspective on the species' scientific and ecological importance. Future research should strengthen sustainable production systems, clarify therapeutic potential of its bioactive compounds, and integrate traditional ecological knowledge with modern biotechnology and conservation biology to support the long-term survival and sustainable utilisation of this valuable Himalayan medicinal conifer.

version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.titleZh: 碳损失指导的代谢工程提高了l-苏氨酸发酵中的碳原子经济性和工业底物利用率
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.abstractZh: l-苏氨酸是一种高价值氨基酸，广泛用于饲料、食品和制药行业，但其工业生产受限于低产量。在本研究中，对工业菌株Thr1进行了全基因组测序，并重建了基因组尺度代谢模型GSMM-iJHL1061。该模型鉴定了54个与CO2相关的反应，并预测每合成1摩尔l-苏氨酸释放0.89摩尔CO2，主要来自PPP和TCA循环。减弱涉及ilvBN、lysA、gnd和icd的脱羧反应，并结合基于RuBisCO-Prk和cynT-pyc的CO2固定，使产量提高至0.66 g/g。删除166个非必需基因产生了Thr9，将产量提高至0.67 g/g。进一步引入麦芽糖水解和蔗糖利用系统产生了Thr10，在1000-L发酵罐中生产了132.5 g/L l-苏氨酸，产量为0.68 g/g。总体而言，通过系统代谢工程显著提高了l-苏氨酸产量，为构建高产微生物细胞工厂提供了有益参考。

question.text: 如何通过代谢工程提高l-苏氨酸的产量及碳原子经济性？
question.evidence: l-Threonine is a high-value amino acid widely used in the feed, food, and pharmaceutical industries, but its industrial production is limited by low yield.

methods.text: 对工业菌株Thr1进行全基因组测序并重建基因组尺度代谢模型；减弱特定脱羧反应并引入CO2固定途径；删除非必需基因；引入麦芽糖水解和蔗糖利用系统；在1000-L发酵罐中进行发酵测试。
methods.evidence: In this study, whole-genome sequencing of industrial strain Thr1 was performed, and the genome-scale metabolic model GSMM-iJHL1061 was reconstructed.

findings.text: 模型预测每合成1摩尔l-苏氨酸释放0.89摩尔CO2；减弱脱羧反应结合CO2固定使产量达0.66 g/g；删除166个非必需基因产生Thr9，产量达0.67 g/g；引入碳水化合物利用系统产生Thr10，在1000-L发酵罐中产量达0.68 g/g且浓度为132.5 g/L。
findings.evidence: Attenuation of decarboxylation reactions involving ilvBN, lysA, gnd, and icd, combined with RuBisCO-Prk and cynT-pyc-based CO 2 fixation, increased the yield to 0.66 g/g.

version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.sourceTitle: Carbon-loss-guided metabolic engineering improved carbon atom economy and industrial feedstock utilization for l-threonine fermentation.
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.sourceAbstract: l-Threonine is a high-value amino acid widely used in the feed, food, and pharmaceutical industries, but its industrial production is limited by low yield. In this study, whole-genome sequencing of industrial strain Thr1 was performed, and the genome-scale metabolic model GSMM-iJHL1061 was reconstructed. The model identified 54 CO 2 -related reactions and predicted 0.89 mol CO 2 release per mol l-threonine synthesized, mainly from the PPP and TCA cycle. Attenuation of decarboxylation reactions involving ilvBN, lysA, gnd, and icd, combined with RuBisCO-Prk and cynT-pyc-based CO 2 fixation, increased the yield to 0.66 g/g. Deletion of 166 non-essential genes generated Thr9, increasing the yield to 0.67 g/g. Further introduction of maltose hydrolysis and sucrose utilization systems generated Thr10, which produced 132.5 g/L l-threonine in a 1000-L fermenter, with a yield of 0.68 g/g. Overall, l-threonine yield was substantially improved through systems metabolic engineering, providing a useful reference for constructing high-yield microbial cell factories.

version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_343:f69368c-.abstractZh: 琥珀酸（SA）是一种具有广泛生物降解材料、制药和食品添加剂应用的关键平台化学品，其市场需求持续快速扩张。传统SA生产工艺严重依赖化石资源，伴随大量碳排放，并造成显著的环境负担，使其与全球碳中和目标及向可持续低碳发展的过渡不相容。相比之下，微生物生物利用可再生碳原料在温和操作条件下进行生产，表现出高原子经济性，为石化路线提供了有前景的替代方案。在本综述中，我们系统地追溯了基于生物的SA的历史发展，重点聚焦于旨在降低成本的工艺创新。我们总结了参与SA生物合成的主要代谢途径，并批判性地考察了天然产琥珀酸反刍动物瘤胃细菌、代谢工程化细菌以及酵母底盘系统的进展。此外，我们客观分析了非粮原料在基于生物的SA生产中的应用，并强调尽管目前缺乏经济竞争力，但此类原料代表了未来基于生物的绿色和可持续发展的重要方向。最后，我们分析了全球及中国基于生物的SA的商业化轨迹和战略格局。本综述旨在提供概念框架和理论见解，以促进绿色SA生物制造从实验室研究向大规模工业实施的转变。
version:doi:10.1007/10_2026_343:f69368c-.sourceAbstract: Succinic acid (SA) is a key platform chemical with broad applications in biodegradable materials, pharmaceuticals, and food additives, and its market demand continues to expand rapidly. Conventional production processes for SA rely heavily on fossil resources, are associated with substantial carbon emissions, and impose significant environmental burdens, rendering them incompatible with global carbon neutrality goals and the ongoing transition toward sustainable, low-carbon development. Microbial biosynthesis, by contrast, utilizes renewable carbon feedstocks under mild operating conditions and exhibits high atom economy, offering a promising alternative to petrochemical routes. In this review, we systematically trace the historical development of bio-based SA, focusing on technological innovations aimed at cost reduction. We summarize the principal metabolic pathways involved in SA biosynthesis, and critically examine advances in native SA-producing rumen bacteria, metabolically engineered bacteria, and yeast chassis systems. Furthermore, we objectively analyze the application of non-food feedstocks in bio-based SA production and highlight that, despite the current lack of economic competitiveness, such feedstocks represent a crucial direction for the future green and sustainable development of bio-based SA. Finally, we analyze the commercialization trajectory and strategic landscape of bio-based SA both globally and in China. This review aims to provide a conceptual framework and theoretical insights to facilitate the transition of green SA biomanufacturing from laboratory research to large-scale industrial implementation.

version:doi:10.1016/j.tips.2026.09.009:5.titleZh: 工程化单核细胞和巨噬细胞用于治疗性控制
version:doi:10.1016/j.tips.2026.09.009:5.abstractZh: 工程化单核细胞和巨噬细胞正成为消除病理靶点、重塑患病组织以及协调局部免疫反应的治疗平台。早期临床研究支持其可行性，但仅靠靶点识别并不能确保进入组织后的持续功能。髓系适配受体、环境响应回路、检查点和代谢工程、体内mRNA递送以及干细胞衍生平台等方面的最新进展，扩大了可用于改善组织追踪、控制细胞可塑性并维持效应能力的策略范围。以往的综述通常按疾病、靶点或平台来组织该领域。在此，我们将工程化单核细胞和巨噬细胞疗法作为整合的药理学系统进行检查，该系统由四个耦合层构成——传感、信号整合、执行和递送——并讨论它们的协调如何决定在不同治疗设置中的组织暴露、功能持久性和药效学读数。
version:doi:10.1016/j.tips.2026.09.009:5.sourceTitle: Engineering monocytes and macrophages for therapeutic control.
version:doi:10.1016/j.tips.2026.09.009:5.sourceAbstract: Engineered monocytes and macrophages are emerging as therapeutic platforms for eliminating pathological targets, remodeling diseased tissues, and coordinating local immune responses. Early clinical studies support their feasibility, but target recognition alone does not ensure sustained function after tissue entry. Recent advances in myeloid-adapted receptors, context-responsive circuits, checkpoint and metabolic engineering, in vivo mRNA delivery, and stem-cell-derived platforms have expanded the strategies available to improve tissue tracking, control cellular plasticity, and sustain effector capacity. Previous reviews have commonly organized the field by disease, target, or platform. Here, we examine engineered monocyte and macrophage therapies as integrated pharmacological systems structured across four coupled layers-sensing, signal integration, actuation, and delivery-and discuss how their coordination determines tissue exposure, functional durability, and pharmacodynamic readouts across therapeutic settings.

version:doi:10.1016/j.cis.2026.104072:8c.titleZh: 生物凝胶基墨水在3D食品打印中的结构-性能关系见解：从水凝胶和油凝胶到大凝胶
version:doi:10.1016/j.cis.2026.104072:8c.abstractZh: 三维食品打印（3DFP）能够实现具有可定制几何形状、质地和营养特征的食用结构的按需制造。生物凝胶基墨水（BG ink），包括水凝胶、油凝胶和大凝胶，提供了一个高度通用的平台，因为它们的流变学和理化性能可以进行系统调整，以满足特定的加工和功能要求。本综述通过多尺度结构-性能-功能框架，批判性地综合了生物凝胶基3DFP的最新进展。它比较了水凝胶中分子交联和水限域的作用、油凝胶中油结构化网络的作用以及大凝胶中相组织和界面耦合的作用，将这些结构机制与墨水性能和宏观功能联系起来。在此基础上，讨论进一步将配方依赖性性能与关键打印参数联系起来，以解释印刷结构的形状保真度、结构稳定性以及与感官相关的和功能特性。这些结构-功能关系在代表性应用的背景下进一步讨论，包括个性化和功能食品、临床和治疗饮食、人工智能集成以及可持续生物制造。还确定了当前的局限性和未来的研究需求。总体而言，本综述阐明了生物凝胶微观结构、墨水性能和最终产品性能之间的多尺度关系，为下一代BG ink和先进3DFP系统的合理设计提供了科学基础。
version:doi:10.1016/j.cis.2026.104072:8c.sourceTitle: Insights into the structure-property relationships of biogel-based inks in 3D food printing: From hydrogels and oleogels to bigels.
version:doi:10.1016/j.cis.2026.104072:8c.sourceAbstract: Three dimensional food printing (3DFP) enables the on-demand fabrication of edible constructs with customizable geometries, textures, and nutritional profiles. Biogel-based inks (BG ink ), including hydrogels, oleogels, and bigels, provide a highly versatile platform, as their rheological and physicochemical properties can be systematically tuned to meet specific processing and functional requirements. This review critically synthesizes recent advances in biogel-based 3DFP through a multiscale structure-property-function framework. It compares the roles of molecular crosslinking and water confinement in hydrogels, oil-structuring networks in oleogels, and phase organization and interfacial coupling in bigels, linking these structural mechanisms to ink properties and macroscopic functionality. Building upon these colloidal and interfacial architectures, the discussion then connects formulation-dependent properties with key printing parameters to explain the shape fidelity, structural stability, and sensory-related and functional properties of printed structures. These structure-function relationships are further discussed in the context of representative applications, including personalized and functional foods, clinical and therapeutic diets, artificial intelligence integration, and sustainable biomanufacturing. Current limitations and future research needs are also identified. Overall, this review clarifies the multiscale relationships among biogel microstructures, ink properties, and end-product performance, providing a scientific foundation for the rational design of next-generation BG ink and advanced 3DFP systems.

version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.titleZh: 从富油微藻到海洋底盘：在Nannochloropsis中合成生物学与工艺导向的生物制造
version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.abstractZh: Nannochloropsis已从一种主要因富含二十碳五烯酸（EPA）脂质而备受推崇的富油海洋微藻，发展成为海洋光合生物制造的可靠候选者。其工具包现已涵盖基因组资源、高效的核转化、同源重组、CRISPR/Cas编辑、标记回收、定义整合位点以及模块化多基因组装。研究人员利用这些能力改变了碳分配、三酰甘油积累、EPA合成和脂质类群分布、类胡萝卜素代谢、重组蛋白生产、特色代谢物形成以及培养稳健性。本综述评估了这些进展是否足以支持将Nannochloropsis作为可预测、可重用且感知工艺的底盘。证据表明，该属已超越了基本的可转化性。靶向基因组修饰和途径构建是可行的，并且内源性和非内源性产物已达到具有生物学意义水平，在某些情况下甚至达到工艺相关水平。然而，结果仍强烈受到基因组位点、菌株背景、细胞内区室、生理状态和培养制度的影响。因此，平台成熟将依赖于可重用的基因组架构、可靠的细胞器靶向规则、动态调节以及适用于迭代设计-构建-测试-学习工作流的表型分析。菌株设计还必须更紧密地与培养、收获、产品回收和部署相结合。针对特定产品的底盘配置可能比用于富含EPA的油类、色素、重组产品和特色代谢物的通用菌株更具实用性。因此，Nannochloropsis为工业相关的非模式光合真核生物如何成为更具设计性的海洋生产宿主提供了有用的测试案例。
version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.sourceTitle: From oleaginous microalga to marine chassis: synthetic biology and process-aware biomanufacturing in Nannochloropsis.
version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.sourceAbstract: Nannochloropsis has developed from an oleaginous marine microalga valued mainly for eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA)-rich lipids into a credible candidate for marine photosynthetic biomanufacturing. Its toolkit now spans genome resources, efficient nuclear transformation, homologous recombination, CRISPR/Cas editing, marker recycling, defined integration sites, and modular multigene assembly. Researchers have used these capabilities to alter carbon allocation, triacylglycerol accumulation, EPA synthesis and lipid-class partitioning, carotenoid metabolism, recombinant-protein production, specialty-metabolite formation, and cultivation robustness. This review assesses whether these advances are sufficient to support Nannochloropsis as a predictable, reusable, and process-aware chassis. The evidence shows that the genus has moved beyond basic transformability. Targeted genome modification and pathway construction are feasible, and native and non-native products have reached biologically relevant and, in some cases, process-relevant levels. However, outcomes remain strongly influenced by genomic locus, strain background, intracellular compartment, physiological state, and cultivation regime. Platform maturation will therefore depend on reusable genomic architectures, reliable organelle-targeting rules, dynamic regulation, and phenotyping suited to iterative design-build-test-learn workflows. Strain design must also be coupled more closely to cultivation, harvesting, product recovery, and deployment. Product-specific chassis configurations are likely to be more practical than a universal strain for EPA-rich oils, pigments, recombinant products, and specialty metabolites. Nannochloropsis thus provides a useful test of how an industrially relevant, non-model photosynthetic eukaryote can become a more designable marine production host.

version:doi:10.1186/s40643-026-01146-w:8.titleZh: γ-亚麻酸生物合成的微生物细胞工厂：代谢工程、下游加工及未来展望
version:doi:10.1186/s40643-026-01146-w:8.abstractZh: γ-亚麻酸（GLA）是一种重要的抗炎多不饱和脂肪酸，然而，其传统来源如月见草和琉璃苣等植物种子的供应受到低产量和气候不稳定性的限制。因此，微生物细胞工厂为大规模生产GLA提供了一种可持续且不受季节影响的替代方案。本综述批判性地综合了利用亲脂性微生物作为生产平台的最新生物技术进展。它系统地阐明了微生物脂质生物合成途径，并评估了提高GLA积累的策略，特别强调理性的代谢工程。此外，还全面考察了用于微生物脂质生产的新技术以及工业规模应用的最新进展。最后，提供了全面的见解，以指导整个价值链的优化，从上游菌株工程到下游加工。

question.text: 如何利用微生物细胞工厂克服植物来源γ-亚麻酸产量低和气候不稳定的限制，实现可持续的大规模生产？
question.evidence: Gamma-linolenic acid (GLA) is a vital anti-inflammatory polyunsaturated fatty acid, yet its traditional supply from plant seeds such as evening primrose and borage is constrained by low yields and climatic instability.

methods.text: 批判性综合利用亲脂性微生物作为生产平台的最新生物技术进展；系统阐明微生物脂质生物合成途径；评估提高γ-亚麻酸积累的策略，特别是理性代谢工程；考察微生物脂质生产的新兴技术及工业规模应用进展。
methods.evidence: This review critically synthesizes recent biotechnological advancements in utilizing oleaginous microorganisms as production platforms.

findings.text: 微生物细胞工厂是生产γ-亚麻酸的可持续且不受季节影响的替代方案；综述涵盖了从上游菌株工程到下游加工的整个价值链优化见解。
findings.evidence: Consequently, microbial cell factories present a sustainable and season-independent alternative for scalable GLA production.

version:doi:10.1186/s40643-026-01146-w:8.sourceTitle: Microbial cell factories for gamma-linolenic acid biosynthesis: metabolic engineering, downstream processing, and future perspectives.
version:doi:10.1186/s40643-026-01146-w:8.sourceAbstract: Gamma-linolenic acid (GLA) is a vital anti-inflammatory polyunsaturated fatty acid, yet its traditional supply from plant seeds such as evening primrose and borage is constrained by low yields and climatic instability. Consequently, microbial cell factories present a sustainable and season-independent alternative for scalable GLA production. This review critically synthesizes recent biotechnological advancements in utilizing oleaginous microorganisms as production platforms. It systematically elucidates the microbial lipid biosynthesis pathways and evaluates strategies to enhance GLA accumulation, with particular emphasis on rational metabolic engineering. Furthermore, emerging technologies for microbial lipid production, alongside the latest progress in industrial-scale applications, are thoroughly examined. Finally, comprehensive insights are provided to guide the optimization of the entire value chain, ranging from upstream strain engineering to downstream processing.

version:doi:10.1007/s10532-026-10393-9:2.titleZh: 基于微藻的抗生素去除与生物降解：机制、协同菌群及工程前景
version:doi:10.1007/s10532-026-10393-9:2.abstractZh: 水生环境中的抗生素污染推动了抗性基因的传播，并威胁生态系统健康。微藻提供了一个双重功能平台，既能感知抗生素胁迫，又能主动去除这些污染物。本综述综合了关于基于微藻的抗生素去除和生物转化的当前知识，强调生物吸附、酶介导转化（主要通过细胞色素P450和硝基还原酶）以及共代谢过程的整合。我们强调了藻际作为动态界面的作用，共生细菌在此增强藻类的生存能力和污染物去除效率，同时调节抗性基因的富集和传播。藻-细菌颗粒污泥系统展示了这种协同作用的实际应用潜力，实现了高效的抗生素去除和抗性传播的抑制。新兴工具如固定化技术、合成生物学和机器学习显示出进一步提高系统稳健性的潜力，并可能促进精确的过程控制，尽管其可扩展性和长期性能仍有待验证。通过将基础机制与工程策略联系起来，本综述为开发符合全球抗微生物耐药性行动计划的可持续、低碳生物修复技术提供了框架。

question.text: 如何有效去除水生环境中的抗生素并遏制抗性基因传播？
question.evidence: Antibiotic pollution in aquatic environments drives the spread of resistance genes and threatens ecosystem health.

methods.text: 综述基于微藻的抗生素去除和生物转化机制，包括生物吸附、酶介导转化（细胞色素P450和硝基还原酶）、共代谢过程，以及藻际中共生细菌的作用；分析藻-细菌颗粒污泥系统等工程应用，并评估固定化、合成生物学和机器学习等新兴工具的潜力。
methods.evidence: This review synthesizes current knowledge on microalgae-based antibiotic removal and biotransformation, emphasizing the integration of biosorption, enzyme-mediated transformation-primarily via cytochrome P450 and nitroreductase-and co‑metabolic processes.

findings.text: 微藻提供双重功能平台以感知和去除抗生素；藻际中的共生细菌增强藻类生存和污染物去除，并调节抗性基因；藻-细菌颗粒污泥系统能高效去除抗生素并抑制抗性传播；固定化、合成生物学和机器学习有助于提高系统稳健性和过程控制，但可扩展性和长期性能尚待验证。
findings.evidence: Emerging tools such as immobilization, synthetic biology, and machine learning show potential to further improve system robustness and may facilitate precision process control, although their scalability and long-term performance remain to be validated.

limitations.text: 新兴工具（固定化、合成生物学、机器学习）的可扩展性和长期性能仍有待验证。
limitations.evidence: Emerging tools such as immobilization, synthetic biology, and machine learning show potential to further improve system robustness and may facilitate precision process control, although their scalability and long-term performance remain to be validated.

version:doi:10.1007/s10532-026-10393-9:2.sourceTitle: Microalgae-based removal and biodegradation of antibiotics: mechanisms, synergistic consortia, and engineering prospects.
version:doi:10.1007/s10532-026-10393-9:2.sourceAbstract: Antibiotic pollution in aquatic environments drives the spread of resistance genes and threatens ecosystem health. Microalgae offer a dual-function platform that both senses antibiotic stress and actively removes these contaminants. This review synthesizes current knowledge on microalgae-based antibiotic removal and biotransformation, emphasizing the integration of biosorption, enzyme-mediated transformation-primarily via cytochrome P450 and nitroreductase-and co‑metabolic processes. We highlight the phycosphere as a dynamic interface where symbiotic bacteria enhance algal survival and pollutant removal, while also modulating the enrichment and dissemination of resistance genes. Algal-bacterial granular sludge systems illustrate the practical potential of this synergy, achieving efficient antibiotic removal and suppression of resistance propagation. Emerging tools such as immobilization, synthetic biology, and machine learning show potential to further improve system robustness and may facilitate precision process control, although their scalability and long-term performance remain to be validated. By linking fundamental mechanisms with engineering strategies, this review provides a framework for developing sustainable, low-carbon bioremediation technologies aligned with global antimicrobial resistance action plans.

version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.titleZh: 大肠杆菌模块重构与多级调控用于高效尿苷生产
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.abstractZh: 尿苷是一种重要的嘧啶核苷，在制药、食品和生物制造领域有广泛应用。然而，微生物合成尿苷仍受限于不理想的效价、产率和生产率。在此，采用模块重构结合多级代谢工程来设计和构建高产的大肠杆菌平台菌株，以实现高效尿苷合成。最初通过引入源自枯草芽孢杆菌的嘧啶操纵子并破坏尿苷降解途径，增强了嘧啶生物合成能力，从而促进从头形成尿苷。进一步的代谢优化侧重于通过加强氨基甲酰磷酸供应、增加嘧啶操纵子剂量、减少尿苷摄取和优化前体供应来提高前体可用性和产物积累。为了平衡细胞生长和尿苷合成，利用Esa群体感应系统动态调节thrA表达，同时过量表达5'-核苷酸酶YjjG显著提高了尿苷产量。通过这些策略的组合，工程菌株U20-2在摇瓶发酵中实现了17.99 g/L的尿苷效价。优化的两阶段温度控制补料分批发酵过程进一步将尿苷产量提高到82小时内的105.68 g/L，产率和生产率分别为0.265 g/g和1.28 g/L/h。这代表了迄今为止报道的大肠杆菌基于葡萄糖生产尿苷的最高效价，值得注意的是，整个发酵过程无需外源诱导剂或抗生素。总体而言，本研究为尿苷及相关嘧啶核苷的高效生物制造提供了一种极具前景且实用的策略。
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.sourceTitle: Modular reconstruction and multi-level regulation of Escherichia coli for efficient uridine production.
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.sourceAbstract: Uridine is an important pyrimidine nucleoside with extensive applications in pharmaceuticals, food, and biomanufacturing. However, the microbial synthesis of uridine is still hindered by unsatisfactory titer, yield, and productivity. Here, modular reconstruction combined with multilevel metabolic engineering was employed to design and construct a high-yielding Escherichia coli platform strain for efficient uridine synthesis. Enhancing the pyrimidine biosynthetic capacity was initially achieved by introducing a pyrimidine operon derived from Bacillus subtilis and disrupting the uridine degradation pathway, thereby promoting de novo uridine formation. Further metabolic optimization focused on improving precursor availability and product accumulation by strengthening carbamoyl phosphate supply, increasing pyrimidine operon dosage, reducing uridine uptake, and optimizing precursor supply. To balance cellular growth and uridine synthesis, the Esa quorum sensing system was utilized for dynamic regulation of thrA expression, while overexpression of the 5'-nucleotidase YjjG substantially increased uridine production. Through the combination of these strategies, the engineered strain U20-2 achieved a uridine titer of 17.99 g/L in shake flask fermentation. An optimized two-stage temperature-controlled fed-batch fermentation process further increased uridine production to 105.68 g/L within 82 h, with a yield and productivity of 0.265 g/g and 1.28 g/L/h, respectively. This represents the highest titer reported to date for glucose-based uridine production in E. coli, and notably, the entire fermentation process was carried out without exogenous inducers or antibiotics. Overall, this study offers a highly promising and practical strategy for the efficient biomanufacturing of uridine and related pyrimidine nucleosides.

version:doi:10.3390/life16101742:f7d645b.titleZh: 植物-微生物相互作用作为铁生物强化新兴的生物制造平台，以水稻为主要模型
version:doi:10.3390/life16101742:f7d645b.abstractZh: 铁缺乏仍然是依赖低铁生物利用度主食（包括精米）的人群面临的主要公共卫生挑战。本叙事综述评估了有益的植物相关微生物如何通过影响根际铁的动员、根系吸收以及随后向可食用组织的运输来支持铁（Fe）生物强化。我们沿着土壤-植物-谷物-食物连续体组织现有证据，并区分已测量的结果与提出的机制联系。这种基于证据的框架在严格的概念意义上被描述为植物-微生物生物制造平台：植物和微生物都不制造铁；相反，它们的相互作用可以改变铁的动员和分布。大多数研究证明了微生物对铁有效性和植物生理的影响，但较少有研究确立谷物中铁含量的增加，且关于铁在抛光后保留或被消费者吸收的证据仍然稀缺。未来的工作应整合田间验证、氮和水管理、铁定位、食品加工和营养生物利用度。这种方法可能有助于优先考虑可测试的干预措施，而不将微生物活性或较高的总谷物铁含量等同于改善的人类铁状况。
version:doi:10.3390/life16101742:f7d645b.sourceTitle: Plant-Microbe Interactions as Emerging Biomanufacturing Platforms for Iron Biofortification, with Rice as a Principal Model.
version:doi:10.3390/life16101742:f7d645b.sourceAbstract: Iron deficiency remains a major public health challenge in populations relying on staple foods with low iron bioavailability, including polished rice. This narrative review evaluates how beneficial plant-associated microorganisms may support iron (Fe) biofortification by influencing Fe mobilization in the rhizosphere, root acquisition, and subsequent transport to edible tissues. We organize the existing evidence along a soil-plant-grain-food continuum and distinguish measured outcomes from proposed mechanistic links. This evidence-based framework is described as a plant-microbe biomanufacturing platform in a strictly conceptual sense: neither plants nor microorganisms manufacture Fe; rather, their interactions can modify its mobilization and distribution. Most studies have demonstrated microbial effects on Fe availability and plant physiology, but fewer have established increased Fe in grain, and evidence for Fe being retained after polishing or absorbed by consumers remains scarce. Future work should integrate field validation, nitrogen and water management, Fe localization, food processing, and nutritional bioavailability. This approach may help prioritize testable interventions without equating microbial activity or higher total grain Fe with improved human iron status.

version:doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2026.102570:.titleZh: 协调聚酮合酶衍生的醛代谢以用于链霉菌生物制造
version:doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2026.102570:.abstractZh: 代谢工程的进展使得将各种非天然反应整合到微生物宿主中成为可能，为石油化工制造提供了可持续的替代方案。我们此前在白色链霉菌（Streptomyces albus）中开发了一种基于模块化聚酮合酶（PKS）的平台，用于生产17种二醇、氨基醇和羟基酸。在该平台中，末端硫酯还原酶（TRs）释放醛中间体，随后由PKS后酶将其转化为控制产物化学性质。在此我们发现，PKS-TR菌株积累了数百个全基因组单核苷酸变异，包括导致酶活性受损的保守PKS和TR残基上的错义突变。基于醛毒性的假设，我们通过基因共整合或PKS-TR-ADH融合将TR催化与下游醇脱氢酶（ADHs）偶联，以限制醛的积累。这些策略降低了基因组变异性并提高了二醇产量，在生物反应器中总二醇滴度达到14.2 g/L，其中包括10.8 g/L的1,3-丁二醇。扩展该方法，工程菌株通过引入PKS-TR共整合与转氨酶或padA醛脱氢酶，相比先前的报道实现了高79%的总氨基醇滴度和高145%的2-甲基-3-羟基己酸滴度，同时消除了优化后的羟基酸途径中的二醇副产物。这些结果确立了TR介导的醛释放作为可编程分支点，并将协调的下游催化作为一种提高基于PKS的链霉菌生物制造的稳定性、生产力和选择性的通用策略。
version:doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2026.102570:.sourceTitle: Orchestrating polyketide synthase-derived aldehyde metabolism for Streptomyces biomanufacturing.
version:doi:10.1016/j.ymben.2026.102570:.sourceAbstract: Advances in metabolic engineering have enabled the integration of diverse non-native reactions into microbial hosts, providing sustainable alternatives to petrochemical manufacturing. We previously developed a modular polyketide synthase (PKS)-based platform in Streptomyces albus for producing 17 diols, amino alcohols, and hydroxy acids. In this platform, terminal thioester reductases (TRs) release aldehyde intermediates that are subsequently converted by post-PKS enzymes to control product chemistry. Here we found that PKS-TR strains accumulated hundreds of genome-wide single-nucleotide variants, including missense mutations on conserved PKS and TR residues leading to impaired enzyme activity. Based on the hypothesis of aldehyde toxicity, we coupled TR catalysis with downstream alcohol dehydrogenases (ADHs) through gene co-integration or PKS-TR-ADH fusion to limit aldehyde accumulation. These strategies reduced genomic variability and increased diol production, reaching a total diol titer of 14.2 g/L in bioreactors, including 10.8 g/L 1,3-butanediol. Extending this approach, engineered strains incorporating PKS-TR co-integration with transaminases or the padA aldehyde dehydrogenase achieved 79% higher total amino alcohol titers and 145% higher 2-methyl-3-hydroxyhexanoic acid titer than previous reports, while eliminating diol byproducts from the optimized hydroxy acid pathway. These results establish TR-mediated aldehyde release as a programmable branch point and orchestrated downstream catalysis as a general strategy for improving the stability, productivity, and selectivity of PKS-based Streptomyces biomanufacturing.

version:doi:10.1007/s12223-026-01613-z:6.titleZh: 用于下一代生物肥料中精准营养递送的智能载体工程化微生物群落
version:doi:10.1007/s12223-026-01613-z:6.abstractZh: 在气候变化下对可持续农业生产力的需求日益增加，基于工程化微生物群落和智能递送系统的新世代生物肥料的进步已成为农业活动不可或缺的一部分。基于工程化微生物群落和智能递送系统的新一代生物肥料的发展已成为可持续养分管理的有前景的方法。传统微生物接种剂相关的缺点是其田间表现不一致，这归因于微生物在田间条件下、环境因素以及养分释放控制不佳时的生存力有限。合成生物学、微生物工程和生物材料的最新进展使得开发用于农业应用的有益微生物群落成为可能。将这些工程化微生物群落与先进的载体技术相结合，包括源自生物聚合物的水凝胶、纳米材料、生物基聚合物和响应性包埋基质，可以增强微生物保护、受控递送和在土壤中的持久性。微胶囊化方法的应用，如喷雾干燥、离子凝胶化、挤出和微流控封装，可以调节微生物释放并可能提高微生物存活率和根际定殖。智能载体系统设计用于保护微生物细胞并根据环境和植物相关条件调节其释放，从而支持更受控的微生物活动和养分递送。本综述考察了工程化微生物群落、先进封装技术和控释系统的最新发展，旨在提高下一代生物肥料配方中的养分利用效率。
version:doi:10.1007/s12223-026-01613-z:6.sourceTitle: Smart carrier-engineered microbial consortia for precision nutrient delivery in next- generation biofertilizers.
version:doi:10.1007/s12223-026-01613-z:6.sourceAbstract: With the increasing demand for sustainable agricultural productivity under a changing climate, the advancement of new-generation biofertilizers specifically based on engineered microbial consortia and smart delivery systems has become an integral part of agricultural activities. The development of next-generation biofertilizers based on engineered microbial consortia and smart delivery systems has emerged as a promising approach for sustainable nutrient management. The drawback associated with conventional microbial inoculants is their inconsistent field performance, which is attributed to the limited viability of microbes under field conditions, environmental factors, and poorly controlled nutrient release. Recent advances in synthetic biology, microbial engineering, and biomaterials have enabled the development of beneficial microbial consortia for agricultural applications. Combining these engineered microbial consortia with advanced carrier technologies, including hydrogels derived from biopolymers, nanomaterials, bio-based polymers, and responsive encapsulation matrices, can enhance microbial protection, controlled delivery, and persistence in soil. The application of methods for encapsulating microorganisms, such as spray drying, ionic gelation, extrusion, and microfluidic encapsulation, can regulate microbial release and may improve microbial survival and rhizosphere colonization. Smart carrier systems are designed to protect microbial cells and regulate their release in response to environmental and plant-associated conditions, thereby supporting more controlled microbial activity and nutrient delivery. This review examines recent developments in engineered microbial consortia, advanced encapsulation techniques, and controlled-release systems for improving nutrient-use efficiency in next-generation biofertilizer formulations.

version:doi:10.1002/smll.76227:f156ca38-.titleZh: 基于DNA纳米技术的机器人设备在医疗保健前沿应用
version:doi:10.1002/smll.76227:f156ca38-.abstractZh: 在过去十年中，DNA纳米技术实现了多种可编程纳米结构的设计，加速了用于先进医疗保健应用的基于DNA纳米技术的机器人设备（DNRDs）的出现。DNA折纸、DNA步行器和分子逻辑电路的最新进展，使得能够作为逻辑门控纳米药丸、精准生物传感器和自主治疗剂的功能动态且对环境刺激响应的系统成为可能。这些可编程装置还支持货物分拣、分子驱动以及由光、热、pH、酶或电磁刺激触发的外部控制操作。尽管取得了这些进展，但若干挑战仍限制了其临床转化，包括在复杂的生理环境中保持结构稳定性、实现可扩展且具有成本效益的制造，以及解决监管和安全问题，特别是与免疫原性、毒性、脱靶活性、非预期激活、生物分布和长期生物学命运相关的问题。在本综述中，我们全面讨论了DNRDs的演变、设计原理和机制基础，突出了最近的技术进步，并批判性地评估了它们在诊断、治疗和合成生物学中不断扩大的作用。我们还讨论了当前的转化局限性以及提高其安全性、稳健性、可扩展性和临床应用所需的新兴策略。最后，提出了向开发更具可编程性、响应性和临床可转化性的DNRDs发展的未来方向。
version:doi:10.1002/smll.76227:f156ca38-.sourceTitle: DNA Nanotechnology-Based Robotic Devices for Frontier Applications in Healthcare.
version:doi:10.1002/smll.76227:f156ca38-.sourceAbstract: Over the past decade, DNA nanotechnology has enabled the design of diverse programmable nanostructures, accelerating the emergence of DNA nanotechnology-based robotic devices (DNRDs) for advanced healthcare applications. Recent developments in DNA origami, DNA walkers, and molecular logic circuits have enabled dynamic and stimuli-responsive systems capable of functioning as logic-gated nanopills, precision biosensors, and autonomous therapeutic agents. These programmable devices also support cargo sorting, molecular actuation, and externally controlled operations triggered by optical, thermal, pH, enzymatic, or electromagnetic stimuli. Despite these advances, several challenges continue to limit clinical translation, including maintaining structural stability in complex physiological environments, achieving scalable and cost-effective manufacturing, and addressing regulatory and safety considerations, particularly those associated with immunogenicity, toxicity, off-target activity, unintended activation, biodistribution, and long-term biological fate. In this review, we comprehensively discuss the evolution, design principles, and mechanistic foundations of DNRDs, highlight recent technological advances, and critically evaluate their expanding roles in diagnostics, therapeutics, and synthetic biology. We further discuss current translational limitations and emerging strategies required to improve their safety, robustness, scalability, and clinical applicability. Finally, future directions toward the development of increasingly programmable, responsive, and clinically translatable DNRDs are presented.

version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.titleZh: 系统工程化COPII machinery与细胞壁重塑实现克鲁维酵母中重组人血清白蛋白的克级分泌及类天然结构特征
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.abstractZh: 重组人血清白蛋白（rHSA）是血浆来源HSA的重要替代物，但其微生物生产受限于其大尺寸和17个分子内二硫键带来的分泌负担。在此，我们在食品级酵母克鲁维酵母（Kluyveromyces marxianus）中开发了一种系统的分泌网络工程策略。α因子前导序列实现了rHSA的高效分泌和正确的N端加工。对35个SEC基因的系统范围筛选表明，COPII介导的内质网输出是主要的细胞内限制因素。组合工程鉴定出SEC23/SEC13/SEC31为最佳COPII模块，使rHSA分泌量增加了60.7%，尽管生长速度有所降低。筛选13个与细胞壁相关的基因揭示了细胞壁作为一个可工程的界面。结合COPII和细胞壁工程，相对于TOP1-rHSA，细胞外rHSA分别增加了287.3%（COPII+gas1Δkre1Δ）和316.0%（COPII+kre6Δyps1Δ）。RT-qPCR揭示了选定COPII、ER折叠和细胞壁相关基因的菌株特异性转录变化，而应激表型分析、透射电子显微镜和细胞壁染色支持菌株特异性的细胞壁重塑而非明显的细胞壁损伤。在5 L补料分批发酵中，通过定义的营养补充，工程菌株实现了高细胞密度生长和2.32-2.37 g/L的细胞外rHSA积累。远紫外圆二色谱、天然PAGE和LC-HRMS/MS证明了类天然的二级结构、与血清来源HSA相当的非变性电泳迁移率，以及所有17个预期的分子内二硫键连接，与天然HSA一致。这项工作通过多层分泌工程建立了一个食品级酵母底盘，用于生产具有类天然结构特征的rHSA，并为分泌复杂富含二硫键的蛋白质提供了一种通用策略。

question.text: 如何在食品级酵母克鲁维酵母中克服分泌负担，实现重组人血清白蛋白（rHSA）的高产量分泌并保持其类天然结构？
question.evidence: Recombinant human serum albumin (rHSA) is an important alternative to plasma-derived HSA, but its microbial production is constrained by the secretion burden associated with its large size and 17 intramolecular disulfide bonds.

methods.text: 在克鲁维酵母中采用系统性分泌网络工程策略，利用α因子前导序列进行分泌；筛选35个SEC基因以识别COPII限制；组合工程优化SEC23/SEC13/SEC31 COPII模块；筛选13个细胞壁相关基因；结合COPII与细胞壁工程（如gas1Δ, kre1Δ, kre6Δ, yps1Δ）；进行5 L补料分批发酵；使用RT-qPCR、应激表型分析、透射电子显微镜、细胞壁染色、远紫外圆二色谱、天然PAGE和LC-HRMS/MS进行分析。
methods.evidence: Here, we developed a systematic secretory-network engineering strategy in the food-safe yeast Kluyveromyces marxianus.

findings.text: α因子前导序列促进了rHSA的有效分泌和正确加工；SEC23/SEC13/SEC31组合将rHSA分泌提高了60.7%；结合COPII和细胞壁工程使细胞外rHSA较对照组增加287.3%至316.0%；工程菌株在5 L发酵中达到2.32-2.37 g/L的rHSA产量；产物具有类天然二级结构、迁移率和全部17个二硫键。
findings.evidence: Combining COPII and cell wall engineering increased extracellular rHSA by 287.3% (COPII+gas1Δkre1Δ) and 316.0% (COPII+kre6Δyps1Δ) relative to TOP1-rHSA.

version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.sourceTitle: Systematic engineering of COPII machinery and cell wall remodeling enables gram-level secretion of recombinant human serum albumin with native-like structural features in Kluyveromyces marxianus.
version:doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2026.1360.sourceAbstract: Recombinant human serum albumin (rHSA) is an important alternative to plasma-derived HSA, but its microbial production is constrained by the secretion burden associated with its large size and 17 intramolecular disulfide bonds. Here, we developed a systematic secretory-network engineering strategy in the food-safe yeast Kluyveromyces marxianus. The α-factor leader enabled efficient secretion and correct N-terminal processing of rHSA. A system-wide screen of 35 SEC genes implicated coat protein complex II (COPII)-mediated endoplasmic reticulum export as a major intracellular constraint. Combinatorial engineering identified SEC23/SEC13/SEC31 as the optimal COPII module, increasing rHSA secretion by 60.7% although with a reduction in growth. Screening of 13 cell wall-related genes revealed the cell wall as an engineerable interface. Combining COPII and cell wall engineering increased extracellular rHSA by 287.3% (COPII+gas1Δkre1Δ) and 316.0% (COPII+kre6Δyps1Δ) relative to TOP1-rHSA. RT-qPCR revealed strain-specific transcriptional changes in selected COPII-, ER folding-, and cell wall-related genes, while stress phenotyping, transmission electron microscopy, and cell wall staining supported strain-specific cell wall remodeling rather than overt cell wall damage. In 5 L fed-batch fermentation with defined nutrient supplementation, the engineered strains achieved high-cell-density growth and extracellular rHSA accumulation of 2.32-2.37 g/L. Far-UV circular dichroism, Native PAGE, and LC-HRMS/MS demonstrated native-like secondary structure, non-denaturing electrophoretic mobility comparable to serum-derived HSA, and all 17 expected intramolecular disulfide linkages consistent with native HSA. This work establishes a food-safe yeast chassis through multi-layer secretion engineering for the production of rHSA with native-like structural features and provides a generalizable strategy for secreting complex disulfide-rich proteins.

version:doi:10.1111/nph.71583:d6de2939-1.titleZh: 高精度工程化根系发育
version:doi:10.1111/nph.71583:d6de2939-1.abstractZh: 根系的发育受到基因调控、激素信号、发育历史和环境输入之间动态相互作用的控制，形成了多层级的控制机制，这些机制可以被利用来进行工程化改造。单细胞技术、空间转录组学和合成生物学等领域的最新进展开始从细胞水平解析根系发育，并使得对发育程序的越来越精确的操作成为可能。在此，我们讨论了如何将谱系追踪、发育历史的遗传记录、细胞类型特异性工程化和可编程遗传回路整合起来，以理解和控制根系结构。我们强调了工程化适应性及上下文依赖型发育行为的新兴策略，包括依赖于历史的可逆响应程序以及重新连接的根-环境相互作用。总之，这些方法为植物中可编程和适应性根系系统的工程化奠定了基础。

methods.text: 讨论将谱系追踪、发育历史的遗传记录、细胞类型特异性工程化和可编程遗传回路整合以理解和控制根系结构的策略；强调工程化适应性及上下文依赖型发育行为（如可逆响应程序和重连的根-环境相互作用）的新兴策略。
methods.evidence: Here, we discuss how lineage tracing, genetic recording of developmental history, cell-type-specific engineering and programmable genetic circuits can be integrated to understand and control root architecture.

findings.text: 单细胞技术、空间转录组学和合成生物学的最新进展开始从细胞水平解析根系发育并实现精确操作；整合上述方法为植物中可编程和适应性根系系统的工程化奠定基础。
findings.evidence: Together, these approaches establish a foundation for programmable and adaptive root system engineering in plants.

version:doi:10.1111/nph.71583:d6de2939-1.sourceTitle: Engineering root development with high precision.
version:doi:10.1111/nph.71583:d6de2939-1.sourceAbstract: Root development is controlled by dynamic interactions between gene regulation, hormonal signalling, developmental history and environmental inputs, creating multiple layers of control that can be harnessed for engineering. Recent advances in single-cell technologies, spatial transcriptomics and synthetic biology are beginning to resolve root development at the cellular level and enable increasingly precise manipulation of developmental programmes. Here, we discuss how lineage tracing, genetic recording of developmental history, cell-type-specific engineering and programmable genetic circuits can be integrated to understand and control root architecture. We highlight emerging strategies for engineering adaptive and context-dependent developmental behaviours, including history-dependent and reversible response programmes and rewired root-environment interactions. Together, these approaches establish a foundation for programmable and adaptive root system engineering in plants.

version:doi:10.3390/ijms27209203:94f9495.titleZh: 从化学拆分到生物制造：(S)-2-氨基丁醇的合成演变
version:doi:10.3390/ijms27209203:94f9495.abstractZh: 作为抗结核药物乙胺丁醇和抗癫痫药物左乙拉西坦等合成的关键手性前体，手性(S)-2-氨基丁醇需要高光学纯度以确保临床安全。本文系统总结了其合成路线的演变及最新进展。传统的化学方法，包括1-硝基丙烷和1-丁烯环氧化路线，存在严重的安全隐患，且高度依赖下游的手性拆分。然而，无论是化学结晶还是酶促动力学拆分，都受限于50%的理论产率上限，并带来沉重的环境负担。为了打破这一瓶颈，利用胺脱氢酶(AmDHs)和ω-转氨酶(ω-TAs)的体外多酶级联反应应运而生，通过独特的双口袋活性位点模型驱动，实现了从前体底物100%的理论产率和>99%的对映体过量(ee)。此外，合成生物学通过全细胞工厂实现了从头生物合成。值得注意的是，最近报道的45.3 g·L -1 滴度指的是上游氨基酸前体L-2-氨基丁酸(L-2-ABA)，而非最终的(S)-2-氨基丁醇产物。为了克服中间产物2-酮丁酸(2-OBA)的细胞内毒性等瓶颈，包括外排泵工程(如rhtA)和基于群体感应的动态调控在内的策略成功将发酵滴度提升至45.3 g·L -1 。最后，评估了这些代际技术的工业化潜力，强调向体外连续流微反应器以及混合全细胞+无细胞架构的转变，结合AI在全细胞工厂中的应用，代表了绿色低碳制造的未来趋势。
version:doi:10.3390/ijms27209203:94f9495.sourceTitle: Evolution of ( S )-2-Aminobutanol Synthesis from Chemical Resolution to Biomanufacturing.
version:doi:10.3390/ijms27209203:94f9495.sourceAbstract: As a pivotal chiral precursor for the synthesis of the antituberculosis drug ethambutol and antiepileptic drugs such as levetiracetam, Chiral ( S )-2-aminobutanol requires high optical purity for clinical safety. This review systematically summarizes the evolution and recent advances in its synthetic routes. Traditional chemical methods, including the 1-nitropropane and 1-butene epoxidation routes, suffer from severe safety hazards and heavily rely on downstream chiral resolution. However, both chemical crystallization and enzymatic kinetic resolution are constrained by a 50% theoretical yield ceiling and incur heavy environmental burdens. To break this bottleneck, in vitro multienzyme cascades utilizing amine dehydrogenases (AmDHs) and ω-transaminases (ω-TAs) have emerged, achieving 100% theoretical yield from prochiral precursors and >99% enantiomeric excess (ee) driven by a distinct dual-pocket active site model. Furthermore, synthetic biology has enabled de novo biosynthesis via whole-cell cell factories. It should be noted that the recently reported 45.3 g·L -1 titer refers to the upstream amino acid precursor L-2-aminobutyric acid (L-2-ABA), not to the final ( S )-2-aminobutanol product. To overcome bottlenecks like the intracellular toxicity of the intermediate 2-ketobutyrate (2-OBA), strategies including efflux pump engineering (e.g., rhtA ) and quorum sensing-based dynamic regulation have successfully boosted the fermentation titer to 45.3 g·L -1 . Finally, the industrialization potential of these generations of technologies is evaluated, highlighting that the transition toward in vitro continuous-flow microreactors and a hybrid whole-cell + cell-free architecture , combined with the integration of AI into whole-cell factories, represents a future trend for green and low-carbon manufacturing.

version:doi:10.3390/biology15201865:38ca.titleZh: 藻类MYB转录因子的进化多样化及其功能角色：来自基因组分布和调控网络的见解
version:doi:10.3390/biology15201865:38ca.abstractZh: MYB转录因子（TFs）代表一个保守的DNA结合调节因子家族，参与多种细胞和生理过程。MYB TFs在陆生植物中已得到充分表征，但它们在藻类中的进化历史和功能多样性仍知之甚少。本综述总结了藻类MYB TFs的结构分类、进化特征和调控功能的当前知识。对Web of Science核心合集出版物（2003年1月1日至2026年4月27日）的书目计量分析显示，自2019年以来藻类MYB研究显著扩展，重点集中在转录调控、脂质代谢和压力适应。系统发育分析表明，尽管保留了与陆生植物保守的MYB结构域，但藻类MYBs表现出谱系特异性多样化。功能研究进一步证明，MYB TFs调控细胞周期进程、碳浓缩机制、脂质生物合成、营养代谢和非生物胁迫反应。然而，大多数藻类MYB基因的功能尚未被表征。整合多组学与基因组编辑将有助于提高对MYB介导的调控网络的理解，并促进其在藻类生物技术和代谢工程中的未来应用。
version:doi:10.3390/biology15201865:38ca.sourceTitle: Evolutionary Diversification and Functional Roles of MYB Transcription Factors in Algae: Insights from Genomic Distribution and Regulatory Networks.
version:doi:10.3390/biology15201865:38ca.sourceAbstract: MYB transcription factors (TFs) represent a conserved family of DNA-binding regulators involved in diverse cellular and physiological processes. MYB TFs are well-characterized in terrestrial plants, but their evolutionary history and functional diversity in algae remain poorly understood. This review summarizes current knowledge of the structural classification, evolutionary characteristics, and regulatory functions of algal MYB TFs. Bibliometric analysis of Web of Science Core Collection publications (1 January 2003-27 April 2026) reveals a marked expansion in algal MYB research since 2019, with emphasis on transcriptional regulation, lipid metabolism, and stress adaptation. Phylogenetic analyses indicate that algal MYBs exhibit lineage-specific diversification, despite retention of MYB domains conserved with land plants. Functional studies further demonstrate that MYB TFs regulate cell cycle progression, carbon-concentrating mechanisms, lipid biosynthesis, nutrient metabolism, and abiotic stress responses. Nevertheless, most algal MYB genes remain functionally uncharacterized. Integrating multi-omics with genome editing will improve understanding of MYB-mediated regulatory networks and facilitate future applications in algal biotechnology and metabolic engineering.

version:doi:10.3390/biology15201859:4de0.titleZh: 从机制模型到AI协同：预测性与个性化生物学的路线图
version:doi:10.3390/biology15201859:4de0.abstractZh: 两个范式现在驱动着生命科学。一个是数学模型的阐释深度，另一个是人工智能的预测能力。几十年来，机制模型为剖析生物过程提供了严谨的、假设驱动框架，而人工智能已在发现现代生物学大型高维数据集中的模式方面证明了自身实力。两者各自都带来了重大进展。它们共同承诺了一种可能重新定义生物学探究边界的综合。在本综述中，我们提出了整合策略的三部分分类法，即AI加速的机制建模、机制启发的AI以及跨越单向顺序耦合和双向迭代系统的混合模型，并调查了它们在系统生物学和合成生物学、药理学和药物发现、流行病学以及神经科学中的应用。随后，我们审视了七个阻碍因素：可解释性、数据稀疏性、因果性、可识别性、计算规模、多模态集成以及验证和泛化，并以对生物数字孪生体、因果发现引擎和自动化科学的展望作为结尾。我们的论点是将这些方法相结合是新的一代旨在构建预测性和机制性生命科学的跨学科科学家面临的主要任务。
version:doi:10.3390/biology15201859:4de0.sourceTitle: From Mechanistic Models to AI Synergy: A Roadmap for Predictive and Personalized Biology.
version:doi:10.3390/biology15201859:4de0.sourceAbstract: Two paradigms now drive the life sciences. One is the explanatory depth of mathematical modeling, the other the predictive power of artificial intelligence. For decades, mechanistic models have offered a rigorous, hypothesis-driven framework for dissecting biological processes, while AI has proven itself at finding patterns in the large, high-dimensional datasets of modern biology. Each has delivered major advances on its own. Together they promise a synthesis that could redefine the boundaries of biological inquiry. In this review we propose a three-part taxonomy of integration strategies, namely AI-accelerated mechanistic modeling, mechanism-informed AI, and hybrid models spanning one-directional sequential coupling and bidirectional iterative systems, and we survey their applications in systems and synthetic biology, pharmacology and drug discovery, epidemiology, and neuroscience. We then examine seven challenges that stand in the way: interpretability, data sparsity, causality, identifiability, computational scale, multimodal integration, and validation and generalization, and we close with a view of biological digital twins, causal discovery engines, and automated science. Our argument is that combining these approaches is the principal task for a new generation of interdisciplinary scientists who aim to build a predictive and mechanistic science of life.

version:doi:10.1186/s40164-026-00840-x:6.titleZh: 肿瘤内微生物群在癌症免疫治疗中的作用：代谢-表观遗传互作与工程化细菌疗法
version:doi:10.1186/s40164-026-00840-x:6.abstractZh: 肿瘤内微生物组通过其代谢物调节宿主免疫微环境和表观遗传景观，从而对免疫治疗的疗效产生关键影响。微生物来源的代谢物，如短链脂肪酸、次级胆汁酸、氧化三甲胺和色氨酸衍生物，通过DNA甲基化、组蛋白修饰和非编码RNA重编程宿主细胞的表观遗传学，进而塑造抗肿瘤免疫反应并驱动免疫激活或耐药性。反过来，缺氧、酸性和营养匮乏的肿瘤微环境重塑了微生物的组成和代谢，形成恶性循环，进一步影响治疗结果。鉴于这些关键作用，靶向肿瘤内微生物群已成为一种有前景的策略。合成生物学的进展使得开发工程化细菌作为可编程活体疗法成为可能。这些工程菌株能够实现肿瘤特异性定植、受控的药物释放以及多种功能，如细胞因子分泌、免疫检查点阻断、STING通路激活和代谢重编程。通过增强免疫检查点抑制剂的功效并与细胞疗法协同作用，工程化细菌疗法代表了提高免疫治疗效率的一种非常有前景的方法。尽管在临床转化方面面临异质性、抗载体免疫力和制造复杂性等挑战，但该策略为精准癌症治疗提供了新范式。
version:doi:10.1186/s40164-026-00840-x:6.sourceTitle: Intratumoral microbiota in cancer immunotherapy: metabolic-epigenetic crosstalk and engineered bacterial therapeutics.
version:doi:10.1186/s40164-026-00840-x:6.sourceAbstract: The intratumoral microbiome critically influences immunotherapy efficacy by modulating the host immune microenvironment and epigenetic landscape through its metabolites. Microbial derived metabolites such as short chain fatty acids, secondary bile acids, trimethylamine N oxide, and tryptophan derivatives reprogram host cell epigenetics via DNA methylation, histone modifications, and non-coding RNAs, thereby shaping anti-tumor immunity and driving either immune activation or resistance. In turn, the hypoxic, acidic, and nutrient deprived tumor microenvironment reshapes microbial composition and metabolism, forming a vicious cycle that further affects therapeutic outcomes. Given these pivotal roles, targeting the intratumoral microbiota has emerged as a promising strategy. Advances in synthetic biology have enabled the development of engineered bacteria as programmable living therapeutics. These engineered strains achieve tumor specific colonization, controlled drug release, and multimodal functions such as cytokine secretion, immune checkpoint blockade, STING pathway activation, and metabolic reprogramming. By enhancing immune checkpoint inhibitor efficacy and synergizing with cell therapies, engineered bacterial therapy represents a highly promising approach to improve immunotherapy efficiency. Despite challenges in clinical translation including heterogeneity, anti-vector immunity, and manufacturing complexity, this strategy offers a new paradigm for precision cancer treatment.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.15.754060:d.titleZh: PRK内含子为增强莱茵衣藻转基因表达提供模块化工具
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.15.754060:d.abstractZh: 摘要 莱茵衣藻是光合生物技术的理想底盘，尽管遗传工程不断进步，但可靠的核基因转基因表达仍是一个主要限制因素。一种有效策略是在转基因序列中引入内含子以触发内含子介导的增强作用（IME）。保留内源内含子的基因组序列通常比无内含子对应物表现出更高的表达水平，正如我们此前在磷酸核酮糖激酶（PRK）基因中所观察到的那样。在此，我们以莱茵衣藻当前的参考IME元件RBCS2的第一个内含子（RBCS2i1）作为基准，研究了PRK内含子的IME活性。前两个PRK内含子PRKi1和PRKi2成为最活跃的候选者。我们使用两种报告系统、两种遗传背景和多种启动子-终止子组合评估了它们的IME活性，并观察到相对于无内含子对应物的增强效果高达35倍。最后，我们利用广霍香 synthase 验证了其性能，这是一种具有挑战性的转基因，其表达需要内含子，并能生产高价值的倍半萜烯广霍香。在单个RBCS2i1内含子不足的情况下，PRKi1实现了可检测的广霍香产量。总体而言，我们的结果确立了PRKi1和PRKi2作为多功能、MoClo兼容的IME工具，并为优化C. reinhardtii中合成生物学和生物技术应用的转基因表达提供了一个模块化、生物铸造厂兼容的框架。
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.15.754060:d.sourceTitle: PRK introns provide modular tools for enhanced transgene expression in Chlamydomonas reinhardtii
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.15.754060:d.sourceAbstract: Summary Chlamydomonas reinhardtii is an attractive chassis for photosynthetic biotechnology, but reliable nuclear transgene expression remains a major limitation, despite continuing advances in genetic engineering. One effective strategy is the introduction of introns into transgene sequences to trigger Intron-Mediated Enhancement (IME). Genomic sequences retaining endogenous introns often show higher expression than their intronless counterparts, as we previously observed for the phosphoribulokinase (PRK) gene. Here, we investigated the IME activity of PRK introns, using the first intron of RBCS2 (RBCS2i1), the current reference IME element in Chlamydomonas, as a benchmark. The first two PRK introns, PRKi1 and PRKi2, emerged as the most active candidates. We assessed their IME activity using two reporter systems, two genetic backgrounds, and multiple promoter–terminator combinations, and observed enhancements up to 35-fold relative to their intronless counterparts. Finally, we validated their performance using patchoulol synthase, a challenging transgene whose expression requires introns and enables the production of the high-value sesquiterpene patchoulol. PRKi1 enabled detectable patchoulol production under conditions in which a single RBCS2i1 intron was insufficient. Overall, our results establish PRKi1 and PRKi2 as versatile, MoClo-compatible IME tools and provide a modular, Biofoundry-compatible framework for optimizing transgene expression for synthetic biology and biotechnological applications in C. reinhardtii .

version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.titleZh: 利用烃类和脂肪酸的混合碳源发酵增强中链长度聚羟基烷酸酯生产
version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.abstractZh: 含有脂肪酸和烃类的混合碳流与聚羟基烷酸酯（PHA）生物制造相关，特别是对于 valorizing 废物和升级回收产生化学多样性底物的塑料。本研究评估了脂肪酸（C6-C18）、烃类（C6-C18）及其混合物对假单胞菌属 putida（PP）、假单胞菌属 resinovorans（PR）以及 PP-PR 共培养物生产中链长度聚羟基烷酸酯（mcl-PHA）的作用。在单一脂肪酸中，癸酸（C10）产生了最高的细胞浓度（2.05 g/L）。富含中链的脂肪酸混合物（C6-C12，无论是否含 C14）促进了 PHA 积累，而含 C8 的烃类进料有利于生长。在混合烃类-脂肪酸配方 HCFA-1 上生长的 PP-PR 共培养物在测试的配置中实现了最高的 PHA 含量（60.96 wt%），滴度为 2.11 g/L。聚合物主要由 (R)-3-羟基辛酸（HO）和 (R)-3-羟基癸酸（HD）组成，(R)-3-羟基十二酸（HDD）为次要成分，并含有可变量的 (R)-3-羟基己酸（HHx）和 (R)-3-羟基十四酸（HTD）。富含 C8 的底物混合物有利于 HO，而富含 C10 的混合物增加了 HD 的比例。因此，除了支持微生物生长和 PHA 积累外，进料组成还可以定制聚合物组成。由于 HO 和 HD 的侧链长度不同，这些组成变化可能会影响链堆积和结晶。因此，调整 HO:HD 比例可能有助于定制用于包装薄膜、涂层和其他高附加值生物塑料的柔韧性和热行为。尽管 PHA 滴度适中，但本研究考察的是底物组成的影响，而非高滴度工艺优化。这些发现将混合碳利用与可调节的 mcl-PHA 组成联系起来，并为设计针对生物塑料应用的进料配方提供了指导。
version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.sourceTitle: Mixed-Carbon Fermentation with Hydrocarbons and Fatty Acids for Enhanced Medium-Chain-Length Polyhydroxyalkanoate Production.
version:doi:10.1016/j.jbiotec.2026.10.01.sourceAbstract: Mixed-carbon streams containing fatty acids and hydrocarbons are relevant to polyhydroxyalkanoate (PHA) biomanufacturing, particularly for valorizing waste and upcycling plastics that yield chemically diverse substrates. This study evaluated fatty acids (C6-C18), hydrocarbons (C6-C18), and their mixtures for medium-chain-length polyhydroxyalkanoate (mcl-PHA) production by Pseudomonas putida (PP), Pseudomonas resinovorans (PR), and a PP-PR co-culture. Among individual fatty acids, decanoic acid (C10) resulted in the highest cell concentration (2.05g/L). Medium-chain-rich fatty-acid mixtures (C6-C12, with or without C14) promoted PHA accumulation, whereas C8-containing hydrocarbon feeds favored growth. The PP-PR co-culture grown on the mixed hydrocarbon-fatty-acid formulation HCFA-1 achieved the highest PHA content among the tested configurations (60.96wt%), with a titer of 2.11g/L. The polymers consisted predominantly of (R)-3-hydroxyoctanoic acid (HO) and (R)-3-hydroxydecanoic acid (HD), with (R)-3-hydroxydodecanoic acid (HDD) as a secondary component and variable amounts of (R)-3-hydroxyhexanoic acid (HHx) and (R)-3-hydroxytetradecanoic acid (HTD). C8-rich substrate mixtures favored HO, whereas C10-rich mixtures increased the HD fraction. Thus, feed composition can tailor polymer composition in addition to supporting microbial growth and PHA accumulation. Because HO and HD differ in side-chain length, these compositional shifts may affect chain packing and crystallization. Adjusting the HO:HD ratio could therefore help tailor flexibility and thermal behavior for packaging films, coatings, and other value-added bioplastics. Although PHA titers were modest, this study examined substrate-composition effects rather than high-titer process optimization. These findings link mixed-carbon utilization to tunable mcl-PHA composition and provide guidance for designing feed formulations for targeted bioplastic applications.

version:doi:10.3390/ijms27209187:c2d2d57.titleZh: 蛋白质自组装作为生物催化中酶固定的设计原则
version:doi:10.3390/ijms27209187:c2d2d57.abstractZh: 酶的固定化对于通过将酶的稳定性、回收率和重复使用率来提高，从而将生物催化过程从实验室转化为工业应用至关重要。它在制药、生物燃料和食品生产中支撑着可持续工艺，但传统的固定化策略涉及固有的权衡。共价连接可防止酶泄漏，但可能会扭曲活性位点，而物理吸附更好地保留酶的构象，但允许酶泄漏。此外，基于载体的方法经常遇到传质限制，并可能需要外部交联剂，阻碍了更广泛的工业应用。合成生物学和材料科学的最新进展加速了用于生物催化的蛋白质基材料的开发。本综述考察了蛋白质自组装作为酶固定的统一设计原则，能够在相对温和的条件下实现可编程组装，以克服传统策略的关键局限性。我们讨论了天然衍生的结构（如细菌微室）和工程系统（包括病毒样颗粒、弹性蛋白样多肽以及 SpyTag/SpyCatcher），这些结构支持可编程的酶组织并实现区室化的多酶级联反应。在此基础上，重点放在具有催化活性的包涵体（CatIBs）上。作为稳健的、内在自固定的蛋白质聚集体，CatIBs 代表了一个简化的无载体平台，为工业生物催化提供了潜在的工艺和成本优势。

question.text: 如何利用蛋白质自组装作为统一的设计原则来改进酶的固定化，以克服传统策略在稳定性、防泄漏、传质及成本方面的局限性？
