limitations.text: 经济竞争力仍强烈受到原料预处理、水解、解毒、发酵性能和下游加工要求的影响。
limitations.evidence: However, their economic competitiveness remains strongly influenced by feedstock pretreatment, hydrolysis, detoxification, fermentation performance, and downstream processing requirements.

version:doi:10.1007/s11274-026-05339-5:8.sourceTitle: Recent progress in microbial succinic acid production: integrating genome engineering and fermentation strategies.
version:doi:10.1007/s11274-026-05339-5:8.sourceAbstract: Succinic acid is a four-carbon dicarboxylic acid and important platform chemical with diverse applications in food and feed, pharmaceutical, textile, and bio-based polymer industries. Growing demand for sustainable and economically viable production routes has stimulated increasing interest in microbial routes for succinic acid biosynthesis as an alternative to conventional petrochemical processes. This mini-review summarizes recent advances in microbial succinic acid production, with particular emphasis on strain development, metabolic engineering, and fermentation-process optimization. Significant progress has been achieved through engineering of both native producers, Actinobacillus succinogenes, Mannheimia succiniciproducens, and Corynebacterium glutamicum and non-native production hosts, such as Escherichia coli, Klebsiella oxytoca, and several yeast species, leading to marked improvements in succinate concentration, yield, and productivity. Emerging approaches, including adaptive-laboratory evolution, systems-level omics, and CRISPR-Cas9, have enabled more precise control of carbon flux toward succinic acid biosynthesis while improving cellular tolerance to low pH and elevated succinic acid concentrations. In parallel, advances in fermentation and bioprocess strategies, particularly low-pH fermentation and enhanced CO₂ fixation, together with the valorization of renewable feedstocks such as lignocellulosic hydrolysates, offer promising opportunities to improve process feasibility and sustainability. However, their economic competitiveness remains strongly influenced by feedstock pretreatment, hydrolysis, detoxification, fermentation performance, and downstream processing requirements. Finally, current challenges and future perspectives for industrial-scale succinic acid production are discussed, highlighting the importance of integrating strain engineering with innovative bioprocess design to develop robust, economically competitive, and environmentally sustainable production platforms.

version:doi:10.1021/acschembio.6c00661:6.titleZh: 白桦茸中UbiA型萜类合酶的鉴定与功能表征
version:doi:10.1021/acschembio.6c00661:6.abstractZh: 白桦茸（Chaga蘑菇）是一种富含结构多样萜类的药用担子菌，但负责倍半萜形成的生物合成酶仍知之甚少。在此，我们从白桦茸基因组中鉴定了六个UbiA型萜类合酶（IoUbiA1-6），并通过在米曲霉中进行异源表达对其进行了功能表征。GC-MS和NMR分析表明，IoUbiA1-4催化双环倍半萜的生物合成，包括(+)-Z-α-荜澄茄烯（1）、(-)-β-姜黄烯（2）和(6R,7E)-α-荜澄茄烯（3）。序列比对和突变分析揭示了两个高度保守的催化基序NQXXXXXXXED和QDXXDXXXD，它们对酶活性至关重要，因为关键残基的丙氨酸取代完全消除了产物形成。这些结果实验性地确立了真菌UbiA型萜类合酶中保守基序的催化重要性。此外，米曲霉表达宿主中甲羟戊酸途径的代谢工程显著提高了化合物1的产量，从3.99 mg/kg增加到61.13 mg/kg。本研究扩展了真菌UbiA型萜类合酶的功能多样性，阐明了白桦茸中双环倍半萜生物合成的分子基础，并为有价值倍半萜的生物技术生产提供了基础。
version:doi:10.1021/acschembio.6c00661:6.sourceTitle: Identification and Functional Characterization of UbiA-Type Terpene Synthases in Inonotus obliquus.
version:doi:10.1021/acschembio.6c00661:6.sourceAbstract: Inonotus obliquus (Chaga mushroom) is a medicinal basidiomycete rich in structurally diverse terpenoids, yet the biosynthetic enzymes responsible for sesquiterpene formation remain poorly understood. Here, we identified six UbiA-type terpene synthases (IoUbiA1-6) from the I. obliquus genome and functionally characterized them through heterologous expression in Aspergillus oryzae. GC-MS and NMR analyses demonstrated that IoUbiA1-4 catalyze the biosynthesis of bisabolane-type sesquiterpenes, including (+)-Z-α-bisabolene (1), (-)-β-curcumene (2), and (6R,7E)-α-bisabolene (3). Sequence alignment and mutational analyses revealed two highly conserved catalytic motifs, NQXXXXXXXED and QDXXDXXXD, that are essential for enzymatic activity, as alanine substitution of key residues completely abolished product formation. These results experimentally establish the catalytic significance of the conserved motifs in fungal UbiA-type terpene synthases. In addition, metabolic engineering of the mevalonate pathway in the A. oryzae expression host significantly increased 1 production from 3.99 to 61.13 mg/kg. This study expands the functional diversity of fungal UbiA-type terpene synthases, uncovers the molecular basis for bisabolane-type sesquiterpene biosynthesis in I. obliquus, and provides a foundation for the biotechnological production of valuable sesquiterpenoids.

version:doi:10.1016/j.mtbio.2026.103743:.titleZh: AICAR诱导的内皮细胞能量供应和旁分泌活性通过促进血管生成和调节巨噬细胞重编程加速慢性糖尿病伤口愈合
version:doi:10.1016/j.mtbio.2026.103743:.abstractZh: 慢性糖尿病伤口愈合严重受到内皮细胞（EC）功能障碍、血管生成缺陷和持续性炎症微环境的阻碍，然而在此过程中EC能量代谢与巨噬细胞极化之间的串扰仍知之甚少。在此，我们鉴定了EC中一种AMPK依赖性代谢通路，该通路协调了血管生成恢复和巨噬细胞免疫重编程以促进糖尿病伤口修复，并将此机制转化为一种由熔融电书写技术制备的功能性三维（3D）支架（MEWs + GelMA@AI）。腺苷酰肌氨酸（AICAR）通过激活AMPK有效诱导EC处于高能状态，保持线粒体超微结构，增强呼吸链复合物活性，并增加VEGF表达和血管生成潜能。值得注意的是，我们发现由这些代谢激活的EC分泌的AI-EXO将GAS6作为关键旁分泌因子递送至巨噬细胞，从而触发MER/AKT通路的激活并驱动M1向M2极化。据我们所知，这是首次报道外泌体GAS6是糖尿病伤口愈合中EC-巨噬细胞串扰的介质。具有多孔结构和持续AICAR释放特性的MEWs + GelMA@AI支架在体外表现出优异的细胞相容性和促血管生成活性。体内实验显示，该支架通过促进新生血管形成、减少炎症浸润以及增加M2/M1巨噬细胞比率，显著加速了糖尿病伤口的闭合，且在主要器官中未检测到系统性毒性。这些发现确立了EC能量代谢与免疫微环境重塑之间的关键联系，为慢性糖尿病伤口提供了一种潜在可转化的代谢工程策略。本研究为针对代谢-免疫相互作用的再生疗法开辟了新的途径。
version:doi:10.1016/j.mtbio.2026.103743:.sourceTitle: AICAR-induced energy supply and paracrine activity of endothelial cells accelerate chronic diabetic wound healing by promoting angiogenesis and modulating macrophage reprogramming.
version:doi:10.1016/j.mtbio.2026.103743:.sourceAbstract: Chronic diabetic wound healing is severely hampered by endothelial cell (EC) dysfunction, defective angiogenesis, and a persistent inflammatory microenvironment, yet the crosstalk between EC energy metabolism and macrophage polarization in this process remains poorly understood. Here, we identified an AMPK-dependent metabolic pathway in ECs that orchestrated both angiogenic restoration and macrophage immune reprogramming for diabetic wound repair, and translated this mechanism into a functional three-dimensional (3D) scaffold (MEWs + GelMA@AI) fabricated by melt electrospinning writing technology. Acadesine (AICAR) efficiently induced a high-energy state in ECs by activating AMPK, preserving mitochondrial ultrastructure, enhancing respiratory-chain complex activity, and increasing VEGF expression and angiogenic potential. Notably, we discovered that AI-EXO, secreted by these metabolically activated ECs, delivered GAS6 to macrophages as a key paracrine factor, thereby triggering activation of the MER/AKT pathway and driving M1-to-M2 polarization. To our knowledge, this is the first report identifying exosomal GAS6 as a mediator of EC-macrophage crosstalk in diabetic wound healing. The MEWs + GelMA@AI scaffold, characterized by a porous structure and sustained AICAR release, exhibited excellent cytocompatibility and proangiogenic activity in vitro . In vivo , the scaffold significantly accelerated diabetic wound closure by promoting neovascularization, reducing inflammatory infiltration, and increasing the M2/M1 macrophage ratio, without detectable systemic toxicity in major organs. These findings establish a critical link between EC energy metabolism and immune microenvironment remodeling, providing a potentially translatable metabolic-engineering strategy for chronic diabetic wounds. This study opens new avenues for regenerative therapies targeting metabolic-immune interactions.

version:doi:10.1186/s13068-026-02831-w:8.titleZh: 谷氨酸棒杆菌可持续从头生产异丁胺的代谢工程策略
version:doi:10.1186/s13068-026-02831-w:8.abstractZh: 背景：短链伯胺是生物系统中一类多功能分子，由氨基酸脱羧或含羰基分子的转氨作用衍生而来。异丁胺是L-缬氨酸的脱羧产物，在药物、除草剂、杀菌剂和专用化学品化学合成中具有应用价值，作为石化化合物的替代品尤其引人注目。由于短链伯胺的化学合成具有危害性且环境不可持续，我们在本工作中建立了一种高效的生物合成方法。结果：天然氨基酸生产者谷氨酸棒杆菌是生产氨基酸衍生物的理想底盘。在本研究中，我们评估了多种相关短链伯胺对谷氨酸棒杆菌的毒性。粗提物实验表明，来自Viridifaciens链霉菌的L-缬氨酸脱羧酶VlmD Sv能将L-缬氨酸脱羧为异丁胺。该酶对于将三种工程菌株中的丙酮酸产量延长以产生L-缬氨酸并最终生成异丁胺至关重要。为确保细胞内L-缬氨酸供应，通过删除支链氨基酸外排蛋白BrnFE Cg基因和/或过表达L-缬氨酸转运蛋白基因brnQ Cg，将胞外L-缬氨酸积累量降低了高达20倍。令人惊讶的是，大肠杆菌来源的转氢酶基因pntAB Ec的表达并未改善反而大幅降低了异丁胺产量。生化分析显示，pntAB Ec的表达使膜电位去极化。结论：本研究展示了在最小培养基中异丁胺的最高产量以及任何微生物短链伯胺的最高产量。在摇瓶培养中，异丁胺效价为12.1 g/L，产率为每摩尔葡萄糖产生0.74摩尔异丁胺。转移至3 L补料分批发酵罐发酵成功，在64小时内达到33.2 g/L的效价，产率为0.47 mol/mol，体积生产率为0.52 g/l/h。此外，还展示了在第二代原料上生产异丁胺，突显了异丁胺可持续生物基生产的潜力。
version:doi:10.1186/s13068-026-02831-w:8.sourceTitle: Metabolic engineering strategies for sustainable de novo isobutylamine production by Corynebacterium glutamicum.
version:doi:10.1186/s13068-026-02831-w:8.sourceAbstract: Background Short-chain primary amines are a versatile group of molecules in biological systems, derived from the decarboxylation of amino acids or the transamination of carbonyl-containing molecules. Isobutylamine, the decarboxylation product of L-valine, has applications in chemical synthesis of pharmaceuticals, herbicides, fungicides and specialized chemicals, where it is especially interesting as a substitute for petrochemical compounds. Since the chemical synthesis of short-chain primary amines is hazardous and environmentally unsustainable, we established an efficient biosynthetic approach in this work. Results The natural amino acid producer Corynebacterium glutamicum is an ideal chassis for the production of amino acid-derived molecules. In this study, we assessed the toxicity of several relevant short-chain primary amines on C. glutamicum. A crude extract assay demonstrated the decarboxylation of L-valine to isobutylamine by the L-valine decarboxylase VlmD Sv from Streptomyces viridifaciens. This enzyme was instrumental to extend production of pyruvate in three engineered strains to yield L-valine and subsequently isobutylamine. To ensure intracellular L-valine supply, the extracellular L-valine accumulation was decreased up to 20-fold by deletion of the genes for the branched-chain amino acid exporter BrnFE Cg and/or overexpression of the L-valine importer gene brnQ Cg . Surprisingly, expression of the transhydrogenase genes pntAB Ec from Escherichia coli did not improve but drastically reduced isobutylamine production. Biochemical analysis revealed that pntAB Ec expression depolarized the membrane potential. Conclusions This study demonstrated the highest production of isobutylamine and the highest production of any microbial short-chain primary amine in minimal medium. In shake flask cultivation, an isobutylamine titer of 12.1 g/L and a yield of 0.74 mol isobutylamine/mol glucose were obtained. Transfer to a 3 L fed-batch bioreactor fermentation was successful and a titer of 33.2 g/L was reached within 64 h with a yield of 0.47 mol/mol and a volumetric productivity of 0.52 g/l/h. Moreover, isobutylamine production on a second-generation feedstock was shown, highlighting the potential of sustainable bio-based production of isobutylamine.

version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.titleZh: 工程化微生物平台用于多样化生物合成抗抑郁色氨酸衍生神经活性化合物
version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.abstractZh: 色氨酸衍生的神经活性化合物，包括血清素、褪黑激素、5-羟基色氨酸（5-HTP）、裸盖菇素及相关吲哚衍生物，代表了一类重要的用于治疗抑郁症和其他神经精神疾病的疗法。然而，通过化学合成或天然提取的传统生产方式仍然受到可持续性低、选择性差和制造成本高的限制。合成生物学、代谢工程和酶工程的进步使得开发微生物细胞工厂以高效生物合成这些高价值化合物成为可能。本综述强调了在工程化微生物平台用于抗抑郁色氨酸衍生物方面的最新进展，重点在于色氨酸过量生产、羟基化生物催化剂、下游生物合成途径以及辅因子工程。我们进一步讨论了细菌血红素依赖性色氨酸羟化酶以及人工智能辅助的酶和途径工程在扩展生物合成工具箱中的新兴作用。最后，我们概述了将智能菌株设计与先进生物工艺工程相结合以推动色氨酸衍生神经活性物质生物制造的当前挑战和未来机遇。
version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.sourceTitle: Engineering microbial platforms for diversified biosynthesis of antidepressant tryptophan-derived neuroactive compounds.
version:doi:10.1016/j.biotechadv.2026.10.sourceAbstract: Tryptophan-drived neuroactive compounds, including serotonin, melatonin, 5-hydroxytryptophan (5-HTP), psilocybin, and related indole derivatives, represent an important class of therapeutics for depression and other neuropsychiatric disorders. However, conventional production through chemical synthesis or natural extraction remains limited by low sustainability, poor selectivity, and high manufacturing costs. Advances in synthetic biology, metabolic engineering, and enzyme engineering have enabled the development of microbial cell factories for the efficient biosynthesis of these high-value compounds. This Review highlights recent progress in engineering microbial platforms for antidepressant tryptophan derivatives, focusing on tryptophan overproduction, hydroxylation biocatalysts, downstream biosynthetic pathways, and cofactor engineering. We further discuss the emerging roles of bacterial heme-dependent tryptophan hydroxylases and AI-assisted enzyme and pathway engineering in expanding the biosynthetic toolbox. Finally, we outline current challenges and future opportunities for integrating intelligent strain design with advanced bioprocess engineering to advance the biomanufacturing of tryptophan-derived neuroactives.

version:doi:10.2174/01138955754788482610.titleZh: 香豆素骨架在药物化学中的创新应用：设计策略与治疗潜力
version:doi:10.2174/01138955754788482610.abstractZh: 香豆素（1,2-苯并吡喃-2-酮）是一种天然存在的苯并吡喃酮，作为由植物、真菌和某些细菌产生的多种生物活性化合物的核心骨架。香豆素衍生物表现出广泛的生物活性，包括抗凝血、抗氧化、抗炎、抗菌和抗癌作用。羟基化、糖基化、甲氧基化和预nylation等结构修饰改善了其药代动力学和治疗特性。合成化学、代谢工程和生物转化方法的进展使得生产具有更高溶解度、生物利用度和跨多个疾病领域治疗相关性的新型香豆素衍生物成为可能。本综述强调了在合理设计香豆素衍生物以提高效力、选择性和药代动力学特性方面所采用的创新策略。重点介绍了支撑开发具有抗癌、抗菌、抗氧化、抗炎、抗凝血和神经保护活性的香豆素杂化物的构效关系（SAR）研究。本综述强调了香豆素衍生物的合理设计、合成、生物催化修饰、代谢工程、构效关系和治疗应用方面的最新进展。

question.text: 香豆素骨架在药物化学中的创新应用、设计策略及其治疗潜力是什么？

version:doi:10.2174/01138955754788482610.sourceTitle: Innovative Applications of The Coumarin Scaffold In Medicinal Chemistry: Design Strategies and Therapeutic Potential.
version:doi:10.2174/01138955754788482610.sourceAbstract: Coumarin (1,2-benzopyran-2-one) is a naturally occurring benzopyrone that serves as the core scaffold of a diverse class of bioactive compounds produced by plants, fungi, and certain bacteria. Coumarin derivatives exhibit a broad spectrum of biological activities, including anticoagulant, antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anticancer effects. Structural modifications such as hydroxylation, glycosylation, methoxylation, and prenylation improve their pharmacokinetic and therapeutic properties. Progress in synthetic chemistry, metabolic engineering, and biotransformation methods has enabled the production of new coumarin derivatives with greater solubility, bioavailability, and therapeutic relevance across multiple disease domains. This review highlights innovative strategies employed in the rational design of coumarin derivatives to enhance potency, selectivity, and pharmacokinetic properties. Emphasis is placed on structure-activity relationship (SAR) studies that underpin the development of coumarin hybrids with anticancer, antimicrobial, antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, anticoagulant, and neuroprotective activities. This review highlights recent advances in the rational design, synthesis, biocatalytic modification, metabolic engineering, structure-activity relationships, and therapeutic applications of coumarin derivatives.

version:doi:10.1080/15592324.2026.272031.titleZh: 绿藻 Euglena gracilis 蛋白质组图谱：厌氧响应下的全局、磷酸化和泛素化蛋白质组
version:doi:10.1080/15592324.2026.272031.abstractZh: 光合鞭毛虫绿藻（Euglena）表现出显著的代谢灵活性，使其能够在厌氧适应过程中动态协调能量产生和资源分配。虽然缺氧下的蜡酯合成已有详尽记录，但蛋白质丰度与翻译后修饰（PTMs）之间的调控相互作用仍未被探索。缺乏高深度蛋白质组学资源和碎片化的基因组注释阻碍了对这种代谢重塑的明确理解，这些注释未能捕捉绿藻的蛋白质组多样性和可塑性。在此，我们通过先进的 LC-MS/MS 分析提供了全面的绿藻蛋白质组图谱。利用最近完善的蛋白质组注释，我们鉴定了 9,122 个蛋白群、12,027 个磷酸肽和 3,346 个泛素化肽，建立了全面的绿藻蛋白质组参考。我们的结果表明，厌氧适应的特征是独特的磷酸化和泛素化信号，这些信号通常独立于全局蛋白质丰度的变化而发生，揭示了在绿藻厌氧适应期间中心代谢受到 PTM 介导的控制。本研究提供了一个基础资源，弥合了绿藻基因组潜力与功能代谢之间的差距。通过解析蛋白水平与 PTM 驱动调控之间的相互作用，我们的工作为研究环境适应提供了新资源，并为绿藻未来的代谢工程提供了严谨的框架。
version:doi:10.1080/15592324.2026.272031.sourceTitle: Mapping the proteome landscape in Euglena gracilis : global, phospho, and ubiquitin proteomes under anaerobic response.
version:doi:10.1080/15592324.2026.272031.sourceAbstract: The photosynthetic flagellate Euglena gracilis (Euglena) exhibits a remarkable metabolic flexibility, enabling the dynamic coordination of energy production and resource partitioning during anaerobic adaptation. While the wax ester synthesis under hypoxia is well-documented, the regulatory interplay between protein abundance and post-translational modifications (PTMs) remains unexplored. A definitive understanding of this metabolic remodeling is hindered by the lack of high-depth proteomic resources and the fragmented genome annotations, which fail to capture Euglena's proteomic diversity and plasticity. Here, we provide a comprehensive Euglena proteome landscape through advanced LC-MS/MS analysis. By leveraging the recently refined proteome annotation, we identified 9,122 protein groups, 12,027 phospho-peptides, and 3,346 ubiquitinated peptides, establishing a comprehensive Euglena's proteome reference. Our results demonstrate that anaerobic adaptation is characterized by distinct phosphorylation and ubiquitination signatures that often occur independently of changes in global protein abundance, revealing a layer of PTM-mediated control over central metabolism during anaerobic adaptation in Euglena. This study provides a foundational resource that bridges the gap between genomic potential and functional metabolic in Euglena. By resolving the interplay between protein levels and PTM-driven regulation, our work offers a new resource for investigating environmental adaptation and provides a rigorous framework for future metabolic engineering in Euglena.

version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.08.757560:4.titleZh: MINT：通过蛋白质-配体相互作用的多模态知识转移预测酶-辅因子特异性
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.08.757560:4.abstractZh: 蛋白质-辅因子选择性预测对于酶注释、代谢工程和生物催化剂发现至关重要，但这一领域仍具有挑战性，因为经过实验验证的关联有限且分布不均，并且生物学相关的差异可能比一般蛋白质-配体相互作用模型所捕捉到的差异更为细微。在此，我们提出了MINT（带有教师监督的多模态交互网络），这是一种用于辅因子特异性预测的多模态框架。MINT结合了蛋白质序列特征与辅因子序列和图表示，并采用渐进式适应策略进行训练，该策略将预训练的蛋白质-配体相互作用模型中的有用信息转移到辅因子预测任务中。在一个固定的平衡保留测试集上，MINT在所有比较方法中实现了最佳的整体性能（AUC = 0.932），这一排名在自然阳性率下的独立家族分层评估中也得到了复现（合并 AUC = 0.939）。进一步的分析表明，预训练模型提供了可转移的结构信息，而渐进式训练方案有助于将这些信息适应于辅因子特异性。在一项针对化学上几乎相同的NAD/NADP对的案例研究中，MINT恢复了95.0-98.6%的真实结合者，并解决了与工程化酶辅因子特异性直接相关的单磷酸水平区分问题。这些结果表明，当注释有限时，渐进式迁移学习是辅因子特异性预测的一种有效方法。
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.08.757560:4.sourceTitle: MINT: Predicting Enzyme-Cofactor Specificity by Multimodal Knowledge Transfer from Protein–Ligand Interactions
version:doi:10.64898/2026.10.08.757560:4.sourceAbstract: ABSTRACT Protein-cofactor selectivity prediction is important for enzyme annotation, metabolic engineering, and biocatalyst discovery, but it remains challenging because experimentally supported associations are limited and unevenly distributed, and because biologically relevant differences can be subtler than those captured by general protein-ligand interaction models. Here, we present MINT (Multimodal Interaction Network with Teacher supervision), a multimodal framework for cofactor specificity prediction. MINT combines protein sequence features with cofactor sequence and graph representations and is trained with a gradual adaptation strategy that transfers useful information from a pretrained protein-ligand interaction model to the cofactor prediction task. On a fixed balanced held-out test set, MINT achieved the best overall performance among all compared methods (AUC = 0.932), and this ranking was reproduced in an independent family-stratified evaluation at the natural positive rate (pooled AUC = 0.939). Further analyses suggest that the pretrained model provides transferable structural information, while the gradual training scheme helps adapt that information to cofactor specificity. In a case study of the chemically near-identical NAD/NADP pair, MINT recovered 95.0-98.6% of true binders and resolved a single-phosphate-level distinction with direct relevance to engineering enzyme cofactor specificity. These results show that gradual transfer learning is an effective approach to cofactor specificity prediction when annotation is limited. TOC
